You own the GTM stack for our EMEA team, from Salesforce workflows to the integrations that tie HubSpot, Notion, and Slack together.

As a Revenue Operations Engineer, your role will include:

  • Account intelligence and enrichment: You will build and extend Clay tables, enrichment, and discovery pipelines that find new accounts and surface the right ones to sales and SDRs. You will push the tool well past its current setup and get the full value out of it.

  • AI agents and automation: You will turn manual GTM workflows into automated ones using agents in Clay, Salesforce, and Claude. You build them to run end to end and stay useful, not to demo once and break a month later.

  • Data quality that stays clean: You will design repeatable processes that keep account and contact data accurate over time. When a cleanup happens, it happens once, and the workflow behind it prevents the mess from coming back.

  • Scoring and top-of-funnel signals: You will own account and MQL funnel scoring and the signal workflows that route intent to the right seller at the right time.

  • Systems and integrations: You will build Salesforce workflows and maintain integrations across Salesforce, HubSpot, Momentum, Chili Piper, Notion, and Slack. When a new tool or feature beats what we built six months ago, you will make the call to replace it.

  • EMEA RevOps support: You will own the RevOps ticket queue during EMEA hours, partnering with our US-based RevOps teammate for follow-the-sun coverage. That includes helping reps with live opportunity questions, not only systems work.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Hands-on Clay experience: You have built Clay tables, enrichment waterfalls, and pipelines yourself, and can explain what you would build next.

  • Salesforce depth: You can build Salesforce flows and automation, not just run reports. HubSpot fluency is expected alongside it.

  • AI-forward building: You have built AI agents or automations that run in production, using tools like Claude, Clay agents, or Salesforce automation, and you can show what they do today.

  • Systems thinking for GTM: You understand how scoring, routing, enrichment, and CRM hygiene connect, and you design for the whole loop rather than one fix.

  • EMEA-based and self-directed: You are based in EMEA, comfortable owning a queue without a teammate in your time zone, and you decide what to fix next without waiting to be told.

Bonus points for:

  • Salesforce Admin certification: Or equivalent admin-level experience owning an org.

  • Code and CLI comfort: Experience with scripting, APIs, the Claude CLI, or MCP integrations.

  • Startup scaling experience: You have helped a company grow from Series A toward later stage and built the systems that growth needed.

  • Advanced Clay or Anthropic tooling: You are the person others ask when they want to know what Clay or Claude can actually do.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule:  You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility:  We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

jobs.title: Property Manager
jobs.description:
About Letly

Letly is the AI-Native operating company built for the home. We believe the home should be autonomously run and we're building the software that will run all rental properties end-to-end.

Our landlords hand us their most valuable asset, often on a guaranteed rent, so how well a property is run is our product. Property Managers own every property after the tenant moves in: compliance, maintenance, rent, renewals and the relationship with the landlord and tenant.

We've raised a $4m pre-seed and are a small, high-agency team, growing revenue at >100% month-over-month. We're hiring to keep service quality ahead of that growth.

 

How we manage

We run portfolios, not inboxes. Every property has an owner who knows its compliance dates, its contractors, its rent position and its tenant by name. Problems get fixed before the landlord or tenant has to chase.

We're honest about what's ours to fix and what isn't. Repairs are triaged on liability and urgency, quoted against evidence and closed out with proof. AI handles the triage, chasing and admin, so a PM's time goes on decisions, contractors and people.

When a guaranteed property sits empty or arrears build, it's our money on the line, so a PM thinks like an owner.

 

What we're looking for

  • Experience. ~2+ years running a residential lettings portfolio as a property manager, at an agency, BTR operator or block manager.

  • Working knowledge of landlord compliance: gas safety, EICR, EPC, smoke and CO alarms, deposit protection, Right to Rent, HMO and selective licensing.

  • Up to date on the Renters' Rights Act 2025 and what it changes for possession, rent increases and repairs.

  • A track record of managing contractors on cost, quality and turnaround.

  • Driven, with an entrepreneurial mindset. You build the process when there isn't one yet, and you want to grow with the business.

 

Nice to have

  • ARLA Propertymark qualification (or working towards it).

  • Experience with Fixflo or similar maintenance tools.

  • HMO or guaranteed-rent portfolio experience in London.

 

How you work

  • Hyper-focus on detail. A missed certificate date or an unprotected deposit is a fine, not a typo.

  • Ownership mentality. You own the property's outcome from start to end, without being chased.

  • Commercial judgement. You know when to repair, when to replace, and who should pay.

  • Communication clarity. Calm and direct with tenants, landlords and contractors, especially when the news is bad.

  • Pace. You close issues fast and keep a portfolio moving while it grows.

  • AI-Native. You use our tools to cut the admin and spend your time where judgement matters.

 

Benefits

On top of base salary, equity and bonus, you're also entitled to:

  • Private health insurance

  • Three meals a day, in office

  • Ubers home on late nights

  • Sponsored professional qualifications and accreditation

🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Field Engineer - Hardware

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) UAV / Robotics Integration Engineer, you will be the part of SE3’s engineering team to bring our technology into real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, end-to-end prototyping and field engineering role. You will work directly with other startups, prime contractors, and military institutions, translating their requirements into practical mechanical and electrical designs building on our existing technology. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, debug a radio link, inspect a wiring harness, analyse a flight log, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the software development team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution. You will not just operate systems. You will make them better.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Own the integration project: Consult with partners, clarify requirements, agree interfaces and test criteria, and drive technical decisions and milestones to a working joint system.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Design integration concepts, CAD models, electrical circuits and system integration and bring together sensors, enclosures, calibration, compute, mechanisms, power electronics, controls, networking, autonomy software, and operator workflows.

  • Validation & Fieldability Ownership: Put your system through its paces: on test stands and in the field. Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. And establish confidence in mission-readiness as the maturity is realized.

  • Create clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, drawing directly from the experts who develop core components of your system.

  • Acceptance & Testing Automation: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable and repeatable.

  • Field Deployment & End-User Interface: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters, enable end-users to succeed in their missions and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. or similar degree in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring multiple years of hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, and troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are proficient in using CAD software, creating wiring diagrams, building electromechanic prototypes and defining and executing test campaigns across hardware disciplines.

  • You are familiar with soldering, crimping, using multimeters, oscilloscopes, serial consoles, or other lab and field equipment, with at least basic experience in command line, data analysis tools and Linux usage.

  • You are proactive, hands-on and able to find effective solutions also under the constraints of field-campaigns and willing to travel and deploy across Europe.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Specific knowledge in UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight log analysis, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

  • Proficiency in PCBA and electronics circuit design and prototyping, especially targeting high-speed data interfaces and sensors

  • Experience with development on ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with networking and radio systems, including WiFi networks, LTE/5G modems, VPNs, telemetry links, antenna placement, RF interference, tactical communication links, and debugging connectivity issues in the field.

  • Experience with perception or measurement systems, camera/IMU calibration, sensor synchronization, image processing, or mission autonomy.

  • Skills interpreting sensor data, robot logs, flight logs, frequency-domain data, vibration issues, EMI issues, thermal issues, or intermittent hardware failures.

  • Experience with environmental testing such as vibration, thermal, ingress protection, EMI/EMC, or MIL-STD-style qualification workflows.

  • Experience creating acceptance tests, runbooks, troubleshooting- or training guides, fleet dashboards, release checklists, or field-support processes.

 

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Get equity early, real stock options to participate directly in SE3’s growth

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you. We are an AI-first company empowering every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge.

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

 

Our Process

  1. Intro Call (20 min): Let’s get to know each other

  2. Technical Screen (30 min): First overview of your abilities in system integration, field testing and debugging

  3. Technical Interview (45 min): We dive deeper into your hardware design skills and ability to iterate based on first principle reasoning.

  4. Onsite Trial/Case (1.5-2 hrs): We’ll integrate, diagnose, debug, or test something together, just like on the job.

  5. Team Dinner/Lunch: See if it’s a culture fit on both sides

Vacature: Marketing director (B2B SaaS/fintech) @ Snelstart

 

Voor onze opdrachtgever Snelstart ( www.snelstart.nl) in Amersfoort zoekt Sound People een marketing director die marketingstrategie, executie en teamontwikkeling verbindt. Met 180.000 gebruikers is het een van de grootste boekhoud en accountancy software platforms van Nederland Snelstart maakt ondernemen al 40+ jaar eenvoudiger met slimme software en wil uitgroeien tot de meest vooruitstrevende fintech‑partner van Nederland.  Jij krijgt mandaat om die ambitie te versnellen.

 

De rol van marketing director bij Snelstart.

·      Co-creëer de marketingstrategie met de Sales Director en directie en bewaak de realisatie.

·      Leid en coach het team (growth & automation, campagnes, product marketing, design, content).

·      Bouw een AI‑gedreven leadfunnel in HubSpot (Breeze AI), gekoppeld aan Dynamics, voor een constante stroom kwalitatieve MQL’s richting sales.

·      Vergroot het eigen leadkanaal (‘base’) en verminder afhankelijkheid van externe platformen.

·      Zet een schaalbare B2B‑contentmachine op op basis van ICP’s, persona’s en doelgroepdata.

·      Stuur campagnes op ROI; elke euro meetbaar en aantoonbaar resultaat.

·      Verhoog interne marketingkennis en verminder bureau‑afhankelijkheid; zet AI slim in.

·      Manage budget en martech‑stack; rapporteer KPI’s (leadvolume, conversie, CPL/CAC, CLV).

  

Wat biedt Snelstart jou?

 

·      Brutosalaris €7.500 – €8.500 (40 u/pw), afhankelijk van ervaring.

·      30 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur)

·      Een werkplek in de fijne kantoorruimte van SnelStart in het midden van Nederland.

·      Maandelijks vakantiegeld en pensioenbijdrage.

·      Laptop, ergonomische werkplek (zit‑sta), goede koffie/thee, fruit en noten.

·      Veel ruimte voor ontwikkeling, zingeving, veiligheid en vrijheid.

·      Een betrokken en dynamisch team.

 

Wat is de procedure?

Na een succesvolle telefonische kennismaking volgt een face to face gesprek met Sven Fremeijer. Als we beiden voldoende aanleiding zien om verder te gaan stelt Sound je voor bij SnelStart. Daar volgen 2 gesprekrondes.

De eerste gespreksronde wordt gezamenlijk gevoerd door de CCO en HR De tweede ronde zal plaatsvinden met de CCO en een externe adviseur. Als laatste een finale selectie en arbeidsvoorwaarden worden vastgesteld in afstemming met de CEO en het MT.

Slotopmerking

Deze functie is bedoeld voor een daadkrachtige verbinder die marketing discipline  met pragmatisme combineert. Als jij de marketing van SnelStart wilt professionaliseren en de organisatie wilt helpen naar een voorspelbare, succesvolle ‘marketingmachine’, dan horen we graag van je!

Neem contact op met Sound People via Sven Fremeijer (


Jouw profiel

 

·      Aantoonbare resultaten in digitale marketing op strategisch niveau (focus op wat je hebt neergezet).

·      Ervaring met het leiden/opbouwen van een marketingteam, bij voorkeur in B2B SaaS/tech.

·      Bewezen succes met leadfunnel‑bouw en marketingautomatisering.

·      Aantoonbare resultaten met product‑led growth.

·      Sterk in performance marketing (paid search/social, SEO/SEA, e‑mailautomatisering, retargeting).

·      Datagedreven, ROI‑gedreven, vertaalt inzichten naar actie.

·      Pré: HubSpot, Dynamics, Userpilot, AI in marketing (o.a. Breeze AI), B2B‑contentstrategie.

 

Qua motivatie en ambitie zoeken we iemand om marketingkennis intern op te bouwen en afhankelijkheid van bureaus te verkleinen. Die het team neerzet, begeleid en ontwikkeld. Die het ruime marketingbudget inzet en optimaliseert. Daar zit de change en de uitdaging.

 

Qua persoonlijkheid zoeken we iemand die verbinding maakt met de rest van de organisatie, die kwaliteit, energie en humor brengt; cultuur omarmt en ownership heeft. De cultuur is professioneel en no nonsens, dus we zoeken iemand die daar goed bij past.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect & Developer – Marketing Automation
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

We are seeking a deeply technical Marketing Technology Architect / Developer to lead the data architecture, custom code development, system integrations, and infrastructure scalability of our marketing engine.

Our day-to-day stack currently relies on Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) as our primary engine, and we are actively considering next-generation architecture like Marketing Cloud Next. However, for us, specific tool proficiency takes a backseat to a genuine passion for marketing technology, AI-driven marketing innovations, robust data architecture, and technical problem-solving.

We value your ability to analyze complex data models, integrate APIs, write clean code, and optimize high-throughput automation pipelines over specific certifications. If you are a platform-agnostic technologist passionate about marketing tech stack mechanics and AI marketing tools, this role provides the scope and autonomy to build world-class system infrastructure.


What you will do

Data Architecture & Engineering

  • Operations Enablement: Prepare, clean, structure, and model marketing data for Marketing Operations teams to run campaigns, segment audiences, and manage daily operations friction-free.

  • Data Modeling: Build and optimize scalable relational database structures, data extensions, custom models, and subscriber key lifecycles for operational needs.

  • ETL & Data Pipelines: Partner with the Data Team to create automated SQL queries and ETL pipelines ingesting and transforming data warehouse datasets (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery) into production-ready data extensions.

  • Governance & Hygiene: Maintain data hygiene, identity resolution, deduplication, and real-time ecosystem syncs to ensure efficiency.

    •  

    Technical Customization & Custom Development

  • Write maintainable custom platform code (e.g., AMPscript, SSJS, WSProxy) for personalization engines.

  • Develop dynamic rendering logic, interactive web forms, and secure landing pages.

  • Troubleshoot automation failures, script exceptions, and data bottlenecks.

    •  

    API & Ecosystem Integrations

  • Architect and maintain API integrations (REST, SOAP, Webhooks) connecting product apps, mobile backends, and third-party systems to the marketing platform.

  • Configure native CRM and database connectors for low-latency, real-time bidirectional sync.

  • Manage rate limits, payload efficiency, OAuth, and retry handlers.

    •  

    Platform Operations & System Health

  • Monitor runtimes, script performance, and query execution to ensure 99.9% uptime.

  • Lead security governance, permissions, business unit structuring, and privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, CAN-SPAM).

  • Partner with DevOps and IT Security on domain authentication and deliverability infrastructure.


    • Experience and qualifications

    Core Technical Competencies

  • Advanced SQL & Database Design: Extensive experience with relational data modeling, complex joins, aggregation, and query tuning.

  • Integrations & Protocols: Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, JSON/XML, OAuth 2.0, webhooks, and Postman.

  • Scripting & Code: Skilled in AMPscript, SSJS, or general languages (JavaScript, Node.js, Python) applied to MarTech.

  • MarTech & AI Curiosity: Passionate about marketing architecture, event triggers, relational mapping, agentic AI, CDPs, and automated personalization.

    •  

    Experience

  • 3+ years in technical architecture, administration, or development in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) (Automation Studio, Journey Builder, Contact Builder, CloudPages, APIs, or Data Cloud/AI frameworks).

  • Practical understanding of how Predictive, Generative, and Agentic AI transform technical marketing.

  • Proven track record of evaluating and mastering new marketing platforms and technical tools.

    •  

    Key Personality Traits

  • Tech & AI Enthusiast: Actively follows MarTech, CDPs, AI automation, and data engineering trends.

  • Platform Agnostic: Uses tools and AI models adaptively to solve data and communication challenges.

  • Problem Solver: Enjoys debugging complex data issues, race conditions, integrations, and AI logic edge cases.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

jobs.description:
Ajax Systems est une entreprise technologique internationale et le plus grand fabricant de systèmes de sécurité en Europe, comptant plus de 4,5 millions d'utilisateurs finaux et 330 000 utilisateurs PRO dans plus de 180 pays à travers le monde. L'entreprise propose des solutions complètes pour la protection des habitations et des entreprises, quelle que soit leur envergure. À ce jour, le portefeuille de produits Ajax comprend 280 dispositifs dédiés à la protection contre les intrusions, à la vidéosurveillance, à la sécurité incendie, à la protection des personnes, ainsi qu'au confort et à l'automatisation. L'entreprise compte 5 000 collaborateurs.

Nous constituons des équipes locales, convaincus que les experts du terrain sont les mieux placés pour appréhender les spécificités de chaque marché. L'entreprise est représentée commercialement dans le monde entier, notamment en Italie, en Espagne, en Allemagne, en France, au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Australie, en Afrique du Sud et dans de nombreuses autres régions.

L'équipe mondiale de Développement Commercial rassemble des collaborateurs partageant les mêmes valeurs et les ambitions d'Ajax Systems. L'alliance du meilleur logiciel et d'un matériel haute performance a définitivement transformé la perception des systèmes de sécurité, tant pour les utilisateurs que pour les professionnels du secteur. Présente dans les plus grands salons spécialisés — IFSEC, Expoprotection, Intersec — et récompensée par des prix prestigieux décernés par des médias de référence tels que PSI Magazine et GIT SECURITY, Ajax figure aujourd'hui parmi les systèmes de sécurité les plus primés d'Europe.

La production d'Ajax Systems repose sur quatre usines : deux implantées en Ukraine, une en Turquie et une au Vietnam. La certification ISO 14001 de l'entreprise garantit un impact environnemental maîtrisé tout au long du processus de fabrication. Le choix des composants entrant dans la conception des dispositifs Ajax est conditionné par la fourniture de déclarations de fabricants attestant de leur conformité aux exigences RoHS.

L'entreprise est née dans un contexte de révolution et de guerre. La résilience est donc au cœur de l'ADN de la marque, et la lutte contre le mal — par la création des meilleurs dispositifs de sécurité et d'automatisation — constitue la mission indéfectible d'Ajax.

Ajax Systems est une success-story ukrainienne, portée par une force et une énergie hors du commun.

As a Site Reliability Engineer with strong networking skills in our Cloud Infrastructure (SRE) team, you help the team own the networks that keep Loft running: cloud networking, VPN and site-to-site connectivity, segmentation, and routing across our offices, test equipment, and ground stations. You keep them reliable, observable, and secure as we scale. You coordinate with IT on the network components that interface with the physical infrastructure used by employees. You’ll work the way an SRE team works: defining reliability in measurable terms (SLOs for connectivity and ground-station availability), instrumenting the systems that prove it, managing the network as code, and automating away toil so on-call load doesn’t grow with the fleet.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

At Loft, we are convinced that space programs should not have to be rebuilt from scratch every time. Our philosophy has been to productize them: we develop our own proprietary technology blocks, hardware and software, so that a customer payload can be integrated faster and more reliably than any bespoke program allows. That approach has delivered — it is why our customers reach orbit in months rather than years, and it is what makes working here different from working in the rest of the industry.

We are now taking the next step: launching and operating our own constellations, and building a new set of services on top of them. That includes a full product suite enabling third-party AI applications to run directly onboard our satellites, and a growing ecosystem of partners whose needs we have to understand and design for. Loft is expanding at a very high pace, and the range of what we build is expanding just as fast.

This is why Product Management matters so much here. Someone has to hold the whole picture — what is technically possible, what customers actually need, what we should build first — and turn it into something engineering and leadership can act on. As a Product Manager, you will own a significant perimeter and the autonomy that goes with it. We are growing the team precisely so that each of us can go deeper on our topics, anticipate rather than react, and have more impact across the company.

You will need to be comfortable talking to anyone here. In the same week you might sit with a system engineer to understand a design constraint, join a BD call with an institutional customer, and present a recommendation to the executive team. Ideas at Loft get discussed openly and on their merits, wherever they come from, so being able to ask a naive question without ego — and to disagree with someone senior without making it personal — matters more than seniority.


About this role:
Understand what is possible, and turn it into requirements
  • Spend the bulk of your time with engineering: understanding architectures, constraints, and dependencies well enough to judge what is realistically doable in a given timeframe.
  • Translate strategic direction into clear requirements and use cases that engineering can act on directly, and follow them down to the Jira tickets.
  • Surface and shape the good ideas that come from engineering — many of the best ones do — and connect them to a product rationale.
  • Define success criteria for each capability, and verify they are actually met through implementation and delivery.
  • Maintain an accurate, shared view of Loft's product capabilities, what is in development, and where the gaps are.

    • Engage directly with the partners building on our platform, including the onboard AI application ecosystem, to understand their needs and constraints.

      • Negotiate scope and delivery commitments with engineering leadership, and re-plan when capacity or mission timelines shift.
      • Challenge, constructively and with data, business development, engineering leadership, and your own assumptions.

        • Communicate

        • Own internal communication on your perimeter: keep engineering, program leadership, and executives working from the same technical reality.
        • Develop the technical narratives and proof points that marketing and BD then turn into their own customer-facing material.
        • Prepare recommendations and presentations for top-executive-level audiences.

  • Structured and data-driven: you bring your experience and your intuitions, but when you put a recommendation on the table you can show the analysis it stands on.

  • Relentless curiosity. In a single month you might move from a satellite bus constraint, to onboard AI inference, to a defense accreditation requirement — and you need to find that stimulating rather than exhausting.

Loft’s Onboard Software group provides the on-orbit software that powers our satellite fleet — from the Linux services running on the hub processor, to the containerized workloads executing customer applications in low Earth orbit.

The Deployment & Runtime Environments team is where software meets the satellite. We own how software gets packaged, deployed, and executed onboard: from the tool that assembles and maintains mission-specific software stacks, to the Runtime Container Environment that lets partner and customer workloads run securely in orbit, to the Linux infrastructure that makes it all reliable. As more satellite programs come online and as we open our container runtime to a growing number of external workloads, the team’s scope is expanding fast.

We’re looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who digs into an unfamiliar system, maps it out, and gets it shipped without needing the path handed to them. You’ll move between Linux internals, container runtimes, and CI pipelines, sometimes in the same afternoon.

  • Develop and harden our onboard Linux infrastructure: how services are deployed on the rootfs, what system manages their execution, and how we ensure reliable and recoverable Linux operation in orbit
  • Evolve our Runtime Container Environment — the container manager and the full stack around it (base images, container registry service) — enabling partner and customer workloads to run securely onboard our vehicles
  • Support scaling of the deployment pipeline as new hardware platforms are added and the number of active satellite programs grows
  • Contribute to Product Validation — as the last step in the development pipeline, the team plays a key role in validating software readiness before it goes to orbit

MAOMAO is building one of Germany's most exciting Asian food e-commerce businesses, combining online grocery, content, community, social commerce and our own consumer brands.

With over 200,000 followers across social media, an established e-commerce business and a growing team, we're ready for our next stage of growth.

We're looking for an exceptionally driven, analytical and entrepreneurial Growth & Strategy Manager to work directly with our founders, drive marketing performance and help scale MAOMAO.

This isn't a traditional marketing role. We're looking for someone who thinks like an entrepreneur, takes ownership and has the potential to grow into a leadership position.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Growth: Identify opportunities to increase revenue, customer acquisition, conversion, average order value and customer retention.

  • Scale TikTok Shop & Social Commerce: Help grow one of our most important sales channels by improving livestream performance, affiliate partnerships, promotional strategies and conversion.

  • Own Marketing Performance: Monitor KPIs across TikTok Shop, livestreaming, social media, e-commerce and campaigns. Turn data into actionable improvements.

Who We're Looking For

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. While we have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe, this particular role is based on-site in Sunnyvale. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence! Location: This is an on-site role based in Sunnyvale, CA (required), with flexible office hours.

Responsibilities

The role will require you to join Tensordyne's Platform Software team to lead requirements gathering, design, and development of system-level services, tools, and supporting tests for Tensordyne's AI inference platform software, including debugging, profiling, and analysis capabilities. The successful candidate will support cross-functional engineering teams in the bring-up and validation of platform software on AI inference systems, and partner closely with the hardware, silicon, and validation teams to deliver robust, production-quality platform software. You will work close to the hardware on firmware and board bring-up, bootloaders and BSP development, device drivers, and Linux kernel modules, collaborating directly with the silicon and hardware teams on hardware/software co-design. The role also involves system-level performance and power optimization across the AI inference platform, working with low-level interfaces such as PCIe, I2C, SPI, and JTAG. Occasional travel (e.g., to partner, customer, or contract manufacturer sites) may be required but is not mandatory.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience developing low-level systems and embedded software, firmware, and tooling for high-performance computing systems deployed to data center customers.
  • Hands-on experience bringing up and debugging complex Linux-based systems at the kernel and driver level, including embedded Linux, device drivers, and/or RTOS environments; experience with SoC/silicon bring-up is highly desirable. Familiarity with AI inference frameworks and data center deployment/management environments is preferred.
  • Expert programming experience in C and C++, with proficiency in Python, Bash/Shell, and/or related programming languages. Rust experience is a plus. Comfortable interfacing directly with hardware, reading schematics and datasheets, and debugging with tools such as JTAG, logic analyzers, and oscilloscopes.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and comfortable working across hardware, silicon, and software teams in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Excellent technical communication skills, with the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts and practical solutions.
  • BS or MS degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.

  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together, than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each others' differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

jobs.title: Expert Site Reliability Engineer - Edge Infrastructure (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role

Orbem’s AI-powered MRI systems run on edge infrastructure deployed directly at customer sites, such as hatcheries and food processing plants. As an Expert Site Reliability Engineer, you will own the reliability, availability, and performance of this growing global fleet.

You are the team’s deepest technical authority on the on-premise platform, setting architecture and standards through hands-on expertise. You will own the hardware, network, operating system, and Kubernetes layers that power teams like Data, Machine Learning, and Software.

Your Day-to-Day

As an Individual Contributor on the expert track, your responsibilities center entirely on deep technical ownership and execution:

Edge Infrastructure Ownership

  • Own the reliability and lifecycle of our edge racks: server hardware, network equipment, custom Linux-based OS, and the GPU-enabled Kubernetes layer running our AI classification services.

  • Design and improve automation for provisioning our growing fleet (50+ edge clusters and counting) using tools like Terraform, BMC/IPMI, and router APIs.

  • Maintain the secure network connecting edge deployments to our central cloud, and the tooling that enables safe software delivery to the fleet.

Reliability & Incident Management

  • Participate in the rotation of support on weekdays and own triage and resolution for escalated production issues.

  • Lead post-incident reviews and turn findings into lasting, automated fixes.

  • Define and monitor SLOs/SLIs/SLAs for physical edge systems running unattended in the field.

  • Extend our observability stack (Prometheus, custom hardware exporters, Grafana, Datadog) to catch issues proactively, often before customers notice.

Architecture, Collaboration & Craft

  • Set technical direction for edge infrastructure projects and contribute to technical planning and ticket writing.

  • Mentor fellow engineers through pairing, design/code reviews, and knowledge sharing, raising the technical bar without formal management authority.

  • Act as the top-level technical escalation point, personally helping resolve the most complex support and production issues.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders (with the eventual support of a Product Manager) to gather requirements and manage technical alignment.

  • Automate away repetitive manual work, applying the same rigor to internal tooling as to a customer-facing product.

Your Experience and Skills

  • Container Orchestration: Super proficient in maintaining Kubernetes on edge machines.

  • Programming: Fluency in at least one modern language, such as Golang or Python.

  • Monitoring: Deep understanding of concepts and tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.

  • Terraform is a native language to you.

  • Linux & Server Expertise: Deep proficiency in Linux-based systems and experience with server hardware, including components like RAID controllers BIOS, and Booting.

  • DevOps: Good understanding of release systems and proficiency with GitOps tools like Argo CD.

  • Security Management: Proficient in security concepts like certificate management (issuing, lifecycles, etc.) and secure network tunnels (e.g., IPSec/VPN).

What Makes You Stand Out

  • Holistic Data Center Engineering Expertise: Deep understanding of how to deal with low-level hardware like routers, switches, servers, BIOS, and TPM modules .

  • Bare-Metal Automation: Proven experience designing and implementing automation for bare-metal infrastructure provisioning.

  • Modern Kubernetes & CI/CD Architect: Moves beyond basic deployments to architecting sophisticated, automated, and resilient delivery pipelines using cutting-edge GitOps and Kubernetes-native tooling.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) Mastery: Expert-level proficiency with Terraform to build version-controlled, repeatable, and scalable environments.

Behavioral competencies

  • Strategic Thinker: You develop a clear vision and roadmap for the edge platform, considering its long-term health, scalability, and usability.

  • Strong Communicator: You build strong relationships with development teams and other stakeholders, communicate changes clearly, and secure buy-in.

  • High Ownership: You take end-to-end ownership of your technical output, including reliability, documentation, and continuous improvement.

  • Data-Driven: You use metrics on uptime, incidents, and support requests to prioritize the work that delivers the most value.

  • Customer-Focused: You keep developer and end-customer experience front of mind in your planning and execution.

Fit to Our Values

  • We Own Every Challenge: we enjoy complexity and thrive under uncertainty.

  • We Strive for Better: we seize any opportunity for growth and challenge the status quo. We are constantly learning and improving.

  • We Imagine New Frontiers: we think beyond “doable” and “reasonable”. We design a sustainable and healthy future together.

What We Offer

International Environment:

  • Join a team with 40+ nationalities across 5 continents, all driven by a shared purpose: shedding light on the world’s toughest challenges.

Comprehensive Benefits:

  • Stock Options: Share in Orbem’s success.

  • Relocation Support: Seamless support for your move to Germany.

  • Learning & Development: €1,750 annual budget for personal growth.

  • Fitness Membership: Access to Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.

  • Childcare Reimbursement: Support for Kita/Kindergarten fees.

  • Deutschland Ticket: Monthly subsidy towards public transportation costs.

Work-Life Integration:

  • Flexible Hours & Home Office: Work when and where it suits you.

  • WFH Perks: Get €185 to upgrade your home office + an external monitor on us!

  • 30 Days Paid Leave: Plenty of time to recharge.

  • Personal Leave: Flexibility for life’s important moments.

  • Work From Anywhere: Experience new cultures and environments for up to 60 days per year.

Make a Difference:

Join an ambitious, fast-growing team working on breakthrough technology. In our scale-up environment, you'll have the freedom to lead your projects and make an impact. We provide a platform for you to explore, innovate, and define your vision for the future. At Orbem, we're committed to helping you discover your strengths, and while we aim to teach you, we also want to learn from you.

Your Team:

You'll become part of our diverse and international team. Learn more about the team members, their work, and challenges here: https://orbem.ai/company/

At Orbem, we're committed to building a smart, diverse team, and we recognize that self-doubt can prevent talented individuals from applying. If you feel you don't meet every requirement, we'd love to hear from you anyway!

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région du Havre.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Un salaire fixe entre 28.000 € et 34.000 € brut annuel + variable déplafonné (OTE cible : 39.000 € – 45.000 €). Ton succès, ton revenu

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence + badge télépéage

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. jobs.title: Conversion Manager - Financial Services
jobs.description:
Why This Role Exists

At Pennylane, our website plays a pivotal role in acquiring and converting customers, transforming traffic from paid acquisition, SEO, partnerships, and other channels into sign-ups, demo bookings, and product adoption.

 

As we accelerate our Financial Services offering, including pro account, and the monetization of our existing customer base, we are seeking a Conversion Manager to own conversion across these strategic areas.

 

You will lead the production and optimization of website pages and paid landing pages, from identifying friction to measuring business impact.

 

You will join the Website team within Growth and collaborate closely with Growth Engineers and Data in a multidisciplinary squad.

 

🌍 About Pennylane

Pennylane is one of France’s leading fintech unicorns, building the financial and accounting operating system for European SMEs and accounting firms.

 

Founded in 2020, we help business owners make better decisions and empower accountants to focus on advising their clients.

 

Key Figures and Ambition

  • 💻 Over 1.3 million SMEs already work with Pennylane

  • 🤝 More than 7,000 accounting firms use our platform

  • 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Over 1,100 Pennylaners from more than 25 nationalities

  • 💰 More than €400 million raised since launch

  • 🌍 Remote-friendly, international culture expanding across Europe

 

What You’ll Do

You will own conversion across the Financial Services and Monetization scope, working across website pages, paid landing pages, product journeys, experimentation, and measurement.

 

Own CRO and Experimentation

  • Define and execute the conversion strategy for key journeys, including pro account landing pages, pricing and product pages, demo-booking journeys, self-sign-up, and upsell flows

  • Build and run a continuous A/B testing program, from ideation and scoping to sizing, analysis, and ship-or-kill decisions

  • Identify conversion friction and opportunities through analytics and behavioral insights

  • Develop clear hypotheses based on user behavior, business priorities, and funnel performance

  • Ensure experiments are measured against meaningful business outcomes

 

Manage the Website Conversion Roadmap

  • Own and prioritize the conversion roadmap for your scope based on expected impact and feasibility

  • Turn opportunities into actionable briefs, specifications, and delivery plans

  • Work closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Design, and other stakeholders to ship improvements

  • Coordinate QA, launch, and post-launch analysis

  • Own key Financial Services journeys, including pro account activation and the accountant portal

  • Contribute to monetization journeys such as upsell and self-sign-up

 

Build and Optimize Paid Landing Pages

  • Produce and optimize landing pages for Financial Services and Monetization campaigns

  • Help increase the speed and volume of landing-page delivery, removing the current bottleneck

  • Partner with Demand Generation and Paid/SEA teams to translate campaign objectives into high-performing pages

  • Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, market context, and local messaging

  • Use these insights to improve both paid landing pages and the wider website experience

 

Own Measurement and Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Define instrumentation and tracking plans with Data

  • Build and maintain dashboards to monitor conversion performance

  • Report on results, learnings, and next steps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Work closely with Demand Gen, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, Design, and Engineering

  • Create alignment across teams and move projects forward without relying on formal authority

 

What You Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in CRO, Conversion, Website Product Management, Growth, or a related field

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, digital products, or another data-driven environment

  • A track record of shipping initiatives end-to-end and demonstrating their impact on business metrics

  • Strong hands-on experience with analytics and CRO tools, such as Amplitude and Contentsquare

  • Ability to independently analyse data, identify patterns, and formulate relevant hypotheses

  • Solid understanding of A/B testing methodology, including experiment sizing, success metrics, statistical pitfalls, and decision-making

  • Experience managing a roadmap and prioritizing initiatives based on impact and feasibility

  • Strong project management skills, from writing a clear brief to coordinating delivery and measuring results

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to:

    • Write clear briefs for designers and engineers

    • Explain prioritization decisions to stakeholders

    • Present results and recommendations to non-technical audiences

  • Ability to build relationships and secure alignment across multiple teams

  • Fluent French and professional English

 

🛠️ Tools and Environment

You will work with tools and processes dedicated to experimentation, analytics, behavioral analysis, tracking, and landing-page production.

 

Our Tools Include

  • Amplitude

  • Contentsquare

  • A/B testing and experimentation platforms

  • Analytics and reporting dashboards

  • Website content and landing-page production tools

 

You will collaborate closely with Growth Engineers, Data, Demand Generation, Product, Sales and Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Ownership of conversion across two strategic areas for Pennylane: Financial Services and Monetization

  • Direct and measurable impact on sign-ups, demo bookings, product activation, and upsell performance

  • The opportunity to shape the conversion roadmap across website and paid landing pages

  • A central role in structuring and scaling our experimentation program

  • Close collaboration with Growth Engineering, Data, Product, Demand Gen, Sales, Customer Success Operations, Brand, and Design

  • High level of autonomy and visibility across the organization

  • Challenging and supportive environment focused on ownership, execution, learning, and measurable impact

 

Success in This Role

Your success will be measured by:

 

  • The frequency and quality of experiments launched

  • The speed and volume of website and landing-page delivery

  • Conversion-rate improvement across the Financial Services and Monetization funnels

  • Growth in relevant outcomes, including sign-ups and demo bookings

  • Ability to absorb inbound landing-page demand without creating a delivery bottleneck

  • Quality of tracking, reporting, and learnings shared with stakeholders

 

📍 Location & Working Model

Permanent position based in Paris on a hybrid basis or fully remote anywhere in France.

 

🌈 Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

Pennylane is dedicated to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace, providing equal opportunities for all candidates, regardless of background, gender, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic.

jobs.title: Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties
jobs.description:
Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties

Ben jij een ervaren installatietechnicus die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol? Of geef je al leiding aan monteurs en wil je meer verantwoordelijkheid binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek? Dan hebben we bij Campus Installatietechniek in Barneveld een mooie uitdaging voor je! Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties combineer je jouw technische kennis met het aansturen en begeleiden van een team monteurs. Je zorgt dat werkzaamheden goed worden voorbereid, projecten volgens planning verlopen en jouw collega's hun werk optimaal kunnen uitvoeren. Je bent de verbindende schakel tussen de monteurs, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding en opdrachtgevers. Daarbij houd je overzicht, denk je mee over technische oplossingen en zorg je voor een prettige samenwerking.

Wat we je bieden

Bij Campus Installatietechniek krijg je de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, jouw team verder te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan mooie installatieprojecten. Daar staat natuurlijk iets tegenover:

  • Een goed salaris dat past bij jouw kennis, ervaring en verantwoordelijkheden;

  • Een afwisselende functie voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en vrijheid om jouw werkzaamheden te organiseren;

  • Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Afwisselende projecten binnen de utiliteitsbouw en gebouwgebonden installatietechniek;

  • Opleidingen, cursussen en doorgroeimogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Moderne middelen en gereedschappen om je werk goed uit te voeren;

  • Een informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's en korte communicatielijnen;

  • De voordelen en ontwikkelmogelijkheden van de VDK Groep, gecombineerd met de persoonlijke sfeer van Campus.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Teamleider Werktuigbouwkundige Installaties ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en coördinatie van werkzaamheden binnen verschillende installatieprojecten. Je zorgt dat jouw team weet wat er moet gebeuren en dat projecten veilig, efficiënt en volgens afspraak worden uitgevoerd.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren van monteurs en technici;

  • Coördineren en verdelen van werkzaamheden binnen werktuigbouwkundige installatieprojecten;

  • Bewaken van de planning, voortgang, kwaliteit, veiligheid en kosten;

  • Afstemmen met projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, opdrachtgevers en leveranciers;

  • Zorgen dat materialen, informatie en middelen tijdig beschikbaar zijn;

  • Meedenken over technische vraagstukken rondom klimaatinstallaties, verwarming en luchtbehandeling;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen en bijdragen aan efficiëntere werkprocessen;

  • Onderhouden van goede contacten met klanten en andere betrokken partijen.

Je staat dicht bij de techniek, maar houdt tegelijkertijd het overzicht over het grotere geheel. Dankzij jouw inzet kunnen de monteurs hun werk goed uitvoeren en worden projecten succesvol opgeleverd.


Wat neem je mee?

Je hebt een stevige technische basis binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek en vindt het leuk om collega's aan te sturen en verder te helpen. Je kunt goed organiseren, communiceert duidelijk en weet ook bij onverwachte situaties het overzicht te bewaren.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in het volgende:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding richting installatietechniek, werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar;

  • Enkele jaren werkervaring binnen de werktuigbouwkundige installatietechniek, bijvoorbeeld als Eerste Monteur, Leidinggevend Monteur of Teamleider;

  • Kennis van gebouwgebonden installaties, zoals verwarmingsinstallaties, klimaatinstallaties en luchtbehandeling;

  • Leidinggevende kwaliteiten en het vermogen om collega's te motiveren;

  • Organisatorisch inzicht en een goed gevoel voor planning en kwaliteit;

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling;

  • Een proactieve houding en het vermogen om technische en organisatorische uitdagingen op te lossen.

Heb je ruime ervaring als Eerste Monteur of Leidinggevend Monteur en ben je toe aan een volgende stap? Ook dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Waar ga je het doen?

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Make security the reason people trust Ockto

Own security at the platform people use to share their most personal data

Every day, people use Ockto to share their identity, income, assets and bank data: when they apply for a mortgage, rent a home or take out a lease. Banks and other large organisations choose Ockto partly because of the level of assurance we offer around that data. At Ockto, security is not a support function. It is part of the product and organisational culture.

As our CISO, you make sure it stays that way as we grow. Part of that growth is adopting an AI driven operating model with strong guardrails. You own Ockto's security programme, from risk and controls to incidents, suppliers and audits. You set the standard, check that it is met, and make security measurable in a way that the whole organisation (and specifically our engineers and spec leads), clients, auditors and regulators all recognise. You do this with a real mandate and short lines to the people who decide.

What you'll do

You own the information security programme of a supervised financial company and make it work in daily practice, not just on paper. As CISO, you:

  • Own Ockto's ISMS and security policy framework, and keep our ISO 27001 certification (held since 2017) and our SOC 2 assurance current and credible.

  • Translate the risk appetite set by management into a security strategy, an annual plan and clear standards that teams can build to.

  • Keep Ockto ahead of what's coming. You track developments such as eIDAS2 and the EU Digital Identity Wallet, NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and the AI Act, assess what they mean for Ockto and our clients, and translate them into our security strategy and standards in time.

  • Verify and challenge. Our engineering teams operate the technical controls; you check that they work and that findings get fixed. You approve risk acceptance for serious vulnerabilities and commission penetration tests. All control owners are challenged and prepared to show evidence and reproduce controls.

  • Lead the response to security and privacy incidents, approve notifications to regulators, and make sure root causes lead to structural fixes.

  • Manage security risk in our supply chain, from onboarding new suppliers to the annual review of critical ones, in line with DORA.

  • Make sure our continuity and recovery arrangements are tested and hold up, together with Engineering.

  • Make security measurable. We judge it by how quickly and how structurally we resolve what we find, not by counting incidents.

  • Represent Ockto's security towards clients, auditors and supervisors: from a bank's due diligence questionnaire to our external audits and contact with DNB and AFM.

  • Build a security-aware culture with an awareness programme people actually remember.

Who you work with

You report to our Product & Trust Director, who sets Ockto's trust framework and risk appetite. Within that framework, the security strategy and its execution are yours. On security matters you also have a direct line to our CEO, and you are involved early in the product and architecture decisions that shape our risk. Our Information Security Officer is part of your team and runs day-to-day control monitoring with you.

You also work closely with our Engineering Director and the value stream teams that build and run the Ockto platform. They operate the technical controls as the first line; you set the requirements, verify and challenge as the second.

Outside Ockto, you work with the security, risk and procurement teams of our clients and with our external auditors. For audits you are the first line of planning, execution and communication with the auditor(s). Together with the Product & Trust Director, you are Ockto's security contact for DNB and AFM.


What you bring

You combine depth in security with the judgement to apply it pragmatically in a scale-up. We're looking for someone who:

•     Has 8+ years of experience in information security, including at least 3 years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or similar.

•     Has run an ISMS end to end and taken an organisation through ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II audits.

•     Knows regulated financial services and works comfortably with DORA, PSD2, GDPR and supervision by DNB or AFM.

•     Has solid grounding in cloud security, preferably AWS, and enough technical understanding to challenge engineers and judge designs.

•     Thinks in risk: turns threats into priorities, and weighs security against cost and delivery speed.

•     Communicates clearly at every level, from the management team and auditors to developers and a client's security officer.

•     Is independent and principled: comfortable saying no, and good at finding the route to yes.

•     Speaks and writes English fluently; Dutch is a strong advantage.

Will be a plus:

•     CISSP, CISM, CCSP or ISO 27001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer certification.

•     Experience with privacy governance and DPIAs.

•     Experience leading incident response, including notification to regulators.

•     Experience with third-party risk management and assurance reporting such as ISAE 3402 or ISAE 3000.

•     Familiarity with digital identity, eIDAS2 and EU digital identity wallets.

•     Experience governing the safe use of AI tooling in a data-sensitive environment.

What you get

You get a role with real influence on how far clients, supervisors and consumers can trust Ockto.

•     Ownership of security at a company where assurance is one of the reasons clients choose us.

•     A real mandate: a direct line to the CEO on security matters, a voice early in product and architecture decisions, and the final word on accepting serious security risk.

•     Influence on what we build next, as Ockto grows into new markets and propositions.

•     Short lines and room to shape the security function the way it should work.

•     Experienced colleagues across product, engineering and compliance.

Ockto also offers:

•     A good salary: between €5500,- and €6800,- per month, depending on experience

•     Room and budget for personal and professional development

•     A MacBook Pro and smartphone of choice

•     Phone and travel allowance

•     Great home and remote working facilities

•     Lunch fee

•     Plenty of activities, including our annual ski trip, a 1.5-day team offsite, drinks and team outings

You'll join a team that values diversity and collaboration, in a friendly, ambitious and innovative atmosphere.


About Ockto

Ockto is the leading platform for future-proof wallet services. For more than ten years we have been taking the friction out of sharing, verifying and enriching personal data, so that organisations and people can trust each other faster, based on the right information. From our office in Naarden, a team of specialists builds data-driven customer journeys that are right the first time.

Ockto. Built for trust.


Ready to join?

Do you see yourself as our new CISO? Then apply directly. After you apply, we'll contact you within five working days to discuss the role and answer your questions.

Want to know more first? Contact us at company culture, core values and recruitment process, or our other vacancies? Take a look at ockto.recruitee.com.

Your data is safe

At Ockto, we only use your CV and motivation letter during the application process to assess your application. If we don't proceed, we keep your application data for four weeks.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage Marketing
jobs.description:
Afstudeeropdracht: Ontwerp een innovatief product voor de groei van 12Build!

Over 12Build

12Build is een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en zo de samenwerking in de bouw makkelijker en transparanter maakt. We bestaan bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds hard. We hebben meer dan 90 collega’s op kantoren in Nijverdal en Zwolle. Ons platform wordt dagelijks gebruikt in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken, en we willen heel Europa veroveren. Met zo’n snelle groei liggen er veel vragen klaar waar nog niemand goed antwoord op heeft. Daar zoeken we jou voor.

De opdracht

We geven je geen dichtgetimmerde opdracht. Je gaat samen met Ed, je begeleider vanuit 12Build, uitzoeken welke uitdaging het beste past bij jouw opleiding en interesses. Het eindresultaat ligt wel vast: je levert een innovatief product op dat 12Build echt kan gebruiken. Dat kan een concept zijn, een tool, een strategie, een prototype of een nieuw proces, zolang het werkt en waarde oplevert.

Ontwerpvraag (startpunt):

Welk innovatief product kan 12Build ontwikkelen om sneller en slimmer te groeien in de internationale markt, en hoe ziet dat product eruit Samen maak je deze vraag in de eerste weken concreet. Mogelijke richtingen:

• AI en kennisdeling: hoe zetten we AI in om klanten en gebruikers te helpen, bijvoorbeeld met cursussen of leercontent in de 12Build Academy?.

• Groei en leadgeneratie: hoe trekken we meer nieuwe klanten aan en volgen we leads slimmer op, bijvoorbeeld met lead scoring of automatisering?.

• Self-service: hoe zorgen we dat gebruikers zelf de weg vinden op het platform en sneller een betalend account nemen?.

• Internationale groei: hoe pakken we een nieuwe markt aan en wat werkt in Nederland wel of juist niet in Duitsland of Denemarken?.

• Klantbeleving en data: hoe halen we meer uit klantdata, reviews en feedback om onze dienstverlening te verbeteren?.

• Jouw eigen idee: zie je een kans die hier niet tussen staat? Dan horen we dat graag..

Wat lever je op?

• Een onderzoek naar het probleem en de kansen, met input van collega’s, klanten of de markt;.

• Een uitgewerkt en getest product, concept of prototype;.

• Een advies over hoe 12Build het product kan invoeren, zodat het na je stage gewoon verder gebruikt wordt..

Maud over haar stage bij 12Build:

“12Build is voor mij een plek waar ik mezelf kan en mag ontwikkelen. Ik voel me vanaf het eerste moment welkom in een super leuk team. Er is fijne begeleiding, ruimte om vragen te stellen en feedback te geven/ontvangen. De kernwaarden Happiness, Openness en Drive voel je als je hier binnen stapt.”

Wie is 12Build?
12Build in het kort: Met een flinke portie Drive, Happiness en Openness bouwen wij aan een transparante bouwbranche. Wij zijn een SaaS platform dat bouwbedrijven verbindt en zo de samenwerking bevordert. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en groeien nog steeds. Inmiddels zijn we met meer dan 90 collega’s, verdeeld over 2 kantoren (Nijverdal en Zwolle). Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software op dagelijkse basis. En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren.


Wie zoeken we?

• Een hbo- of wo-student die gaat afstuderen in bijvoorbeeld marketing, bedrijfskunde, commerciële economie, business innovation, communicatie, AI of een vergelijkbare studie;.

• Iemand die zelf ideeën aandraagt en het leuk vindt om iets nieuws neer te zetten;.

• Iemand die beschikbaar is vanaf februari 2027, voor de duur van je afstudeerperiode;.

• Iemand die Nederlands spreekt. Duits of Engels is een pluspunt..

Wat bieden we?

• Een stagevergoeding;.

• Een eigen opdracht met echte impact in een internationaal en snelgroeiend bedrijf;.

• Begeleiding door een ervaren collega en een team van zeven marketeers;.

• Een platte organisatie waarin jouw ideeën gehoord worden;.

• Thuis en op kantoor werken, een relaxruimte met pooltafel, tafeltennis en FIFA, en geregeld uitjes en teamdagen..

jobs.title: Product Manager – Operations Systems (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Ready to become part of the most important mission on this planet?

We are rebuy, pioneers in the sustainable reuse of electronics and media, and we are looking for you! Our mission: to make circular living accessible to all, one transaction at a time. By giving products a second chance, we reduce resource consumption and avoid unnecessary e-waste.

Our global team of 500 drives things forward collaboratively, takes personal responsibility, values constructive critical thinking, and is dedicated to serving our customers and planet.

The Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product team and own the internal, backend-heavy products behind our operations.

Every item rebuy sells has been through our hands. Before a pre-owned book, DVD, or game reaches a customer, it has been bought in, received, identified, tested, graded, stored, picked, packed, and shipped. The systems that run this flow are the focus of this team, and the users are the hundreds of colleagues in our operations teams.


You will own the tools and services behind inbound processing, grading and quality control, fulfillment, and returns. Your users are warehouse operators, graders, pickers, and operations leads. Your customers are, in the end, every rebuy buyer and seller who relies on the condition and delivery promise we make.

For this role we need someone who is genuinely detail-oriented, who reads the data before forming an opinion, who understands systems and data flows end-to-end, and who can translate operational reality into precise requirements and measurable outcomes.

As a Product Manager you work hand in hand with operations leadership, team leads, engineering, and data to deliver measurable efficiency and quality improvements. You will spend time on the floor with the people who use your products, translate their goals and constraints into a roadmap you own, build the business case with unit economics together with operations and finance, and negotiate scope and timing with engineering. Improvements are co-created with the people who run the operation, not handed to them.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive domain product roadmap: Translate ops strategy (throughput, unit cost, quality, lead time) into a 6–12 month roadmap with the Strategy Manager and Ops Product Lead. Make and document trade-off decisions with ops leaders

  • Understand operational reality: Spend time at the warehouse mapping processes and data flows end-to-end to uncover system gaps and unmet needs early

  • Drive data-backed decisions: Analyze KPIs, pull data, avoid measurement traps, and connect feature changes to unit economics improvements

  • Write precise requirements: Specify business rules, edge cases, data models, state transitions, integrations, and failure modes for engineering

  • Ship iteratively without disruption: Sequence releases safely using pilots, feature flags, parallel runs, change management, and pre-defined metrics

  • Collaborate across teams: Engage in technical discussions and manage scope, time, and urgency trade-offs with tech and ops leads

  • Build stakeholder buy-in: Align ops, CS, tech, finance, and leadership on shared metrics via clear written communication


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in product management, with a focus on backend, internal, workflow, or operational products (for example warehouse, logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, order management, inventory, marketplace operations, fintech back-office, or similar)

  • Hands-on data skills: you can work fluently in an analytics environment, build your own analyses, define metrics rigorously, and spot when a number is misleading

  • Strong attention to detail: experience writing precise specifications covering business rules, edge cases, data models, and failure modes, and catching problems before they reach production

  • Systems thinking: you can map a multi-step operational process and the data flowing through it, identify bottlenecks and inconsistencies, and reason about second-order effects of a change

  • Experience collaborating with engineering on technical decisions, including integrations and data migrations, and negotiating scope and time-to-market trade-offs

  • Clear, structured communication skills, written and verbal, with the ability to build buy-in with operations team leads, engineering, and product leadership

  • Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot) to accelerate daily work such as analysis, writing, and prototyping

  • Fluency in English and German

Location:

  • Berlin

  • Hybrid model (Must be willing to have regular presence at our operations sites located in Rudow)


Purpose, a great company culture and incredible benefits - what to expect at rebuy:

  • Work with a friendly team that is passionate about circularity and wants to make the world a little more sustainable, one transaction at a time.

  • Feel comfortable in an environment where independence and new ideas are welcome.

  • Benefit from flat hierarchies and the greatest possible transparency so that things don't take longer than they have to and you always feel well informed.

  • Use employee discounts on rebuy.de, sustainable products at Futurebens, offers for sustainable micro-mobility and massages directly in our office.

  • Have fun at our legendary team and company events.
