jobs.title: Afstuderen: Integratie van machine data voor resourceplanning
jobs.description:
WAT GA JE DOEN?

Bij onze internationale klanten wordt voor de dagelijkse productie gebruikgemaakt van verschillende LogicSteel software applicaties. LogicSteel MRP ondersteunt hierbij operationele processen, zoals het plannen van productie, het beheren van projecten, inkooporders en het aansturen van medewerkers. Daarnaast zijn er systemen zoals Insights die machine- en prestatiegegevens inzichtelijk maken. Doordat informatie verdeeld is over meerdere applicaties, ontbreekt vaak één centraal overzicht voor resourceplanning en capaciteitsbeslissingen.

Tijdens deze afstudeeropdracht onderzoek je hoe relevante gegevens uit deze systemen beter gecombineerd en gepresenteerd kunnen worden, zodat gebruikers sneller de juiste inzichten hebben voor het plannen van mensen, machines en productiecapaciteit.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het analyseren van het huidige resourceallocatieproces en de rol van machine- en productiegegevens hierin;

  • Het voeren van interviews met gebruikers om hun doelen, behoeften en knelpunten in kaart te brengen;

  • Het onderzoeken welke data uit Insights en MRP relevant is voor besluitvorming;

  • Het analyseren van gebruikersstromen, beschikbare data en bestaande schermen;

  • Het ontwikkelen van wireframes, gebruikersflows en ontwerpconcepten;

  • Het valideren en verbeteren van ontwerpen door middel van feedbacksessies met gebruikers en stakeholders;

  • Het vertalen van gebruikersbehoeften naar functionele requirements;

  • Het opstellen van een advies voor de integratie en presentatie van machinegegevens over verschillende platformen.

Het eindresultaat is een onderbouwd ontwerp- en implementatievoorstel waarmee gebruikers sneller en beter onderbouwde beslissingen kunnen nemen op het gebied van resourceplanning en machinebezetting.


WIJ VRAGEN

  • HBO- of WO-opleiding in de richting van UI/UX Design, Human Computer Interaction, Interaction Technology of vergelijkbaar.

WIJ BIEDEN

  • Een vergoeding: €600,- per maand;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding: zodat jij geen onnodige kosten maakt;

  • Apparatuur en materialen: bijvoorbeeld een laptop, speciaal gereedschap of software;

  • Ervaren coach: goede begeleiding is belangrijk en dus krijg je een vaste coach om je te ondersteunen;

  • Ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Over Voortman

Wat in 1968 begon in een kippenschuur in Rijssen, is uitgegroeid tot wereldspeler in CNC-staalbewerkingsmachines. Met een team van meer dan 750 collega’s wereldwijd ontwikkelen en bouwen we niet alleen high-end machines, maar ook slimme software en service waarop klanten kunnen vertrouwen. Deze 3 krachtige bouwstenen maken ons Twentse, internationale familiebedrijf uniek.

jobs.title: Vil du være vår resepsjonist i vinter?
jobs.description:
Resepsjonist -- Vintersesongen 2027

Lillehammer Fjellstue & Hytteutleie -- Nordseter

Vi søker en serviceinnstilt og positiv resepsjonist som ønsker å være en del av vårt serviceteam i vintersesongen. Stillingen gjelder fra ca. 20 desember januar til ca. 15 april , med en stillingsprosent på 80-100 % (4-5 dager per uke). Arbeidsliste tilpasses i samarbeid med resepsjonsteamet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en person som trives med menneskelig kontakt og liker å skape gode opplevelser for andre. Du er blid, imøtekommende og profesjonell -- både i møte med gjester og kollegaer. Du jobber godt selvstendig, men er også en lagspiller som bidrar til et hyggelig arbeidsmiljø. Du må ha tilgang på egen bil, da bussforbindelser til Nordseter ikke samsvarer med arbeidstider.

Vi ser gjerne at du:

  • Er ansvarsfull, ryddig og evner å holde oversikt -- selv i travle perioder.

  • Kommuniserer godt på norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk , samt engelsk.

  • Har erfaring med resepsjonsarbeid eller kundebehandling.

  • Behersker flere språk -- det er en stor fordel, da vi har mange internasjonale gjester.

  • Kjenner litt til Lillehammerområdet, eller er interessert i å lære, slik at du kan gi gode tips til gjestene våre.

  • Er fylt 20 år (pga. skjenkerettigheter i resepsjonsbaren).

Erfaring med Visbook er et pluss, men ikke et krav -- vi gir deg god opplæring i våre rutiner.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Som resepsjonist hos oss vil du blant annet:

  • Ha ansvar for inn- og utsjekk av gjester

  • Besvare telefon og e-poster

  • Håndtere booking og reservasjoner

  • Gi turistinformasjon, tips og anbefalinger

  • Bidra til god gjestehåndtering og trivsel

  • Håndtere betaling og kasseoppgjør

  • Sørge for at våre gjesters opphold blir så bra som mulig

Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?

Lillehammer Fjellstue og Hytteutleie er en familieeid virksomhet der vi legger stor vekt på varme, nærhet og gode opplevelser. Du blir en del av et engasjert team og får jobbe i vakre omgivelser på Nordseter -- midt i Lillehammerfjellet.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Les gjerne mer om oss på vår nettside.

Send en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om deg selv, sammen med CV og referanser, til jobs@lillehammerfjellstue.no.

Fortell oss gjerne hvorfor akkurat du er den rette for vårt resepsjonsteam!

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Om oss

Lillehammer Fjellstue ligger bare 15 minutter fra Lillehammer sentrum, omgitt av vakker natur med turstier og sykkelruter rett utenfor døren. Vi tilbyr overnatting i hytter, leiligheter og hotellrom, og har en tilhørende restaurant på stedet.

I vintersesongen har vi mange internasjonale gjester på besøk som ønsker å gå på ski i det store løypenettet i Lillehammerfjellet.

Hos oss jobber et trivelig og internasjonalt team som er opptatt av å skape en god hverdag - både for hverandre og for våre gjester. Dette er et perfekt sted å jobbe for deg som er glad i natur og et aktivt friluftsliv.

Lillehammer Fjellstue eies og drives av en familie som har lange røtter på Nordseter og som ønsker å se på alle medarbeidere som en utvidet del av fjellstuefamilien.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant / Manager - Payments Operations (Banking, PI & EMI) (m/f)
jobs.description: Job Title:  Senior Consultant / Manager - Payments Operations (Banking, PI & EMI) Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting Job Function:  Consulting Services Level of Experience:  Experienced Contract Type:  Open-term Req ID:  14249 Job Description:  Your future teamThe payments landscape is undergoing its deepest transformation in a decade. The Instant Payments Regulation, Verification of Payee, PSD3/PSR, DORA and the evolving safeguarding expectations of the CSSF are reshaping how banks, Payment Institutions and E-Money Institutions run their payments operations.To answer the growing demand from our clients, the Banking Consulting department is strengthening its Payments team. We are looking for a Senior Consultant or Manager with strong operational payments expertise. You will join a team recognised on the Luxembourg market and connected to Deloitte's Global Payments network. You will help banks, PIs and EMIs design, run and improve their payments operations.The advantages of joining us• Strategy meets execution - every day. This role uniquely bridges high-level strategic transformation advisory and hands-on transformation delivery.• Depth in Banking, breath of topics.You will work across the full spectrum of banking transformation, helping clients design scalable, client-centric operating models and new value propositions.• Real ownership, real impact.As a Manager, you will take meaningful ownership of workstreams, client relationships, and team development from day one, directly driving outcomes for both clients and the practice.Your contribution to our success• Assess and redesign payments operating models (Target Operating Models, process flows, roles and responsibilities, outsourcing set-ups)• Lead or contribute to operational readiness for regulatory change: Instant Payments, Verification of Payee, PSD3/PSR, safeguarding• Review and optimise payments back-office processes: payment processing, investigations and exceptions, returns and recalls, reconciliations, safeguarding, cut-off and liquidity management• Design and strengthen the operational control framework, KPIs/KRIs and first-line controls, including fraud• Act as the business bridge between operations, compliance and IT teams on payments transformation programmes, without leading the technical implementation• Manage engagements and client relationships: scoping, staffing, delivery quality and budget follow-up• Contribute to business development: proposals, client meetings, market eminence and thought leadership• Coach and develop junior team members•  Your skills• 4-6 years of experience, in payments operations within a bank, a PI/EMI, a payment service provider or a consulting firm• Strong knowledge of payments operations: SEPA SCT/SDD, SCT Inst, cross-border payments, cards, e-money issuance and wallets• Good understanding of the regulatory framework: PSD2 and PSD3/PSR, EMD2, Instant Payments Regulation, AMLD, DORA, as well as the CSSF framework applicable to PIs and EMIs• Hands-on experience in process redesign, operating model definition, controls and outsourcing• Familiarity with market infrastructures and schemes (TARGET2/T2, STEP2, SWIFT, EPC rulebooks) is a strong asset• Business-oriented profile: this role focuses on operations and processes, not on IT development or system implementation• Strong analytical, structuring and communication skills, with the ability to engage with COOs, Heads of Operations and Compliance• Fluent in English and French; German is an assetInterested? Please submit your resume in EnglishGet to know more about Deloitte; LinkedIn page (#DeloitteLU), Instagram page, YouTube page or website.With more than 2,600 employees and 98 nationalities, Deloitte Luxembourg is one of the Grand Duchy's largest, strongest and oldest professional services firms. For 75 years, our talented teams have been serving clients in various industries delivering high added-value offerings to national and international clients in audit and assurance, consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and related services. Deloitte Luxembourg is part of the global Deloitte network.

jobs.description: Shape Exceptional Buildings, Take Ownership & Grow With UsFull-Time / Half-Time Position (Part-Time Applicants Welcome)  |  Walferdange, Luxembourg  |  On-siteAbout the OpportunityWe are a growing company specialising in the renovation and development of high-quality buildings, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern construction techniques. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Architect who enjoys taking responsibility for a project as a whole—from design development and building permits through execution drawings, tendering, site supervision and final handover.About UsAt Xtend, we restore and develop exceptional historic buildings in Luxembourg. We combine traditional craftsmanship, real estate development and entrepreneurial thinking to create unique projects with long-term value. We work on some of Luxembourg's most remarkable historic and architectural projects, combining traditional building techniques with modern real estate development.Every project is different. Every project matters. Have a look at our website to get a feel for what we do: www.xtend.lu.What You're Looking ForYou want more than a drawing-office position: you are looking for meaningful responsibility, varied projects and the satisfaction of seeing your work built.A meaningful role with responsibility for complete projects, not just isolated design tasksThe opportunity to work on distinctive historic buildings and demanding technical challengesA small, committed team where your decisions and expertise make a visible differenceClose collaboration on design, with genuine autonomy in technical development and deliveryLong-term professional growth as the company developsWhat You'll DoAs Project Architect, you will be trusted to translate design ideas into technically sound, well-documented and successfully completed projects. jobs.description: Senior Supply Chain Expert, Amazon Vendor ServicesJob ID: 10580075 | Amazon EU SarlDescriptionAmazon Vendor Services is a paid business-to-business service that helps strategic brands partner with Amazon to grow their business. As a Senior Supply Chain Expert, you independently own the complete, end-to-end supply chain for a portfolio of complex brands at a Pan-European level - from their long-term, three-year plan through to day-to-day availability, inventory health and profitability. You act as a trusted consultant, balancing service, cost and profitability across the full supply chain, and you set and own the success metrics you work on daily, ensuring every brand's experience demonstrates our customer obsession.You work at project and program level and handle difficult, ambiguous situations with limited direction. You drive alignment across multiple internal and external stakeholders - the brand, retail, operations and finance - to implement new supply chain solutions and structurally improve the ways of working around you as you develop toward the next step in your career.Key job responsibilities- Supply chain strategy & design (Strategic): Independently own and drive the long-term, three-year supply chain strategy for a portfolio of complex brands - a business solution you take from strategy through to implementation on your own initiative. You design the right mix of solutions for each brand, weighing availability, speed, cost and profitability together rather than optimising one link in isolation, align demand and network strategy with the brand's growth ambitions and Amazon's, and secure stakeholder commitment to the plan.- Implementing new supply chain solutions (High-judgment delivery): Independently lead the onboarding and roll-out of new supply chain solutions in ambiguous, non-standard situations where the path is not defined. You exercise high judgment, drive timely decisions, and align and unblock stakeholders across the brand, operations, finance and internal teams to get solutions live and adopted.- Profitability, buying & inventory health (Analysis & action): Keep the brand's supply chain healthy and profitable day to day - availability, stock positioning, lead times, cost to serve and margin. You put artificial intelligence and advanced analytics to work to accelerate your analysis, surface where profitability or service is slipping, and automate the way you work - then act on the underlying cause across the full supply chain, not just the symptom in front of you.- Performance management & communication (Impact at scale): Own the performance of your brands against their plan and be the voice of that story - writing crisp narratives and leading the business reviews that set the agenda, align senior internal and external stakeholders, and drive the decisions that close performance gaps before they surface.- Programs & team direction (Scope beyond your portfolio): Lead cross-cutting projects that extend well beyond your own brands. You identify where the biggest opportunities sit, define and deliver solutions that program teams adopt and scale across the organisation, and influence the direction and priorities of the wider team. You design the metrics we are measured by, challenge whether they capture the outcomes that matter, and set the standard - eliminating broken processes and establishing the mechanisms others build on.A day in the lifeThis role requires managing long-term strategy and day-to-day priorities at the same time, and judging which needs your attention first. In a single day you may move from a three-year strategy discussion with a brand to a time-sensitive decision on a supply disruption where the data is incomplete. The problems are rarely pre-defined, so you decide what matters most, where the opportunity is, and what to set aside. Alongside your brands, you manage projects that define the team's strategy and direction and set how we work with program teams. The variables are interdependent and the trade-offs are real, with no fixed process for the most difficult decisions. You are expected to work through that ambiguity independently and are trusted to act. Beyond the core job, you will work in a diverse, international team, have the freedom to build your own tools, learn from experienced mentors, and take up learning opportunities that grow your skills well beyond your day-to-day scope.About the teamWe are a Pan-European team of Supply Chain Experts who partner directly with strategic brands to grow their business with Amazon. You will build your network at a European level through community events, team activities and affinity groups, and grow with a clear path toward owning bigger, more strategic scope. jobs.description: Sr Manager, EU Next Day Speed , EU Speed and Service ProgramsJob ID: 10579605 | Amazon EU SarlDescription**THIS ROLE CAN BE BASED IN LUXEMBOURG, LONDON, MUNICH, PARIS, MILAN, MADRID, BERLIN, BARCELONA**Have you ever ordered a product on Amazon and wondered how it got delivered to you so fast, and what systems and processes power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.The EU Speed team is part of EU Supply Chain, Transportation Planning & Operational Excellence (STEP) organisation, which optimises the EU end-to-end transportation and transfer network.Our mission: offer the right speed, for the right customer, on the right selection, in the most cost-efficient manner.• Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion.• We improve customer experience through continuously optimising the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.• We tackle Amazon's most complex problems, processes, and decisions. We work with fulfilment centers, transportation capacity, topology, connectivity, DEA, finance, and retail teams across EU to improve our logistic infrastructure and algorithms.• We are obsessed with rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day.Key job responsibilitiesWe are seeking a Sr. Manager to own the end-to-end strategy, execution, and performance of 1D+ Speed across EU5 and EXP8 markets. This is high-visibility leadership role accountable for speed outcomes that impact day to day our customers.Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where customers come to get goods delivered next-day. This role is the senior leader who makes that happen. You will own end-to-end Next Day speed to improve customer experience across EU markets. The problem space is broad, the opportunity is not fully defined, and the strategy is yours to set. This is a people manager role: you will lead a team of Program managers and Analyst, while personally driving the multi-year vision and roadmap for Next Day speed improvement. You will distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and cross-functional stakeholders to design and drive the right long-term solution. You will own the Speed metric for 1D and 2D Speed, setting targets, identifying structural headwinds and tailwinds, and driving the cross-functional mechanisms required to close gaps at country and EU level. You deliver with independence and high judgment, distinguishing between one-way and two-way doors to move fast where appropriate and exercise caution where the stakes demand it.A day in the lifeThis role requires you to:• Set the vision and own the strategy for Next Day Speed: The problem, opportunity, and strategy are often not predefined: you identify them, frame them, and drive the organization toward the right outcome. You own Next Day Glance View Speed and are accountable for translating strategic ambiguity into a clear, executable plan.• Lead across significantly complex, persistent programs: Own a portfolio of speed initiatives spanning multiple orgs and countries. Handle significantly complex problems, decisions, and escalations where the methodology, requirements, customer needs, and technical feasibility may not be defined. Deconstruct risks into appropriate simplicity and make trade-offs between opportunity, resources, and sustainability.• Drive organisational influence at scale: Influence team priorities and business strategy across STEP Operations, Transportation, Network Design, Finance, Stores, and country-level operations. Partner at Director/VP level to align capacity, investment, and operational priorities with speed targets. You effectively force-multiply by working across your org to shape priorities and goals through data-driven contributions.• Build and lead mechanisms for operational excellence: create scalable mechanisms and best practices, and educate others on them. Actively remove bottlenecks and set the standard for process improvement.• Communicate at the highest level: Author high-quality narratives that distill complex operational data into clear, actionable insights. You are trusted to present decisions to leaders two levels above you. You ask the hard questions, decompose significantly complex problems into straightforward solutions, build consensus, and align teams toward coherent strategies across locales, roles, and functions.• Build and develop future leaders (people manager): Hire, mentor, and grow a team of program managers and analysts. Develop future leaders and participate actively in the recruitment process. Lead by example, encouraging positive and constructive feedback in doc reviews, peer reviews, and cross-team evaluations.• Innovate and simplify: Identify structural opportunities to improve speed at lower cost. Challenge existing assumptions, propose new approaches, and build scalable mechanisms that reduce manual effort and increase speed predictability. You acquire new knowledge and skills as needed to solve problems that do not have established playbooks.About the teamThis role demands two mindsets that set exceptional leaders apart:• Grit: You have a clear goal and the relentless ability to move toward it despite roadblocks and challenges. When a speed target is at risk, you do not wait for conditions to improve: you find the path, rally the teams, and deliver the outcome.• Lateral thinking: You challenge the status quo, think out of the box, and adopt a diverse and often bold approach to problem solving. You are the visible, vocal owner of >1D speed.Your work is strategic, and you are the primary owner. You do not wait for problems to be handed to you: you identify them, frame the right question, and drive the organization to the answer. Basic Qualifications- Bachelor's degree in Business, Logistics, Business Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field- Experience leading and interacting with cross-functional teams- Experience managing large data sets and utilizing to drive performance and process improvements- Experience in stakeholder and communication managementPreferred Qualifications- Master's degree

jobs.title: Spezialist (w/m/d) Depotprozesse - Schwerpunkt FVV-Plattform
jobs.description: Wählen Sie aus, wie oft (in Tagen) Sie eine Benachrichtigung erhalten möchten: Spezialist (w/m/d) Depotprozesse - Schwerpunkt FVV-Plattform Besetzung zum: 01.01.2027Zuständige Ansprechperson für die Position: Ximena Kornblueh (recruiting@deka.de) Wir sind die DekaBank – das Wertpapierhaus der Sparkassen und einer der größten Fondsanbieter Deutschlands. Unsere Niederlassung in Luxemburg übernimmt innerhalb der Deka-Gruppe zahlreiche zentrale Aufgaben: Sie betreut Vermögensverwaltungsprodukte, verantwortet das Emissionsgeschäft eigener Fonds und agiert als Verwahrstelle für in Luxemburg aufgelegte Deka-Investmentfonds. Damit leisten wir einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Wertschöpfungskette der Unternehmensgruppe. An unserem Standort sind Zentralfunktionen wie IT, Finanzen, Compliance und HR tätig, die lokale Geschäftsaktivitäten unterstützen, aber auch Dienstleistungen für andere Standorte übernehmen. Außerdem nimmt die Niederlassung operative und administrative Aufgaben für weitere Gesellschaften der Deka-Gruppe in Luxemburg wahr. Dich interessiert eine standortübergreifende Zusammenarbeit zur Weiterentwicklung der modernen FVV-Plattform mit viel Handlungsspielraum und Zukunftsperspektive? Wir suchen motivierte und innovative Teamplayer, die sich für eine spannende Position als universeller Spezialist für die FVV (Fondsvermögensverwaltung) begeistern können. Gestalte mit uns die Finanzwelt von morgen! Wenn Du Teil eines engagierten Teams in einem internationalen Umfeld werden möchten, freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Dich erwartet: • "Run the Bank" / Prozesssicherheit: Du erstellst den reibungslosen Ablauf aller Prozesse rund um die FVV-Plattform sicher.• Deka-Connect+: Du wirkst an operativen Korrekturen rund um das Produkt Deka-Connect+ mit.• Weiterentwicklung der FVV-Plattform: Du arbeitest an der Weiterentwicklung der FVV-Plattform mit und fokussierst Dich auf Prozesse bei der Produktneuerungen sowie IT-Anpassungen.• Fachliche Kommunikation: Du unterstützt die interne Kommunikation sowie den Austausch mit Sparkassen zu prozessualen Neuerungen der FVV-Plattform und Besonderheiten des Produkts Deka-Connect+. Du bringst mit: • Abgeschlossene Bankausbildung: idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Zusatzqualifikation, z. B. als Bank-/Sparkassenfachwirt:in oder Betriebswirt:in, alternativ ein Studium der Betriebswirtschaftslehre oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation• Praktische Erfahrung im Fondsgeschäft, Kenntnisse im Bereich Vermögensverwaltung sind von Vorteil• Interesse an der Produktpalette und der Funktionsweise der Fondsbasierten Vermögensverwaltung sowie den dazugehörigen Geschäftsprozessen• Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office, insbesondere sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse• Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie eine offene, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise• Analytisches Denkvermögen, Prozess- und Gestaltungsaffinität und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, mindestens auf Niveau C1  Hier ein Einblick in das Arbeiten bei der DekaBank in Luxemburg: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AJZMzki9cvg Uns ist wichtig, dass alle die gleichen Chancen bei der Deka haben. Wir sind davon überzeugt, dass die Vielfalt unserer Mitarbeitenden und eine inklusive Unternehmenskultur Perspektiven erweitern, Innovationskraft und Kreativität fördern und dazu beitragen, die besten Lösungen für unseren Kundenkreis zu finden. Deshalb fördern wir Diversität und freuen uns über jede Bewerbung – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt? Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Onlinebewerbung! Bei Rückfragen steht Ihnen unser Recruiting-Team unter Personalgewinnung@deka.lu  gerne zur Verfügung. Bitte beachten Sie, dass wir aus datenschutzrechtlichen Gründen keine Bewerbungen oder zusätzlichen Unterlagen per Post oder Mail annehmen dürfen. Vielen Dank für Ihr Verständnis. Im Falle einer Einstellung werden wir Sie um die Vorlage eines aktuellen polizeilichen Führungszeugnisses bitten.Standort der Stelle:  Luxemburg

jobs.title: Werkstudent Videoschnitt und Content Marketing (m/w/d) mit Übernahmeperspektive
jobs.description:
Schneide Content, der Kanzleien sichtbar macht. Und wachse danach mit uns weiter.

Kanzlei Brands unterstützt Kanzleien in ganz Deutschland bei der Gewinnung von Fachkräften, der Positionierung als Arbeitgeber und der Mandantengewinnung. Dafür entstehen bei uns jede Woche Videos, Social-Media-Posts, Anzeigen und Reports.

Wir suchen Dich als Werkstudent, der Videos schneiden kann und ein Gefühl für gute Inhalte hat.

Diese Stelle ist auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit ausgelegt:
Wenn es passt, übernehmen wir Dich nach Deinem Studium in eine Festanstellung im Content- und Performance-Marketing.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du schneidest Videos aus unseren Dreh- und Foto-Tagen, für unsere Kunden und für Kanzlei Brands.

  • Du erstellst Reels, Carousels und Anzeigen-Creatives in mehreren Varianten.

  • Du unterstützt uns bei Reports, Leadmagneten und Direktmailings mit Grafik und Layout.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Marketing und unserer Social-Media-Betreuung zusammen.


Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Übernahmeperspektive: Nach Deinem Studium ist eine Festanstellung bei uns ausdrücklich das Ziel.

  • Flexible Zeiteinteilung: Deine Arbeitszeiten passen wir an Vorlesungen und Prüfungsphasen an.

  • Echte Projekte: Deine Arbeit geht live, bei Kunden und in unseren eigenen Kampagnen.

  • Weiterbildung: Unser digitales Schulungssystem und regelmäßige Trainings bringen Dich weiter.

  • Gute Arbeitsmittel: Hochwertige Ausstattung, aktuelle Apple-Geräte und höhenverstellbare Schreibtische.

  • Zentraler Standort: Modernes Büro in der Hamburger Mönckebergstraße.

  • Wertschätzendes Team: Wir erreichen Ziele gemeinsam und feiern unsere Erfolge.

  • Gründliche Einarbeitung: Mit klaren Prozessen, Checklisten und digitalen Schulungen.



Dein Profil

  • Du bist eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation, Design oder Marketing.

  • Du arbeitest sicher mit Premiere Pro, CapCut oder DaVinci Resolve sowie mit Canva oder Adobe.

  • Du hast ein Gefühl für Social-Media-Formate, Tempo und starke Einstiege.

  • Du hast ein Portfolio oder Arbeitsproben, die Du uns zeigen kannst.

  • Du bist zuverlässig und übernimmst gern Verantwortung.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch.

jobs.title: Meriteringstandläkare Pedodonti, Uddevalla
jobs.description: I Folktandvården Västra Götaland bidrar du till jämlik hälsa och livskvalitet för alla människor i alla livets stunder. Här möter du en kultur präglad av samarbete, engagemang och glädje och har tillgång till modern teknik och experter inom alla områden. Det finns alltid någon att lära av och många att trivas med. Vi erbjuder stabiliteten för en trygg vardag och möjligheter att växa under hela ditt fortsatta yrkesliv.Bli en del av något större. Välkommen till Folktandvården!BeskrivningInom Pedodonti arbetar med tandvård på barn och ungdomar som av olika skäl har svårigheter att kunna få detta genomfört inom allmäntandvården. Vi arbetar med allt från tillitsträning och strukturerad inskolning och, vid behov med stöd av sedering (midazolam och/eller lustgas), till behandling under generell anestesi.Då vi har ett stort inflöde av patienter finns ett stort behov av en meriteringstandläkare till oss på Specialistkliniken för Pedodonti Uddevalla.Tjänsten innefattar kliniskt arbete på kliniken men också under generell anestesi (narkos) på Uddevalla sjukhus.Vi erbjuder handledning vid introduktion av nya moment så att du som meriteringstandläkare kan känna dig trygg i din roll.Meriteringstjänsten pågår under 6-12 månader. Omfattning och tillträde av tjänsten kan diskuteras och variera över tid utifrån individens möjligheter i relation till annan sysselsättning samt enligt överenskommelse utifrån verksamhetens behov. Önskvärt vore ca 40-50% inom Pedodonti.Kvalifikationer Allmäntandläkare- gärna med erfarenhet inom yrket.Förmåga att genom ett gott bemötande etablera förtroende och skapa tillit hos såväl våra unga patienter som hos deras vårdnadshavare/medföljare.Intresse av tandvård för barn och ungdomar med särskilda behov.Förmåga/lära sig att samverka med andra aktörer inom såväl tandvård som sjukvård.Vid behandling under generell anestesi är det viktigt att vara trygg i sina terapival och stundtals kunna upprätthålla ett effektivt/snabbt arbetssätt.Hos oss får du möjlighet att ta eget ansvar och att göra skillnad. På Folktandvården ser vi samarbete som vår styrka och det är därför viktigt att vi kan arbeta bra tillsammans. Dina personliga egenskaper är viktiga och att kunna relatera till andra människor på ett lyhört sätt värderas högt. Om stressade situationer skulle uppstå är det viktigt att kunna ge stabilt intryck och också kunna organisera och prioritera arbetet på ett klokt och effektivt sätt. I det dagliga arbetet är du självgående och tar ansvar för din uppgift så att vi tillsammans kan lösa utmaningar och vara trygga tillsammans för de vi är till för.Välkommen med din ansökan! ÖvrigtFolktandvården Västra Götalandsregionen gör kontroll i misstanke- och belastningsregister innan anställning. Om Västra GötalandsregionenHos oss blir du en del av en större helhet. Vi är 56 000 medarbetare i över 200 yrken som varje dag gör skillnad i människors liv i hela Västra Götaland. Du bidrar till en trygg och jämlik vård samt till ett hållbart samhälle där miljö, kultur och goda kommunikationer skapar livskvalitet. Vi är mitt i en digital utveckling där du får vara med och forma framtidens arbetssätt för att förbättra och förenkla vardagen för invånare och verksamheter. Som tillsvidareanställd blir du krigsplacerad som en del av vårt gemensamma ansvar för att samhällsviktiga funktioner ska fungera även i kris. Vill du veta mer om oss? På vår webb kan du läsa mer om våra förmåner och möta medarbetare som varje dag gör skillnad och utvecklas i sina yrken. https://www.vgregion.se/jobba-i-vgr/sa-ar-det-att-jobba-hos-oss/ AnsökanVästra Götalandsregionen ser helst att du registrerar din ansökan via rekryteringssystemet. Om du som sökande har frågor om den utannonserade tjänsten eller av särskilda och speciella skäl inte kan registrera dina uppgifter i ett offentligt system - kontakta kontaktperson för respektive annons.Till bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings-, förmedlings- och rekryteringsföretag samt andra externa aktörer och försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the team

The Legal team at Airwallex is a collaborative group of legal minds and risk management experts. We're passionate about safeguarding Airwallex's operations, fostering a culture of compliance and ethical conduct, and ensuring we navigate the global financial landscape with integrity. We provide expert guidance and support to all areas of the business, proactively identifying, mitigating, and managing legal and financial risks.

What you’ll do

Airwallex is looking for an experienced (Senior) Counsel to support our fast growing commercial legal team across EMEA. You will support a complex set of fintech products that will challenge your problem solving and critical thinking skills. You will support a wide variety of commercial legal matters supporting Airwallex’s growing Sales team, and help us build for scale in several EMEA markets, ranging from Germany, Israel, France, the Netherlands to the UK. This is a strategic position and you will be a key advisor to Airwallex’s EMEA go-to-market Commercial team.

This position is based in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive complex deals. Personally lead negotiations on high-stakes enterprise commercial and strategic partnership deals across EMEA (with a strong emphasis on our UK, NL, and IL business), many with significant cross-border elements.

  • Build for scale. Develop and implement an innovative strategy for delivering efficient and effective commercial legal support. Drive the creation and maintenance of scalable templates, playbooks, and processes to support our rapidly growing business.

  • Be a strategic partner. Act as a key advisor to our dynamic, globally distributed commercial leadership. Partner with the Commercial team to scale our go-to-market efforts and advance multi-product and multi-jurisdictional deal strategies.

  • Enhance Efficiency. Learn from our data and operations teams to leverage technology, automation, and data-driven insights to increase the efficiency and impact of the Commercial Legal function.

  • Collaborate Globally. Work closely and effectively with Airwallex’s global legal, compliance, and risk teams on deals and projects that involve multiple jurisdictions

  • Contribute to Culture. Make a positive contribution to the culture of the Airwallex legal team, the EMEA team, and the company as a whole.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Must-Haves:

  • You bring 5-8 years of legal experience, with experience in private practice at a top law firm. Additional in-house experience at a fintech is strongly preferred.

  • Excellent communication, drafting, negotiation, and writing skills.

  • The ability to explain complex legal concepts to various non-legal audiences, and the ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and deals.

  • High motivation and the ability to operate independently and pivot quickly within a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment.

  • A learner’s mentality: you are consistently looking to take on new and diverse challenges and expand your knowledge beyond your current areas of expertise.

  • A collaborative and empathetic mindset, a good sense of humor, and a keen understanding of how to work effectively with colleagues from different teams and backgrounds.

  • Ability to translate complex legal and risk issues into clear, succinct, and actionable guidance.

  • High integrity, sound judgment, and an unflappable demeanor and collaborative style of working

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience at a fintech or in the banking industry or high-growth and/or globally distributed company.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating technology transactions, SaaS agreements, and other customer-facing services agreements.

  • French/German/Spanish language skills preferred

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: IT System Engineer (w/m/d), 80–100 %
jobs.description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

  • Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

  • Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

  • Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

  • Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

  • Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

  • Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

  • Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

  • Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

  • Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

  • Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

  • Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

  • Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

  • Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

  • Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

  • Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

  • Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

  • Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

  • Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

  • E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

  • Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

Deine Ansprechpersonen:

  • Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

  • Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.

Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

 - Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

 - Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

 - Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

 - Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

 - Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

 - Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

 - Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

 - Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

 - Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a rare opportunity to partner directly with Replit’s President, Michele Catasta. As Replit leads in making useful intelligence accessible to all, you will serve as the company President's primary operational and strategic force multiplier across these critical organizations.

Your mandate is to own the most complex cross-functional challenges, unblock technical and operational bottlenecks, and ensure that the core product, engineering, and organizational engines operate with speed, coherence, and precision.

This is a high-leverage individual contributor (IC) role, not a traditional management track or team-building post. You will scale your personal leverage through AI workflows, agentic automation, and rigorous analytical judgment, influence, not headcount. You are the operator Michele turns to when an issue spans multiple disciplines such as technical architecture, product execution, support feedback loops, or organizational design and demands a single, decisive owner.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Act as Trusted Advisor & Operational Stand-in: Serve as a direct thought partner and proxy for Michele. Elevate core operational insights, synthesize briefings for high-stakes technical and organizational decisions, and step in as a representative when needed.

 - Proactively Clear Cross-Functional Friction: Anticipate blind spots and resolve organizational bottlenecks before they escalate. Bridge natural seams between Engineering, Product, Support, AI teams to ensure high-cadence execution.

 - Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for Complex Initiatives: Spearhead high-priority projects that lack a neat functional home such as evolving product unit economics, developer tooling infrastructure shifts, pricing models, or technical re-architectures.

 - Scale Impact via AI & Automation: Actively build and deploy AI agents, automation pipelines, and modern operational workflows to multiply your personal bandwidth across status synthesis, metrics tracking, scenario modeling, and operational monitoring.


WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

 - Not a Routine Data / BI Role: You will not be building routine dashboards, running routine SQL queries, or handling standard quarterly analytics. Those belong to Data, RevOps, and Strategic Finance.

 - Not Bureaucracy or Process for Process’s Sake: We prioritize momentum, rapid iteration, and decisiveness over heavy governance frameworks or dense slide decks.


WHAT WE LOOK FOR

 - 7+ Years in High-Growth Tech: Proven track record in strategy, operations, product operations, or technical chief of staff roles, with extensive time spent working shoulder-to-shoulder with Engineering and Product leadership.

 - Cross-Domain Credibility: Strong technical fluency to earn the respect of Staff/Principal Engineers and AI researchers, paired with the operational empathy to partner effectively with Support and People teams.

 - Exceptional Execution in Ambiguity: The ability to take ill-defined, sprawling problems, define clean problem boundaries, and drive them to resolution without formal line authority.

 - Strong Quantitative & Analytical Toolkit: Deep comfort evaluating unit economics, interrogating technical systems data, building scenario models, and separating actionable signal from noise.

 - Executive-Ready Communication: Direct, concise communicator who can deliver unambiguous trade-offs and recommendations to senior leadership with clarity and brevity.

 - Hands-on AI & Agent Automation: Active, practical experience leveraging LLM workflows, coding agents, and automation frameworks to amplify daily productivity and analytical depth.

 - Presence & Proximity: Continual availability is essential. Ability to work in-person (at least) three days a week (Monday, Wednesday, Friday) in Foster City, CA, collaborating closely on-site with leadership.

 - Scale Experience: Experience navigating rapid organizational scaling while maintaining high cultural and engineering standards.


NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Deep Developer Tooling Background: Prior experience in developer platforms, cloud infrastructure, AI coding assistants, or developer-focused software ecosystems.


HOW WE’LL KNOW IT’S WORKING

 - Decision Velocity Across Functions Increases: Product, engineering, and support initiatives move from scoping to execution faster, with clear alignment and measurable business impact.

 - Net-Negative Friction: Teams actively seek your partnership because your involvement removes ambiguity, sharpens priorities, and unblocks progress rather than introducing overhead.

jobs.title: 3D Packaging Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

As a 3D Packaging Engineer, you will collaborate closely with our engineering team to physically realize our VIO products. You will operate, adapt, and fine-tune high-precision assembly equipment to meet the precise tolerances required for optimal device performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Tooling Adaptation: Assist in modifying and calibrating high-precision assembly equipment (e.g., flip-chip bonders, die attach machines) to meet unique quantum 3D integration specifications.

  • Process Optimization: Help develop and refine placement and bonding processes (thermo-compression bonding, laser-assisted bonding, coldwelding) for non-standard substrates. Test adhesives, glues, and solders to determine which materials survive extreme thermal cycling and cryogenic vacuum conditions.

  • 3D Assembly Execution: Execute complex integration strategies, including multi-die stacking, interposer-based 3D architectures, and orthogonal (vertical) chip placement.

Your Profile

  • Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Physics, Materials Science, or a related field.

  • Tooling Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience operating and adjusting high-accuracy semiconductor assembly platforms.

  • Precision Assembly: Demonstrated experience achieving tight placement tolerances (around 1µm) in an R&D or pilot production environment.

  • 3D Integration Knowledge: Solid foundational understanding of 3D integration (TSVs, micro-bumps, interposers) and how structural materials behave under thermal stress, high vacuum, or cryogenic conditions.

You will take our existing measurement software and data practices to the next level, making them robust and maintainable, and building on how we organize data so it supports analysis, yield, and root cause investigations at scale. As channel counts grow, PCMs and test vehicles multiply, and test setups become more varied, you will standardize our experimental workflows so measurement throughput never becomes the bottleneck.

You will also be the link between R&D, the software team in Product, and the data team in Operations, so our efforts stay aligned.

  • Data management: Develop and maintain how R&D measurement data and metadata are stored, linking each device to its related tests, components, and setup history, so cross-device comparisons and yield questions become a quick query.

  • Code architecture & quality: Review, refactor, and maintain modular Python code following modern software practices (automated testing with PyTest, CI/CD, documentation, version control).

jobs.title: Lead Supply Chain Coördinator
jobs.description:
Bij Crisp hebben we een missie: eten met meer smaak bereikbaar maken voor iedereen, waarbij we onze kracht van de kortste keten van boer tot bord inzetten op een manier waar je trots op kunt zijn. Als Lead Supply Chain Coördinator geef jij leiding aan het team dat iedere dag opnieuw zorgt dat de korte keten tussen leverancier en ons Warehouse zo goed mogelijk loopt. Zo kunnen we onze knetterverse producten altijd op tijd bij onze klanten bezorgen.

Je staat zelf midden in de operatie, maar kijkt ook verder: je maakt de supply chain elke dag een stukje slimmer, bouwt aan de processen en manier van werken binnen je team, en zorgt voor een sterke samenwerking met ons warehouse. Zo bouw je mee aan een Supply Chain-afdeling waarmee we kunnen blijven groeien.

Wat je gaat doen

Als Lead Inbound Supply Chain Coördinator zorg jij er samen met je team voor dat onze leveranciers de juiste producten, op het goede moment, in de juiste hoeveelheid leveren. Hierdoor krijgen onze klanten hun producten vers bezorgd en kunnen we op ons Warehouse de voorraad zo laag mogelijk houden. Dat is een ingewikkelde puzzel die we elke dag een stukje slimmer willen oplossen. Jij geeft het team daarin richting, houdt de dagelijkse operatie scherp en verbetert tegelijk structureel. Je hebt veel contact met externe partijen zoals leveranciers, en met andere teams binnen Crisp zoals ons warehouse en het commerciële team.

Een aantal van jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn:

  • Je bent leidinggevende van het Inbound Supply Chain-team. Je coacht en ontwikkelt je teamleden, voert de gesprekken die daarbij horen en zorgt dat iedereen weet wat je van hem of haar verwacht.

  • Je bewaakt samen met het team de dagelijkse supply chain performance en bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het oplossen van verstoringen. Waar nodig spring je zelf bij om bestellingen scherp te monitoren en snel te schakelen met leveranciers en interne teams.

  • Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de continuous improvement van onze dagelijkse supply chain. Je analyseert waar het schuurt, zet verbeteringen op de agenda en zorgt dat ze ook echt landen in de operatie.

  • Je bent eigenaar van de teamprocessen en de way-of-working. Je zorgt voor heldere afspraken, duidelijke rolverdeling en werkwijzen die meegroeien met Crisp.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking met ons warehouse team. Je stemt structureel af, lost knelpunten samen op en bouwt aan een relatie waarin beide teams elkaar sterker maken.

Dit ben jij

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding op zak.

  • Je hebt minimaal 3-5 jaar ervaring binnen Supply Chain, Logistiek of Operations.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands.

  • Je bent een natuurlijke leider. Je geeft richting, coacht je team en haalt het beste uit mensen.

  • Je bent een verbeteraar. Je ziet snel waar processen beter kunnen en voert verbeteringen ook echt door.

  • Je bent nog steeds een echte doener. Je vindt het leuk om mee te draaien in de operatie.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk. Je bent een teamplayer, bouwt makkelijk relaties op en schakelt met gemak met veel verschillende partijen tegelijk.

  • Je hebt talent voor planning en structuur. Je werkt planmatig en gestructureerd en bent altijd voorbereid.

Wat wij bieden

  • Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op het Europese voedselsysteem.

  • Een extra vrije dag per jaar om je in te zetten voor vrijwilligerswerk en iets goeds te doen.

  • Voor straks een perfect pensioen via BPFL.

  • Enthousiaste, slimme collega’s en tijd om elkaar te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen.

  • En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten.

Onze selectieprocedure

Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter.

Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd.

jobs.title: Junior Business Controller
jobs.description:
Steer our numbers, fuel our growth – so our team can focus on saving birds and stopping drones.

As our Jr. Business Controller, you bring data to life and turn financial insights into smart operational decisions. You work closely with your team and colleagues across the business to build accurate forecasts, spot trends, and guide our strategic goals. Reporting directly to the Head of Business Controlling, your sharp financial eye gives our management crew the clarity they need to keep Robin Radar moving forward.

What you'll do

Financial forecasting and analysis: Collate, analyze, and interpret financial data using preset tools and methods. Drive our budget forecasting and closing processes to keep our growth plans on track.

Reporting and dashboarding: Deliver clear management analytics, periodic reports, and visual dashboards. Give leaders across the organization the visibility they need for confident operational oversight.

Variance and trend analysis: Run variance analysis to track operational performance. Identify trend deviations early and translate those shifts into actionable steering advice for key stakeholders.

Financial policies and internal controls: Advise on financial guidelines and help optimize internal control procedures. Resolve routine queries, handle continuous practice improvements, and keep standards consistently high.

Compliance and risk oversight: Review financial data periodically to verify completeness and accuracy. Ensure full alignment with regulatory codes and escalate non-compliance risks before they impact the business.

Cross-functional projects and support: Assist with special financial projects across our entities. Guide colleagues to help them make the best possible use of our data management systems every day.

What you bring

  • BSc or MSc in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field

  • 1 - 2 years of experience in financial controlling or FP&A, ideally within a multinational environment

  • Strong command of financial modelling, forecasting, and modern reporting tools

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and written

  • Analytical mind with sharp attention to detail and a strategic outlook

  • Proactive team player who takes ownership and works well independently

  • Excellent communicator across cultures, comfortable collaborating with teams across our group companies

N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

The team

At blp, dedicated engineering teams own individual products such as invoices, customer orders, and order confirmations. The Platform Team owns what all of them are built on: shared services and APIs, the data access layer, and the component and design system that shape how the product looks and behaves.

The team's focus has been the frontend platform, and we are now deliberately extending that ownership deeper into the stack. You would be central to that shift, with real influence over how the platform layer gets defined rather than inheriting someone else's blueprint.

 

About the role

  • What you'll do and for whom. You build and run the core backend service our product teams rely on, from its APIs and persistence layer to email, user provisioning, and cross-tenant capabilities for large enterprises. Through those teams, your work reaches the 20'000+ people who use our Purchase-to-Pay and Order-to-Cash agents every day.

  • Where you'll work. You join the Platform Team, about 10 engineers. At BLP, platform means the core of our product, not internal infrastructure: the shared services, data access layer, and design system that every product runs on. You work closely with the senior backend engineer who owns these areas today, in a large production Go codebase with well-established patterns.

  • What success looks like. In your first year, you own one core area end-to-end, for example, user provisioning, outbound email, cross-tenant capabilities, analytics, or workflow configuration, from the Go service to the customer using it.

 

What you'll do

  • Build the service that product teams build on. Design, build, and evolve the core APIs behind document processing, approval workflows, administration, and analytics, with clear contracts so product teams can ship on top of them without workarounds.

  • Own the persistence layer. Each tenant has its own isolated MySQL database. You evolve the abstraction product teams build on (a tenant-scoped unit of work, typed repositories, and shared type-safe querying) so that isolation, transactions, and permissions are right by default.

  • Scale BLP for large enterprises. Extend our cross-tenant capabilities so customers with many subsidiaries and business units can manage users, permissions, and documents across all of them from one place, correctly, securely, and fast.

  • Own email, in and out. Own our email document ingestion and outbound email services, including the audit trail and its UI.

  • Make setup self-service. Turn manual SSO, SCIM, and email setups into migration tools and admin UIs that customers and project managers can run on their own.

  • Work with customers. Join onboarding calls with customer IT teams and project managers, get their setups running, and turn what you learn into better tooling.

  • Own it end-to-end. From the Go service through the React UI to production, including tracing, metrics, and incident analysis after it ships.

Tech stack: Go, React/TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, Temporal, Kubernetes on GCP and AWS, GitHub CI/CD, and OpenTelemetry with Grafana, Prometheus, Tempo, and Parca for observability.

 

We're excited about you because

  • You have 4+ years of experience as a software engineer, with most of that time spent building and operating backend systems in production.

  • You have 2+ years of professional Go experience, writing services that run in production, not side projects.

  • You've designed a backend service or API that other teams depended on, and kept it reliable and evolvable as usage grew.

  • You work well across teams. You align with product, integration, and infrastructure teams on contracts, priorities, and rollouts, and you can explain technical trade-offs to people who aren't engineers.

  • You improve existing production systems step by step, and you know when a rewrite isn't worth it.

  • You have strong fundamentals in type systems, composition, testing, and clean architecture, and you're comfortable working in a codebase built on functional patterns.

  • You're fullstack where it counts: you build on the components and design system our frontend experts maintain to ship admin UIs quickly, even though the backend is where you do your deepest work.

  • You think in products and take ownership. You translate business problems into precise specifications, weigh cost against benefit, work directly with customers when a setup needs it, and stay responsible for what you ship after it goes live.

 

Strong plus

  • Experience with distributed systems, Kubernetes, Temporal, or cloud infrastructure.

  • Experience with user provisioning (SCIM) and SSO (OIDC).

  • Experience running multi-tenant systems.

  • Domain knowledge in ERP, finance, procurement, or supply chain processes, or German language skills.

What you'll get

  • Ownership of visible outcomes. The areas you own decide how fast enterprise customers go live and how well BLP scales with them.

  • Impact at scale. Every improvement you ship to the product core multiplies across all product teams and the 20'000+ people who use BLP daily.

  • Senior scope from day one. You'll lead technical initiatives and mentor engineers on a team that is actively growing its backend ownership.

Learn more about BLP and our values at blp.digital/company/careers.

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Manager I (Dutch Speaking)
jobs.description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

Step into the world of Customer Onboarding, a place where seamless onboarding experiences are crafted to bring delight to customers and businesses alike. As a Pleo Customer Onboarding Manager, you hold the key to unlocking the full potential of our cutting-edge solutions for businesses across Europe & the UK. Your mission is to oversee and execute the onboarding process with precision and finesse, collaborating seamlessly with both customers and internal teams to ensure a smooth and memorable journey from start to finish.


Picture yourself as the bridge between technology and human connection, understanding each customer's unique requirements, and configuring Pleo to match their needs perfectly. You'll be the go-to expert for technical queries, providing consultation, sharing best practices, and conducting training to drive user adoption that allows our customers to take their business to new levels. Your role goes beyond just technical prowess – it's about building strong relationships and ensuring customer success becomes a powerful reference point for the world to see. Your genuine curiosity and exceptional problem-solving skills will shine through as you navigate multiple onboarding projects with ease, all while staying up-to-date with the latest industry trends.


Some of the fun you will have
Facing the customer externally:

  • In short, after our customers have signed up to Pleo, you'll be in charge of their Onboarding

  • Work with these customers to identify objectives, priorities, policies, systems, and effective rollout plans

  • Align with our customers on project timelines, scope, resources, and integration requirements

  • Configure Pleo for users, including activation, limits, cards, integration, and compliance

  • Integrate Pleo with the customer's accounting system, export expenses, and help test

  • Provide consulting, share best practices, conduct training and help drive user adoption

  • Assist in preparing data, communication, policies, and guides

  • Provide 'hyper care', conduct final review calls, facilitate handover to the dedicate Customer Success Manager.

  • Maintain strong relationships, gather feedback and CES scores

  • Assist in capturing testimonials or references

 

And internally facing:

  • You'll enjoy sharing knowledge with the team, collaborating on training and enablement

  • The opportunity to work and add your voice to our continuous process improvement projects

  • Accurately track efforts for revenue recognition and resource allocation

  • Provide feedback and insights to product, development, and marketing teams

  • Collaborate with stakeholders, share updates, address risks

  • Ensure onboarding timeline and customer satisfaction

  • Share success stories, encourage testimonials, showcase experiences

 

You will thrive in this role if you have

  • Successful customer facing experience (at least 2-3 years), ideally in Customer Onboarding, or in Customer Success.

  • Some knowledge of accounting principles and financial workflows is desirable.

  • Genuine curiosity for understanding and fulfilment of customer needs.

  • Strong and proven commitment to customer satisfaction and building relationships.

  • Excellent planning, prioritisation, and risk management abilities for simultaneous onboarding projects.

  • Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams to drive success. Can you really break down a customer problem and explain it to a data analyst, designer, or engineer?

  • Willingness to adapt to changing requirements and stay updated with industry trends.

  • Energy that is palpable. Are you someone who can lift others up? Can you be a rock for your teammates? Can you be vulnerable when times call for it? And, can you bring a fierceness that propels our business forward? If yes then you are the one for this team.

  • Complete business fluency in Dutch and English (Essential)

  • Business or Native German would be nice to have.
