jobs.title: Doktorand i medicinsk vetenskap
jobs.description: Doktorand i medicinsk vetenskap  Umeå universitet, Medicinska fakulteten Institutionen för folkhälsa och klinisk medicin utlyser en doktorandtjänst i medicinsk vetenskap inom forskningsområdet Kardiologi. Anställningstiden är fyra år och avser heltid med start enligt överenskommelse.  Du som antas till utbildning på forskarnivå ingår i det fakultetsgemensamma forskarutbildningsprogrammet vid Medicinska fakulteten. Programmet omfattar 25 hp och erbjuds i två studietakter: 25 hp över 8 terminer (totalt 4 år) respektive över 12 terminer (totalt 6 år), med programstart varje höst- och vårtermin. Mer information om programmet går att finna på fakultetens hemsida för utbildning på forskarnivå (Utbildning på forskarnivå)Projektbeskrivning och arbetsuppgifter  Medfödda hjärtfel är den vanligaste allvarliga medfödda missbildningen och drabbar cirka 9 av 1 000 nyfödda. Tack vare stora framsteg inom diagnostik, kirurgi och kateterburna behandlingar överlever idag mer än 95 % av patienterna till vuxen ålder. Detta har lett till en snabbt växande population av vuxna med medfödda hjärtfel (ACHD), men också till en ökad förekomst av långsiktiga komplikationer såsom hjärtsvikt, förmaksflimmer (AF) och ischemisk stroke. Det övergripande syftet med detta doktorandprojekt är därför att förbättra riskstratifieringen för ischemisk stroke hos ACHD-patienter samt att öka kunskapen om epidemiologi och riskfaktorer för förmaksflimmer. Studierna bygger huvudsakligen på svenska nationella kvalitetsregister med hög täckningsgrad och lång uppföljningstid. Målsättningen är att möjliggöra mer träffsäker och individualiserad riskbedömning, förbättra preventiva insatser och behandlingar samt bidra till framtida riktlinjer för vård av den växande ACHD-populationen.Doktoranden kommer att delta aktivt i planering och genomförande av projektets studier. Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar datahantering, statistiska analyser, tolkning av resultat samt författande och publicering av vetenskapliga artiklar. Arbetet sker under handledning och i nära samarbete med handledare, statistiker och andra forskningssamarbetspartners. Under forskarutbildningen förväntas doktoranden successivt utveckla ökad självständighet och ta ett växande ansvar genom forskningens alla delar.Anställningen syftar till en doktorsexamen och doktorandens huvuduppgift är att ägna sig åt egen forskarutbildning vilket innefattar deltagande i forskningsprojekt såväl som forskarutbildningskurser, journal clubs, seminarier etc. Antagningskrav För att antas till utbildning på forskarnivå ska den sökande ha grundläggande behörighet och särskild behörighet enligt nedan samt bedömas ha sådan förmåga som i övrigt behövs för att klara utbildningen. Grundläggande behörighet  Grundläggande behörighet till utbildning på forskarnivå har den som har avlagt en examen på avancerad nivå, fullgjort kursfordringar om minst 240 högskolepoäng (hp), varav minst 60 hp på avancerad nivå, eller som i någon annan ordning inom eller utom landet har förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper (HF 7 kap 39§). Särskild behörighet För att kunna antas till utbildning på forskarnivå krävs att den sökande har nödvändiga kunskaper från högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande utbildning och/eller yrkeserfarenhet som bedöms i relation till forskarutbildningsområdet samt nödvändiga språkkunskaper i engelska. Både skriftliga och muntliga kunskaper avses.Övriga kvalifikationer  Särskilt meriterande är:·         läkarexamen eller pågående läkarutbildning,·         kunskap om eller erfarenhet av forskning inom vuxna med medfödda hjärtfel (ACHD),·         erfarenhet av epidemiologisk och registerbaserad forskning,·         god samarbetsförmåga och erfarenhet av arbete i forskningsgrupper.Ansökan Ansökan ska innehålla: Ett personligt följebrev med motivering till varför du söker och varför du är lämpad till forskarutbildningsplatsen. Ett CV. Styrkta kopior av examensbevis, betyg och intyg. Kopior på examensarbete och eventuella publikationer. Kontaktinformation till minst två referenspersoner. Ansökan ska göras via vårt e-rekryteringssystem Varbi och vara inkommen senast 2026-11-19.VillkorLön i enlighet med fastställd lönestege för doktorandbefattningar. För det fall att uppehållstillstånd krävs för din vistelse i Sverige, förbehåller sig universitetet rätten att återkalla antagningen om du inte beviljas uppehållstillstånd, eller – om datum för studiestart är bestämt - om du inte kan uppvisa ett giltigt uppehållstillstånd innan datum för studiestart.Välkommen med din ansökan!Umeå universitet vill erbjuda en jämställd och jämlik miljö där öppna samtal mellan människor med olika bakgrund och perspektiv lägger grunden för lärande, skaparkraft och utveckling. Vi välkomnar därför personer med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter att söka den aktuella anställningen.Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare: Vi undanber oss vänligen men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.

The department is actively involved in ongoing research across several fields and has a strong emphasis on education, continuing professional development, and the ongoing advancement of clinical services.What can we offer? As a Specialist Physician/Senior Consultant at the Department of Gastroenterology and Hepatolgy at Sahlgrenska university Hospital, you will have excellent opportunities for professional development and research. You will work within our subspecialty teams alongside ambitious and friendly colleagues, with close collaboration with the transplantation unit.The department has a high patient volume, providing extensive opportunities for both clinical practice and research.Our goal is to provide the highest possible standard of care for our patients. We place great importance on supporting each individual's professional development according to their interests, strengths, and career goals, while also enabling them to influence their working environment.About the RoleYou will work with the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients requiring specialized care in hepatology in both emergency and elective settings. You will also be expected to take an active part in the department’s quality improvement, development, and change initiatives, as well as in research activities.About YouWe are looking for a board-certified senior consultant in Gastroenterology and Hepatology with a high level of expertise in hepatology. You should be interested in both your own professional development and contributing to the advancement of care at one of the largest university hospitals in the Nordic region. You work well within a team and have a strong interest in liver disease.We value strong communication and collaboration skills. You are able to apply newly acquired knowledge in your clinical practice, make sound clinical judgments, and thrive in a fast-paced work environment. We are seeking a motivated and independent individual with the ability and interest to take overall responsibility and place the patient's needs at the center of care.Ongoing research activities and/or a doctoral degree (PhD) are considered meritorious.Great emphasis will be placed on personal suitability.Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis throughout the recruitment period.We warmly welcome your application!Together for the patient - Sahlgrenska UniversitetssjukhusetIn the event of recruiting a physician or nurse with a foreign medical license and/or specialist certification, the appointment will be preceded by the necessary process to fulfill the requirements for Swedish licensure and/or specialist recognition.About Region Västra GötalandRegion Västra Götaland is there for the people of Västra Götaland. jobs.title: FPGA Engineer
jobs.description:
................

For our client in Vienna (AT), we are looking for an experienced FPGA Engineer to contribute to the development of an advanced hardware and software platform for particle accelerator systems.

In this role, you will design and implement FPGA-based solutions for real-time control, high-speed data communication, and synchronized operations within a technically demanding and regulated medical-device environment.

Your Tasks:

  • Design, develop, and integrate FPGA-based embedded systems using Xilinx Zynq platforms
  • Develop and maintain FPGA firmware frameworks, register maps, and hardware/software interfaces
  • Implement and optimize PCIe communication and FPGA-to-Linux integration, including efficient data transfer and DMA mechanisms
  • Design and implement high-speed optical communication interfaces, including Fiber Link MAP, GT transceivers, and custom communication protocols
  • Optimize communication performance with a focus on bandwidth, latency, and reliability
  • Contribute to the development of real-time measurement, control, and synchronized timing systems for particle accelerator components
  • Collaborate with hardware, firmware, and software engineers to ensure seamless integration into a unified control platform
  • Support verification, testing, and technical documentation in accordance with regulated EU medical-device development processes

Your Profile:

  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a comparable technical discipline
  • Strong hands-on experience in FPGA development, particularly with Xilinx Zynq-based embedded platforms
  • Solid understanding of FPGA firmware architectures, register maps, and hardware/software integration
  • Practical experience with PCIe interfaces, FPGA-to-Linux communication, and DMA-based data transfers
  • Strong knowledge of high-speed optical links, GT transceivers, and communication protocol development, ideally including Fiber Link MAP
  • Experience in optimizing FPGA communication systems for high throughput and low latency
  • Familiarity with embedded Linux and/or bare-metal environments is an advantage
  • Experience with real-time systems, synchronization, or timing-critical applications is beneficial
  • Knowledge of regulated development environments, ideally within the medical-device industry, is a plus
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a structured and collaborative working approach
  • Good communication skills in English or German

jobs.title: Psychologist
jobs.description: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.Role SummaryScania Occupational Health Services Sweden is looking for an experienced licensed psychologist who would like to provide qualified support to Scania’s operations in Södertälje. In this role, you will work with issues relating to individuals’ health and circumstances, group interaction and development, and organizational ways of working and change. You will support employees, managers, HR and management teams, adapting your interventions to their needs—from clinical support for individuals to consultative work with groups and organizations.You will contribute psychological expertise and a holistic perspective to issues relating to work-related ill health, rehabilitation, collaboration, conflict and change. The aim is to promote health and create sustainable conditions for both people and the business.You will be part of a cross-professional team in a global and dynamic organization. Your experience and ability to translate knowledge into practical support will be important to our work to promote health, safety and sustainable productivity.  Job ResponsibilitiesYou will be part of a cross-functional team that includes occupational health physicians, occupational health nurses and other psychologists. In your customer team, you will also work with ergonomists and work environment engineers. You will work in a consultative capacity, supporting individuals, groups, managers, HR and management teams.The work includes both preventive and remedial interventions at individual, group and organizational levels. You will move between these levels according to the needs of each assignment and consider how individuals’ situations, group interactions and organizational conditions affect one another.Your main responsibilities will be to:    Conduct clinical assessments and provide time-limited psychological treatment for individuals, both individually and in groups, as well as support in cases of work-related ill health and rehabilitation.    Support individuals and groups with issues relating to health, work capacity, collaboration and return to work.    Support groups with group development, collaboration and conflict issues, for example through facilitation and consultative support.    Support managers, HR and management teams with issues relating to employee health, group interactions and organizational conditions.    Contribute psychological expertise to organizational changes and change management, focusing on how changes affect individuals, groups, leadership and the work environment.    Analyze organizational conditions and provide recommendations for sustainable ways of working and a good organizational and social work environment.    Develop and deliver training in areas such as mental health, change, work environment and leadership.The position is based at Occupational Health Services in Södertälje. When the customer assignment allows, the work can be carried out remotely.Who You Are    Licensed Psychologist with experience providing psychological support to individuals and groups.    Strong consultative background, partnering with managers, teams, and organizations to address workplace challenges and promote wellbeing.    Experience supporting organizational change, including reorganizations, new ways of working, and business transformations.    Knowledge of group dynamics, organizational psychology, and evidence-based interventions that support healthy and effective workplaces.    Experience working with work-related ill health, rehabilitation processes, and employee support.    Skilled in supporting managers and teams through collaboration, communication, and conflict-resolution challenges.    Able to build trust, provide constructive challenge, and translate psychological expertise into practical recommendations and actions.    Structured, empathetic, and adaptable, with excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.    Fluent in Swedish and English, both written and spoken; experience within Occupational Health Services is considered an advantage.This Is UsOccupational Health Services Sweden is part of Global SHE, which supports Scania in the areas of safety, health and work environment. We are based in Södertälje, Oskarshamn and Luleå in Sweden, as well as at other locations around the world. Our role as an independent expert resource is to guide Scania in its work to ensure and promote health, safety and sustainable productivity. Our work is based on legislation, science and proven experience. We also have a preventive and methods-development remit, aimed at supporting Scania in complying with legislation. As an integrated part of the business, we have a good understanding of the workplaces and the opportunity to follow operations over time.Scania OffersWe offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.ApplicationWe look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-11-10. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.

jobs.title: International Advocacy Advisor
jobs.description: RFSL is seeking an International Advocacy Advisor to support Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists in advancing their advocacy priorities and influencing policy at national, regional and international levels. The role combines international advocacy, partnership development and capacity strengthening, with practical programme and administrative support that enables locally led movements to thrive.About RFSL and our international workRFSL (the Swedish Federation for Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, Transgender, Queer, and Intersex Rights), founded in 1950, is one of the world’s oldest non-profit organisations working to advance LGBTQI rights.RFSL’s international work supports LGBTQI movements in Eastern Europe, Asia and Africa through regranting, partnerships, knowledge exchange, organisational support and advocacy. We work closely with local partners to support locally led movements, strengthen their agency and influence, and contribute to enabling environments for LGBTQI rights at national, regional and global levels.Your role with usYou will work closely with Ukrainian LGBTQI organisations and activists to strengthen their ability to lead and influence advocacy processes. Together with partners, you will identify priorities, develop strategies and messaging, map stakeholders, and find opportunities to engage decision-makers and relevant international platforms, including the EU, UN, OSCE and Council of Europe.A central part of the role is helping partners access the knowledge, networks, resources and practical support they need to pursue their priorities. This includes organising capacity-strengthening activities, managing scholarships and providing hands-on programme and administrative support. You will also contribute to advocacy efforts in Sweden related to Ukraine and work with RFSL colleagues to align policy, advocacy and communications.You will collaborate with the Head of Program, International Program Managers, other Advocacy Advisors and colleagues across RFSL’s international work. The position is based in Stockholm and involves international travel several times per year.For full description of  key responsibilities and desirable qualifications, please see our job ad on RFSL’s careers pageWho are you?You are a structured, collaborative and solution-oriented professional committed to LGBTQI rights, international advocacy and locally led movement strengthening. You understand Ukraine’s political and social context, the regional human rights and civil society landscape, and the challenges facing LGBTQI organisations working in politically sensitive or resource-constrained environments.You build trusted partnerships and adapt your approach to different organisations, particularly grassroots groups that may need substantial practical support alongside strategic guidance. You respect local leadership and autonomy, understand power dynamics in international partnerships, and approach your work with awareness of security, safeguarding and the importance of accountable support.You enjoy combining strategic advocacy and capacity strengthening with practical operational and administrative tasks. You are comfortable moving between developing advocacy strategies and organising activities, coordinating travel, booking accommodation, handling receipts and ensuring that payments and documentation are in order. You recognise that this hands-on support is an important part of enabling partners to advance their own priorities.You bring strong analytical, communication and organisational skills, can represent RFSL professionally with civil society, public authorities and international institutions, and work effectively across teams and cultures. You are proactive, flexible and accountable, and share RFSL’s values of anti-racism, feminism, accessibility and intersectionality.To succeed in this role, you need:    A strong commitment to LGBTQI rights and experience or demonstrated competence in advocacy, policy influence, civil society support or related human rights work, particularly in relation to Ukraine.    Strong knowledge of the human rights situation and civil society landscape in Ukraine or the wider region, including experience working in partnership with LGBTQI movements or organisations.    At least three years of relevant professional experience in advocacy, civil society support, development cooperation or a related field.    Experience engaging with international or regional advocacy processes and human rights mechanisms, such as those of the EU, UN, OSCE or Council of Europe.    An understanding of security and safeguarding considerations when working with LGBTQI activists and civil society in challenging contexts.    Strong analytical, organisational and administrative skills, including experience with organisational capacity assessment, budgets, programme documentation and risk management.    Excellent written and spoken English.    Some understanding of Ukrainian or a closely related language, together with a willingness to develop Ukrainian-language skills as needed.    The ability to work from Stockholm, Sweden, and undertake international travel several times per year.Employment terms    Employment type: This is a permanent position, starting with a six-month probationary period.     Location: RFSL office in Stockholm.    Start date: As agreed    Contract terms: Covered by the Collective Agreement for Nonprofit OrganizationsOur offerRFSL offers an inclusive, values-driven workplace where you can contribute to meaningful change alongside committed colleagues and partners. We provide competitive employment conditions, including occupational pension and parental benefits.How to applyApply by November 15th, 2026. The recruitment process is conducted in English and includes anonymous, competency-based assessment, a work-related assignment and a background check.For questions about the position or recruitment process, contact HR Partner Tobias Jensen at tobias.jensen@rfsl.se.RFSL strives to be an inclusive, feminist and anti-racist workplace. We welcome applicants regardless of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, sex characteristics, religion, race, ethnicity, country of origin, disability, age or other grounds of discrimination. We strongly encourage candidates with diverse backgrounds and experiences to apply.

jobs.title: Nuclear Waste System Engineer
jobs.description: What we do at BlykallaBlykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com.What you’ll get to doYou will own the design of the radioactive waste management systems for SEALER, covering the liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams generated by the reactor over its life. This includes the systems that process, characterise, condition, package, and store waste, from the cover gas cleanup that handles activation products in the primary loop, to the treatment of contaminated liquids from maintenance operations, to the interfaces with spent fuel and decommissioning.The lead-cooled fast reactor environment presents distinct waste challenges, solutions here need to combine solid nuclear waste engineering fundamentals with a proper understanding of the lead chemistry environment.    Define the functional and design requirements for SEALER's radioactive waste management systems, covering liquid, gaseous, and solid waste streams.    Develop and maintain the design basis for cover gas cleanup, liquid radwaste treatment, and solid waste characterisation, packaging, and storage.    Lead trade-off studies on waste minimisation at source versus downstream treatment, and quantify the impact on plant footprint, cost, and dose.    Interface with the Nuclear and Safety and licensing teams on waste categorisation, disposal routes, and regulatory expectations in Europe (i.e. SSM) and in the US (NRC).    Define the scope of supplier work packages on waste system equipment, evaluate proposals, and steer their execution through qualification.    Coordinate with the Material and Lead Chemistry teams on activation products and the handling of lead-contaminated components.    Support decommissioning-oriented design choices during the concept and preliminary design phases.    Contribute to the waste-related sections of the plant safety case and licensing documentation.        Who you’ll get to work withThe Nuclear Waste System Engineer sits in the Fluid Systems Engineering Team within Blykalla, and reports to the Manager of Fluid Systems Engineering. You will collaborate closely with the Nuclear and Safety, Material, Test and Validation, and Quality teams, as well as with external suppliers, research partners, and regulators. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you areYou will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are:    More than 5 years of professional experience in radioactive waste management, ideally in reactor design, waste treatment facility engineering, or spent fuel handling.    Degree in nuclear, chemical, environmental, or a closely related engineering discipline.    Working knowledge of the physical and chemical processes involved in liquid radwaste treatment (evaporation, ion exchange, filtration), gaseous waste cleanup (HEPA, adsorbers, delay beds), and solid waste conditioning (cementation, drum packaging).    Familiarity with nuclear waste categorisation (LLW, ILW, HLW) and disposal routes in at least one national regulatory framework.    Comfort writing clear technical specifications, reviewing supplier deliverables critically, and managing a multi-vendor technical dialogue from concept through qualification.    Familiarity with CAD tools and engineering software.    Fluent in English, spoken and written.    Fluency in Swedish is a plus.Meritorious skills:    Experience with waste systems in Generation IV reactor programmes (LFR, SFR, MSR) or in research reactors with unusual coolants..    Experience interfacing with SSM (Sweden) or NRC (US) on waste-related submittals.    Prior work on commissioning or decommissioning of nuclear facilities.    Familiarity with activation calculations and source term evaluation.    Experience with nuclear waste transport, interim storage, or final disposal facilities.Location This position is for our office in Stockholm.

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
jobs.description: What we do at BlykallaBlykalla is a Swedish deep-tech company at the forefront of the nuclear industry, pioneering the development of small modular reactors that provide clean, safe, and reliable energy. Thanks to lead-cooling, we achieve high safety in a very compact format, allowing for a simple and cost-effective design that can be mass-produced. Our unique reactor design will provide safe and green baseload energy that perfectly complements solar and wind power.What you’ll get to doWe are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer with deep expertise in ABB 800xA DCS to lead the development of Blykalla's plant control system architecture and implementation strategy.This is a unique opportunity to help define the control philosophy of a first-of-a-kind advanced nuclear reactor. You will play a key role in ensuring that Blykalla develops and retains ownership of critical control system intellectual property while working closely with ABB and other suppliers.Key ResponsibilitiesDCS Architecture & Ownership    Lead the design and development of Blykalla's plant-wide automation and control system architecture.    Define the ABB 800xA system architecture for reactor, balance-of-plant, auxiliary, and test facility applications.    Develop internal engineering standards, libraries, templates, and control strategies to maximize in-house ownership of intellectual property.    Establish long-term governance for control system design, lifecycle management, cybersecurity, and configuration control.Control System Engineering    Develop functional specifications, control narratives, cause-and-effect matrices, and automation philosophies.    Design and implement control logic, sequences, interlocks, alarms, and operator interfaces.    Configure ABB 800xA applications, controllers, engineering environments, and HMI systems.    Define communication architectures including OPC UA, IEC 61850, Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, Ethernet/IP, and other industrial protocols.    Develop and maintain simulation and testing environments for control system validation.Nuclear Plant Integration    Support the integration of reactor systems, safety systems, and balance-of-plant equipment into the overall control architecture.    Work closely with reactor, thermal-hydraulic, electrical, mechanical, and safety engineers to define system requirements.    Contribute to licensing and regulatory documentation related to instrumentation and control systems.    Support development of digital I&C architectures aligned with nuclear industry expectations and international standards.Vendor & Stakeholder Management    Act as the primary technical interface with ABB regarding 800xA architecture, licensing, engineering tools, and implementation support.    Ensure that Blykalla retains ownership of application software, engineering databases, configuration standards, and control strategies.    Manage external engineering partners and system integrators where required.    Participate in factory acceptance tests (FAT), site acceptance tests (SAT), commissioning, and startup activities.Verification & Validation    Develop testing methodologies for control logic verification and system validation.    Lead integration testing and commissioning activities.    Support development of digital twins and operator training simulators.    Ensure traceability from requirements through implementation and testing.Who you’ll get to work withThe Senior Control Systems Engineer sits in the Plant engineering Team within Blykalla. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and Blykalla. Who you areYou will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personnel chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help in order for you to succeed in this role, these are:    MSc or BSc in Control Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, Nuclear Engineering, or related discipline.    Minimum 10 years of experience in industrial automation and control systems engineering.    Extensive hands-on experience with ABB 800xA DCS engineering, configuration, commissioning, and lifecycle management.    Proven experience designing and implementing large-scale DCS architectures.    Experience developing control strategies for complex industrial facilities.    Strong understanding of industrial networks, field instrumentation, and process control.    Fluent in English, spoken and written    Fluency in Swedish is a plusTechnical Skills    Expert-level knowledge of ABB 800xA:    AC 800M controllers    Control Builder    Aspect Objects    System 800xA Engineering    Operator Workplace    Alarm Management    Batch and Advanced Process Control (desirable)    Strong understanding of:    ISA-88    ISA-95    IEC 61511    IEC 61508    Industrial cybersecurity principles    Configuration management and software lifecycle practices    Experience with simulation and testing environments.Location This position is for our office in Stockholm.Reference & Background ChecksAs part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. However, every resume and application is reviewed directly by our recruiting team. AI tools are used solely for operational support and do not influence candidate evaluation or hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Comissioning & Warranty Lead
jobs.description: The final phase of a delivery is where our technology truly proves itself. Installation at the shipyard, commissioning, HAT and SAT, final acceptance, and the warranty period are critical stages in ensuring that the vessel performs as promised. They are also the moments that shape the customer’s lasting impression of our delivery.To strengthen our focus on this critical phase, we are now establishing a new Commissioning & Warranty function and are looking for two individuals to join the team who want to help shape it from the start. In this role, you will take operational responsibility for the delivery through its most decisive stage, where engineering is transformed into real-world performance and customer value.What you will be doingAs Responsible for Commissioning & Warranty, you are operationally responsible for a delivery from formal project handover, after FAT and delivery of the equipment, until the customer is transferred to standard Aftermarket support. You will plan, coordinate, and drive the delivery forward through arrival inspection, installation support, commissioning, HAT and SAT, customer acceptance, the warranty period, and ultimately formal warranty closure. Your mission is clear: keep everything moving until we leave behind vessels that perform as promised and customers who trust us to deliver again.Throughout this journey, you will be the customer’s primary operational point of contact, providing continuity, direction, and clear ownership from one phase to the next. Internally, you will be the connecting force between our technical, operational, and supporting functions, bringing the right people together, aligning priorities, and ensuring that the delivery continues to move forward.In practice, you will:    Take over the delivery from the Project Manager and make sure nothing falls between the two of you: scope, open points, documentation and warranty terms.    Coordinate field service resources and spare parts, and collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), technical support and suppliers to secure competence and availability against plan;    Ensure arrival inspection at site is completed and drive transport damage and shortages to resolution.    Support installation towards the shipyard, then plan and run commissioning, HAT and SAT until acceptance is obtained.    Act as operational owner of warranty cases, from registration and technical assessment to liability determination and resolution, including claim handling and supplier recovery.    Handle customer disputes and negotiate practical, commercially sound settlements within your mandate.    Keep scope boundaries, documentation, cost exposure and status visible and feed lessons learned back into engineering, production and service.You work within a clear mandate. Decisions on prioritization, technical resolution paths, resourcing, warranty assessment and settlements within your delegated authority are yours to make. The Project Manager remains accountable for the overall project, and the genuinely large questions are escalated but you are expected to solve, not to forward.We think you should haveYou have led projects before and know what it takes to keep stakeholders aligned when schedules are under pressure. You are comfortable being the main point of contact for customers and enjoy balancing technical, commercial and operational perspectives to move a project forward.We believe you have several years of experience in project management, commissioning management, or aftermarket/service management, preferably within the marine, offshore, energy, or other capital equipment industries. You hold a technical degree or have gained equivalent knowledge through practical experience. You have worked closely with shipyards, customers and suppliers, handling deviations, claims and commercial discussions, and you possess a solid technical understanding that allows you to actively participate in discussions with engineers and service technicians, form your own view of technical challenges, and contribute to finding solutions.You are comfortable working across multiple IT systems simultaneously, such as ERP platforms, case and claim management systems, documentation tools and reporting solutions. You also have a good understanding of contracts, warranty terms and the commercial impact of technical decisions. Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required, while Swedish is considered an advantage. The role also involves occasional travel to shipyards, vessels and customer sites as needed, although travel is not the primary focus of the position.Just as important as your experience is the way you work. You are structured and proactive, with a natural ability to bring tasks to completion rather than letting them drift. You remain calm and professional in challenging situations, focusing on finding solutions and building strong relationships. You communicate clearly with people from different cultures, backgrounds and levels of an organization, and you take ownership of your responsibilities without waiting to be directed.Why join us    A role with real influence. Commissioning and warranty is where our promises to the customer are tested. We are building a clearer, more structured and more customer-focused way of working around it and you will help us shape it. Your work strengthens the transition between New Sales, Project Management and the Aftermarket organization, with better quality, stronger documentation, reduced cost leakage and stronger customer relationships as the result.    A global and technologically advanced environment. World-leading products for vessel propulsion, experienced colleagues and international customers. You will work closely with Project Management, Technical Support, Field Service, Engineering, our Product Centers and the regional Global Customer Support organizations, and build a cross-functional network across the business that few other roles give you.    Breadth, and room to grow. Few positions combine technology, coordination, customer dialogue, business understanding and continuous improvement the way this one does. It sits in a stable global organization with a strong culture of innovation, and offers good development opportunities in whichever direction you want to take next.    We offer flexible working hours and the option to work remote or from home office.Security Clearance is required for this position.Kongsberg Maritime - a global leader in maritime technology.

jobs.title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
jobs.description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

jobs.title: Master Thesis in Adaptive Architecture for Human-AI Annotation Systems
jobs.description: Company description:.Job description:    Thesis Scope & Problem Statement   This thesis project is intended for two Master's students working together. The central focus of this Master's thesis is to design, implement, and evaluate a confidence-aware adaptiverification architecture within the existing annotation tool. Instead of applying the same review process every detection or scene, the system will use confidence signals to select an appropriate depth of humverification. This is a software engineering thesis focused on how to structure, integrate, test, and evaluathat adaptive behavior, with particular attention to maintainability, traceability, fallback behavior, andeffective human oversight. Existing AI models provide the application context; developing new perceptimodels is not the primary objective. Research Objectives & Tasks   The work may include:      Design and integrate a modular architecture with explicit interfaces for confidence providerverification policies, decision logging, and annotator feedbac     Implement confidence-provider components that expose calibrated or normalized signals, such model confidence, model agreement, source model, and object class frequency, through a comminterface.     Implement and compare interchangeable threshold-based and learned decision policies for routingcases to light review, full review, or a second review. Automatic acceptance will be considered onlywhere permitted by safety policy, with low-confidence, out-of-distribution, and safety-critical casrouted to human review.     Integrate attention cues into the annotation interface and record the signals, policy version, selectedreview mode, and human outcome for each routing decision.     Develop automated tests for routing decisions, component interfaces, and fallback behavior.     Benchmark the adaptive architecture against existing manual, sequential, and parallel workflousing annotation correctness, recall on safety-critical classes, error catch rates, task completion time,routing overhead, and human intervention.     Evaluate maintainability and testability through change scenarios, such as adding a confidenprovider or replacing a decision policy.     Conduct a counterbalanced user study to investigate verification behavior, cognitive workload, trucalibration, and susceptibility to automation bias.  Depending on feasibility and measurable added value, the work may also explore out-of-distributiondetection or vision-language-model-derived scene complexity as additional confidence signals. The coevaluation will use fixed policies during controlled experiments; online adaptation is an optional extension.     Who Are We?   You will join the Verification & Validation (V&V) Virtual Driver team at V.A.S., focused on ensuring tintegrity of the software stack for autonomous decision-making and control. The team brings togetherdevelopers with varied backgrounds and seniority, all centered around robust V&V practices. Theenvironment is friendly and helpful, with both in-office development and in-vehicle testing.     Who Are You?   You are a final-year Master's student in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, withstrong interest in software architecture, software quality, and building maintainable systems. You arecomfortable programming in Python and interested in extending and evaluating an existing softwareplatform in an industrial setting. You should have a foundation in modular software design, interface design, automated testing, and versioncontrol, together with an interest in empirical software engineering. You should be motivated to comparedesign alternatives and connect architectural decisions with measurable effects on correctnesperformance, maintainability, and testability. Familiarity with AI-assisted systems, machine learning, computer vision, or human-computer interaction isadvantageous, but prior specialization in machine learning or object detection is not required. An interest inlearning enough about model confidence and human verification to make sound software design decisis important.     Why Join Us?   This thesis offers an opportunity to apply software engineering methods to a concrete industrial challengdesigning an adaptive human-AI workflow that is maintainable, testable, and auditable. You will build on existing annotation platform and prior thesis results, taking the work from architectural design throughimplementation and empirical evaluation. You will:      Gain hands-on experience in architectural design, component integration, automated testing, andevaluation of an industrial software system.     Investigate how confidence signals can guide human attention while preserving traceability ahuman oversight.     Measure architectural trade-offs across annotation correctness, performance, maintainabilittestability, and human effort.     Collaborate with engineers working on the validation of autonomous transport solutions.    You will gain practical experience in designing and evaluating human-AI systems in a safety-critical context.We look forward to receiving your application letter, academic transcript, and CV in English.           Preferred start date:  January 2027Application deadline: 15 November 2026   We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail. jobs.description: Company description:Who are we?Volvo Cars is a company on a mission; to bring traditional car manufacturing into a connected, sustainable and smart future.Since 1927, we have been a brand known for our commitment to safety, creating innovative cars that make life less complicated for our consumers. In 2010, we decided to transform our business, resulting in a totally new generation of cars and technologies, as well as steady growth and record sales. Today, we’re expanding our global footprint in Europe, China and the US, and we’re on the lookout for new talent. We are constantly pushing our own skills and abilities to drive change in the automobile industry like never before. We are looking for innovative, committed people to join us in this endeavour and create safe, sustainable and connected cars. We believe in the power of people and will challenge and support you to reach your full potential. Join us and be part of Volvo Cars’ journey into the future.Job description:   Let's introduce ourselves   At Volvo Cars, we have bold targets when it comes to innovation, sales and customer experience, and we’re developing new technologies to lead in safety, autonomous driving and electrification. If you want to grow together with talented people creating a new automotive future, we have a job for you.   As a Product Owner on our Mobile Core Developer Experience Team, you will lead the strategy and execution of key features and improvements for our mobile platforms, with a focus on building foundational tools and infrastructure that will empower the entire mobile app ecosystem and enable all App stakeholders to impact value with high quality. You will work cross-functionally with engineering, design, data, and business teams to deliver high-impact solutions that enhance user experiences, improve app performance, and drive overall product growth.     What you'll do   In this role, you will work with engineering teams to define, prioritize, and deliver platform features, infrastructure improvements, and technical enhancements. You are to maintain a well-organized and prioritized backlog, focusing on tactical deliverables that provide immediate value to internal stakeholders. You will also coordinate between multiple stakeholders to balance the needs of the the team operations cover the needs of our internal customers. You are to define key results for the team and success metrics for the platform, guaranteeing the success of each effort and investment. You will also lead and coordinate cross-team initiatives to drive alignment, ensure timely execution, and foster collaboration across departments along with serving as the bridge between product teams and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment in objectives and clarity in communication.   You will prioritize internal and external user needs and feedback, ensuring the platform's base components are intuitive, responsive, and delightful as well as monitor the effectiveness and efficiency of the base components, ensuring continuous improvement based on data and feedback.     What you'll bring   You will bring experience in product management, ideally with platform product experience. You bring proven experience successfully launching and scaling mobile app features or platforms in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You also have a comprehensive understanding of technical platform concepts, such as API design, identity and access systems, permissions management, security, and compliance. You also bring strong understanding of user experience design and its impact on product growth. You are an effective communicator and bring collaboration skills and experience in managing and prioritising various stakeholders and their needs. You have the ability to grow and inspire a team towards a shared vision along with an analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making.   #LI-DNI#LI-DNP

There will be a particular focus on Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).As an experienced Accountant, you will join a team of seven professionals and play a key role in all activities related to asset accounting.Your responsibilities:- Coordinate regular register(s) updates and reviews of useful lives and residual values with other CERN stakeholders.- Analyse CERN projects to identify new assets or consolidation/upgrade of existing assets.- Perform accounting entries related to movements of assets, depreciation/amortisation, and impairment tests.- Support the ongoing ERP transformation project touching the areas of asset accounting and financial accounts.- Perform balance sheet account reconciliations, including a reconciliation of assets register(s) to financial accounts.- Maintain policies, procedures, and controls to ensure efficient, accurate, and compliant asset accounting.- Coordinate physical assets counts.- Support external auditors queries.- Support preparation of the Organization's Financial Statements, including assets related notes and disclosures.- Maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.Your profile:- Proven experience as a general accountant with a focus on asset accounting, such as Property, Plant and Equipment (PPE).- Demonstrated experience with international accounting standards IFRS and/or IPSAS.- Experience preferably acquired in a company handling large volumes of data or in an international organisation.- Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Accounting, Finance or a related field. Accounting certification, such as ACA, CA, CPA, etc.Your skills:- Accounting control and analysis, book-keeping and book-closing.- Financial reporting and analysis, handling large volumes of data.- Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.- Uses openness and honesty to interact constructively with others.- Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.- Demonstrates a willingness to accept changing circumstances; supports initiatives for change.- Works well autonomously; takes on activities and tasks without prompting.- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.Ideal start date: 01/03/2027Contract duration (in months): 60Grade range: 6Benchmark job: 5A0030 - Financial ProfessionalJob flexibility: HybridFor more information abour the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/fap-acc-ga-2026-214-ld-2/

jobs.title: Senior Business Controller
jobs.description: Global business performance, product profitability and long-term development meet in this Senior Business Controller role. Join the Crushing Solutions Division within business area Rock Processing, where you combine business control with product offering support and strategic analysis to help shape our business today and for the future. About your job You work closely with the divisional management team, combining business partnering with analysis that connects performance, priorities and long-term opportunities. As a member of the Product Offering management team, you bring a financial perspective to the development of our offering and its global profitability. You report to the Director of Business Control. Job responsibilities     Monitor, analyze and report on global profitability and business performance, identifying drivers and opportunities for improvement.      Evaluate product profitability and provide financial guidance for product offering and portfolio decisions.     Support forecasting, target-setting, budgeting and scenario analysis.     Translate financial insights into clear recommendations for divisional management and other stakeholders within the Sandvik Group.     Contribute to M&A activities and strategic analysis, bringing a strong financial and commercial perspective to decision-making.     Develop management reporting, dashboards and business analysis that strengthen transparency and business understanding.     Drive improvements in financial processes, data quality and internal controls while ensuring compliance with internal frameworks and applicable regulations. Location and flexibility The position is preferably based in Svedala, Sweden, at a site where activities span materials development and manufacturing. This setting gives you a close connection to the products and operations behind the numbers. Global collaboration and occasional travel may be required. Your profile  You bring solid experience in business control or financial planning and analysis, with a strong understanding of global industrial business models and profitability drivers. You connect detailed analysis with the bigger picture and are comfortable contributing to management-level discussions on product offering, strategy and M&A. Your background includes     Experience in business control within a global industrial organization.     Experience with forecasting, budgeting, reporting and performance follow-up in a matrix organization.     Experience analyzing financial and operational drivers across regions in an international business environment.     Good knowledge of ERP systems, reporting tools and business intelligence solutions, together with excellent communication skills in English. You combine strong analytical skills and an ability to grasp complex issues with commercial curiosity and a strategic mindset. Driven and structured, you take initiative and stay focused when challenges arise. You enjoy collaborating across geographies and functions, build effective stakeholder relationships with a flexible and tactful approach, and communicate complex financial insights clearly and relevantly to different audiences. jobs.title: Material Developer & Team Lead Shanghai Material Team
jobs.description: Klättermusen is looking for a Material Developer & Team LeadWe are seeking a skilled and motivated Material Developer and Team Leader for our material team in Shanghai to join our Purchase & Production team in Åre. The role combines hands-on responsibility for developing fabrics for outdoor products with leadership of the Material Team in Shanghai. The ideal candidate has a strong background in textiles, material science, chemistry, or a related field; experience with technical fabrics; and the ability to lead and develop a team across locations. The role works cross-functionally to develop, test, and implement materials that improve product performance, sustainability, quality, and cost-efficiency, while ensuring clear priorities and effective follow-up within the Shanghai team.This is a full time employment and the position is based in Åre.Key ResponsibilitiesFabric Development:    Collaborate with product design and development teams to source and develop materials that meet the performance, aesthetic, and sustainability goals of our products.    Provide regular updates and reports to the product development team and management.    Ensure that our materials meet regulatory and safety standards and follows Klättermusen's test protocol.    Ensure that all material product cards in the PLM system are accurate and up to date.    Negotiate prices (incl. surcharges), lead times and minimum order quantities with suppliers.Quality Assurance & Testing:    Develop and implement testing protocols to assess material performance under various conditions.    Coordinate the Shanghai Material Team's cooperation with the Quality Team on bulk fabric testing, inspections and quality follow-up, ensuring clear responsibilities and timely information sharing.    Work with the Quality Team to investigate material related quality issues, coordinate with the Shanghai Material Team to agree on corrective and preventive actions with suppliers and follow up on their effectiveness.Sustainability Initiatives:    Identify opportunities to incorporate sustainable materials and practices into product development.    Ensure environmental impact reduction through material innovation/choices.    Ensure that sustainability data for materials is accurate and up to date in the PLM system.    Contribute to sustainability initiatives and other science-driven projects.Team Leadership & Personnel Responsibilities:    Lead and coordinate the Material Team in Shanghai, with a primary focus on bulk fabric follow-up, quality, and the redevelopment and improvement of existing materials.    Set clear priorities, allocate work, and follow up on progress, quality, and seasonal deadlines in alignment with the Material Team in Sweden and relevant cross-functional teams.    Hold regular team meetings and one-to-one meetings, provide feedback and coaching, and support each team member's performance, engagement, and professional development.    Manage personnel responsibilities for the Shanghai Material Team, including performance reviews, individual development plans, absence follow-up, and workplace-related matters, in alignment with company policies and local HR requirements.    Identify staffing and capability needs and participate in recruitment, onboarding, training, and succession planning for the team.    Develop clear ways of working, responsibilities, and escalation routines, and ensure effective collaboration, communication, and knowledge sharing between the teams in Shanghai and Sweden.    Address performance or collaboration issues promptly and escalate material, quality, delivery, or resourcing risks when required.Other:    Establish and maintain relationships with key material suppliers.    Support the commercial team with sustainability and material data.Experience & Skills    Proven experience (3+ years) in fabric and trims development within the outdoor, sports, or technical textile industry, preferably within packs, footwear, and/or waterproof apparel.    Bachelor's degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, or a related field    Strong knowledge of textile manufacturing processes, material properties, testing methods, and fabric construction    Experience with sustainable materials and practices in the footwear, packs, and/or apparel industry    Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with strong attention to detail    Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively with cross-functional and cross-cultural teams    Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and take ownership of projects and initiatives    Proficiency in relevant software tools, such as Microsoft Office and PLM systems    Business-level proficiency in written and spoken English    Experience leading, coaching, or developing a team, including responsibility for performance follow-up and employee development    Ability to lead effectively across locations and build strong collaboration between teams in Sweden and ShanghaiWhat Klättermusen offers    A forward-thinking design environment in a global outdoor brand    A role centered on innovation, exploration, and sustainable product development    Close collaboration with international production, sourcing teams, and testing environments    Opportunities for creative impact and professional growth    A workplace immersed in the outdoors — Åre is both our home and our testing groundWelcome to apply by 2026-11-10. jobs.title: Teacher of Art and Music/ Lärare i musik
jobs.description: MISV is a student-centred international school committed to developing caring, knowledgeable and independent individuals through a high-quality International Baccalaureate (IB) education in a challenging, diverse, and supportive environment. MISV is an IB school for both the Primary Years Programme (PYP) and Middle Years Programme (MYP), and was established in January 2022 to meet the needs of the growing number of expatriate families coming to Västerås for work or study and requiring an international education for their children. As a new school, MISV is in a period of growth and development, opening up the opportunity for enthusiastic and passionate educators to join our small team of hard-working and caring teachers who are united in their commitment to make the world a better place.We are looking for PYP/MYP teachers who:Certified teacher with relevant academic backgroundExperience teaching in the IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) and/or Primary Years Programme (PYP)    Demonstrate flexibility and a willingness to embrace change, a strong desire to collaborate, and a commitment to personal and professional growth.    Plan and implement engaging lessons that foster inquiry, curiosity, and exploration, ensuring the IB PYP framework is delivered to the highest possible standards.    Implement varied and inclusive teaching styles and resources, and provide meaningful feedback to students as they reflect, take action, and demonstrate progress.    Embrace research-backed and innovative teaching and learning strategies, with particular emphasis on constructivism and student agency.    Cultivate a positive classroom environment that contributes to our school-wide culture of care, agency, and international-mindedness, promoting student dignity, self-esteem, and self-efficacy.    Foster strong partnerships with parents/guardians, maintaining open communication and involving them in their child’s educational journey.We ask you to be:    A caring and passionate teacher who can inspire and engage students while providing rigorous instruction.    Experienced in teaching the relevant grade level.    Able to use technology effectively, and to integrate technology meaningfully into teaching and learning.Tjänsten är 75% på IB MISV och 25% på Centuriaskolan som följer svensk läroplan. Båda skolor finns i samma lokaler.

jobs.title: Salkunhallinnan asiantuntija, Auris Energia, Espoo
jobs.description: TehtävänkuvausSalkunhallinnan asiantuntijana vastaat kaasun osto- ja myyntisalkkujen sekä sopimusten päivittäisestä hallinnasta ja optimoinnista. Työskentelet osana tiivistä kaasun hankinta- ja portfolionhallintatiimiä ja raportoit suoraan kaasun myyntiliiketoiminnasta vastaavalle johtajalle. Roolissasi pääset pyörittämään päivittäistä Suomi–Baltia-alueen kaasupörssikauppaa, ylläpitämään tase- ja hinnoittelumalleja sekä seuraamaan kaasumarkkinoiden kehitystä analyysien ja laskelmien avulla. Työskentelet roolissa Espoon toimistolla hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.Tarjoamme:- Mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan kiehtovalle ja kehittyvälle energia-alalle.- Vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin, jossa pääsee kehittämään osaamistaan ja tekemään itsenäisiä ratkaisuja.- Aseman tiiviissä asiantuntijatiimissä, jossa työskennellään yhdessä yhteisten tavoitteiden eteen.- Toimipisteen Espoossa hyvien kulkuyhteyksien äärellä.Työtehtävät- Päivittäinen operatiivinen kaasukauppa: Suoritat kaasun ostosopimusten nominoinnit, siirtokapasiteettitilaukset sekä käyt kauppaa Suomi–Baltia-alueen kaasupörssissä ja hallinnoit Latvian kaasuvarastoa.- Salkun- ja taseenhallinta: Ylläpidät ja kehität kaasun portfoliomallia, tasehallintamallia sekä optimoit kaasun ja biokaasun osto- ja myyntisalkuja.- Markkina-analyysit ja laskelmat: Seuraat Suomen ja Euroopan kaasumarkkinoita, laadit analyyseja sisäiseen käyttöön ja energiamarkkinaviestintään sekä toteutat hinnankiinnityksiä asiakkaille.- Myynnin ja mallien kehitys: Osallistut myynnin hinnoittelumallien, tuoterakenteen sekä hankinnan toimintatapojen ja -työkalujen kehittämiseen osana tiimiä.- Sopimushallinta ja laskutusaineistot: Huolehdit hinnankiinnityssopimusten ylläpidosta, manuaalisesti laskutettavien asiakkaiden laskutusaineistoista ja ostolaskujen tarkastuksesta.- Järjestelmä- ja dataylläpito: Vastaat käytettävien Excel-mallien ja tietojärjestelmien sujuvasta hallinnasta sekä automaattisen datansiirron valvonnasta ja poikkeamien korjaamisesta.Etsimällämme henkilöllä on:- Soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto (esim. DI, KTM, AMK insinööri tai tradenomi)- Aikaisempaa kokemusta vastaavista energia-alan asiantuntijatehtävistä tai tehtävää hyvin tukeva koulutus- Sujuva tietotekninen osaaminen (erityisesti vahva Excel-osaaminen) sekä valmius ottaa nopeasti haltuun kaasukaupan ja salkunhallinnan erikoisjärjestelmät- Sujuva suullinen ja kirjallinen suomen ja englannin kielen taito.- Järjestelmällinen, tarkka ja huolellinen työskentelyote.- Kyky itsenäiseen päätöksentekoon myös kiireen keskellä.- Erinomaiset tiimi- ja vuorovaikutustaidot.Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen salkunhoidosta sekä sähkö-, kaasupörssi- tai arvopaperikaupasta sekä yleisen energia-alan kokemuksen tai koulutuksen.RekrytointiprosessimmeAcademic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

jobs.title: Lumityöntekijä, ISS Palvelut Oy, Joensuu
jobs.description: Oletko osa-aikatöitä etsivä ja ulkotöistä nauttiva työntekijä? Mikäli vastauksesi on kyllä, voi seuraava tehtävä olla juuri sinua varten!Haemme asiakkaallemme ISS Palvelut Oy:lle LUMITYÖNTEKIJÖITÄ Joensuuhun tulevan lumikauden ajaksi arki- ja viikonloppuvuoroihin.Tehtäviisi kuuluvat pääasiassa käsilumityöt sekä liukkaudentorjunta. jobs.title: Sähköasentaja rakennusprojektiin,
jobs.description: Etsimme nyt sähköasentajaa osaksi Harrinivan hotellityömaan rakennusprojektia! Tämä on loistava tilaisuus sinulle, joka haluat olla mukana toteuttamassa merkittävää rakennushanketta ja nautit käytännönläheisestä työstä. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat monipuoliset sähköasennukset, kuten putkitus, kaapelinveto ja kalustus, osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Toivomme sinulta reipasta asennetta ja perustaitoja sähköasennuksista. Sujuva suomen kielen taito auttaa sinua menestymään tehtävässä. Lisäksi tarvitset voimassa olevan sähkötyöturvallisuuskortin. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisessa ja vaihtelevassa ympäristössä, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi. Lyhyestä kestosta huolimatta tämä työ tarjoaa arvokasta kokemusta ja mahdollisuuden verkostoitua alan ammattilaisten kanssa. Jos olet valmis tarttumaan haasteeseen ja haluat olla mukana rakentamassa jotain ainutlaatuista, tämä paikka voi olla juuri sinua varten. Liity joukkoomme ja tule osaksi projektia, jossa jokaisella on tärkeä rooli!Asiakas tarjoaa majoituksen.

jobs.title: Autosähköasentaja
jobs.description: **Työtehtäväsi vaihtelevat huolloista vaativiin vianetsintöihin ja korjauksiin, joten nykyautojen väylä- ja diagnoositekniikan hallinta on suotavaa. Korjaamoalan koulutuksen ohella odotamme sinulta vähintään kahden vuoden työkokemusta sekä nykyaikaisten testereiden ja oheisohjelmistojen hallintaa. Sähkö- ja hybridiautojen tuntemus on tietenkin plussaa. Arvostamme oma-aloitteisuutta ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä. Kokemuksen ohella yhtä merkitsevää on halu oppia ja kehittyä edelleen sekä positiivinen määrätietoinen asenne.****Tarjoamme sinulle taitojesi mukaisen kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, koulutusta osaamisesi tueksi ja mahdollisuuden kehittyä osana rautaista ammattilaisten tiimiämme. Tule mukaan kohtaamaan tämän ja huomisen päivän haasteet ja tehtävät sekä kasvamaan yhdessä menestyvän yrityksen kanssa!****Haku päättyy sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

jobs.title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja
jobs.description: Oletko varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja, joka haluaa johtaa pedagogiikkaa, kehittää yhteisöllistä toimintakulttuuria ja vaikuttaa aidosti lasten oppimiseen, hyvinvointiin sekä osallisuuteen? Verkanappuloilla pääset tekemään juuri sitä osana osaavaa ja kehittyvää työyhteisöä.Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana vastaat pedagogisen toiminnan suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja arvioinnista sekä johdat tiimisi pedagogista toimintaa. Rakennat yhdessä tiimin kanssa oppimisympäristöjä, jotka innostavat lapsia tutkimaan, oppimaan ja kasvamaan turvallisessa sekä osallistavassa ympäristössä.Meillä opettaja ei jää yksin. Saat tueksesi osaavan työyhteisön, aktiivisen pedagogisen verkoston sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi osana yhteisöpedagogiikkaan perustuvaa toimintakulttuuria.Tule mukaan tiimiimme rakentamaan varhaiskasvatusta, joka tekee aidosti eron lasten ja perheiden arjessa!MEILLÄ VARHAISKASVATUKSEN OPETTAJANA OLET TIIMINVETÄJÄ, PEDAGOGINEN JOHTAJA JA YHTEISÖLLISEN TOIMINTAKULTTUURIN RAKENTAJAMitä saat meillä?Meillä saat enemmän kuin työpaikan. Saat mahdollisuuden tehdä merkityksellistä työtä, vaikuttaa, kehittyä ammattilaisena ja rakentaa työarkea, joka sopii myös omaan elämäntilanteeseesi. * Aidot mahdollisuudet vaikuttaa Pääset vaikuttamaan omaan työhösi, pedagogiikkaan ja työyhteisösi kehittämiseen sekä siihen, millaista laadukasta varhaiskasvatusta rakennamme yhdessä. * Hyvinvointia tukevan työarjen Haluamme, että työssä voi onnistua ja voida hyvin. Panostamme ennakoivasti työhyvinvointiin, työkykyyn ja sujuvaan arkeen. * Läsnä olevan ja valmentavan johtamisen Esihenkilösi on arjessa lähellä ja tukee sinua työssäsi ja kehittymisessäsi. Lähes jokaisessa päiväkodissamme on oma päiväkodin johtaja. * Mahdollisuuksia oppia ja rakentaa omaa urapolkuasi Saat vastuuta ja tukea osaamisesi kehittämiseen. Tarjoamme palkallisia opiskelupäiviä ja mahdollisuuksia edetä urallasi esimerkiksi esihenkilö- tai asiantuntijatehtäviin. * Joustavuutta eri elämäntilanteisiin Voit työskennellä 60–100 % työajalla. SAK-työaikaa voit mahdollisuuksien mukaan tehdä osittain etänä. jobs.description: Lähihoitaja (keikkatyö), Onnikoti Aalto, PoriTule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä ainutlaatuiseen joukkoommeuuteen Onnikoti Aaltoon, Poriin!Haemme nyt lähihoitajia keikkatyöhön uuteen, kauniiseen ja moderniin kotiimme. Arkemme on toiminnallista jajärjestämme jatkuvasti aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.Kuka sinä olet?Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinenhenkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut kehitysvammaisten parissa työskentelystä.Osaaminen kehitysvammaisten kanssa työskentelystäkatsotaan eduksesi.Miksi tulisit meille töihin?Uudessa yksikössä pääset alusta asti mukaan rakentamaan ja kehittämään toimintaamme, myös keikkalaisena. Onnikoti Aallossa tulet osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitätehdään positiivisella asenteella kaikkia kunnioittaen. Jokainen työntekijä perehdytetään työhön työsuhteen alussa.Työ on vuorotyötä ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:n G20C mukainen. Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa.Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa, tuberkuloosiselvitystä ja salmonellatodistusta sekä voimassa olevaa Suosikki/Terhikki-rekisteröintiä, ammattikorttia ja hygieniapassia.Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitetturikosrekisteriote.Haethan tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin viimeistään 22.11.2026. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.Kerron mielelläni lisää:Yksikönjohtaja Veera Vanhatalopuh. 040 684 5004 (arkisin klo 8–16)veera.vanhatalo@onnikodit.fiKoti täynnä ainutlaatuista elämäniloa.Onnikodeissa tarjoamme tukea tarvitsevalle kodin, jossa hän voi elää mahdollisimman antoisaa ja turvallista arkea. Panostamme yksilöllisyyteen sekä laatuun ja palvelumme lähtökohtana ovat aina asukkaan omat ainutlaatuiset ominaisuudet, vahvuudet, mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä tuen tarpeet.Onnikodit on osa Mehiläistä.
