jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.

As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

  • Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

  • Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

  • Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

  • Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

  • Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

  • Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

  • Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

  • PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

  • 12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

  • Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

  • Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

  • Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

  • Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

  • Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

  • Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

  • Management experience

  • English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

jobs.title: Salivastaava / The Barö
jobs.description: **Intohimona laatu, luonto ja elämykset? Etsimme ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa The Barö -hotelliin!**Etsimme Inkoon upeaan saaristomaisemaan The Barö -hotelliin energistä, itsenäistä ja sydämellään työtä tekevää ravintolasalin esihenkilöä / salivastaavaa.Jos sinulla on aito intohimo laadukasta ruokaa, juomaa ja ensiluokkaista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan ja haluat olla mukana luomassa unohtumattomia elämyksiä uniikissa premium-ympäristössä, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö!**Työnkuvasi:**- **Käytännön työnjohto ja sali:** Toimit salitiimin esihenkilönä, minkä lisäksi osallistut aktiivisesti suorittavaan työhön ja toimit itse myös À la carte -tarjoilijana. Varmistat omalla esimerkilläsi, että asiakaspalvelumme laatu on aina ensiluokkaista. - **Juomatuotteen kehittäminen:** Suunnittelet hotellin uniikin cocktail-listan, trendikkäät ja laadukkaat mocktailit sekä vastaat muista juomatuotteista. - **Sommelierin rooli:** Vastaat ravintolamme laadukkaista viineistä, toimit viiniasiantuntijana ja suosittelet asiakkaillemme täydellisiä makupareja. _Etkö ole vielä valmis sommelier? Ei hätää – me The Barössä olemme valmiita kouluttamaan sinut tähän rooliin, jos asenteesi on kohdallaan!_ **Mitä odotamme sinulta?**- Aitoa, palavaa intohimoa ja kiinnostusta ruoka- ja juomakulttuuria sekä korkeatasoista asiakaspalvelua kohtaan. - Sujuvuutta ja varmuutta À la carte -tarjoilussa sekä halua toimia tiimin veturina vauhdikkaissakin tilanteissa. - **Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta:** Hotellimme sijaitsee upealla paikalla luonnon keskellä, jonne ei pääse julkisilla kulkuvälineillä. Tehtävän hoitaminen ja työmatkat edellyttävät siksi omaa autoa. - Arvostamme oikeaa asennetta, oppimishalua ja käytännön kokemusta. **Ravintolamme arki ja rytmi:**Työpäiväsi ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevat viikonpäivien mukaan:- **Viikonloppuisin** tarjoilemme korkeatasoista À la carte -illallista sekä lauantaisin maistuvaa lounasta. - **Arkisin** hotellimme täyttyy yrityskokouksista, yksityistilaisuuksista ja muista tapahtumista, jotka tuovat vaihtelua työviikkoon. **Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**- **Työsuhde ja tunnit:** Kyseessä on vakituinen työsuhde. Tarjolla on täydet tunnit, noin 160 h / kk. - **Palkkaus:** Tuntipalkka MaRa TES mukaisesti. Voit esittää palkkatoiveesi. Alkuvuodesta mahdollisuus siirtyä kuukausipalkkaiseksi suoraan The Barön kirjoille, jolloin kiinteästä kuukausipalkasta sovitaan erikseen. - Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi (esim. sommelier-koulutus) ja vaikuttaa suoraan ravintolamme juoma- ja palvelutuotteeseen. - Upean ja inspiroivan työympäristön sekä lämminhenkisen tiimin tuen. Vuonna 2021 avattu **The Barö** on ekologisesti rakennettu, korkealuokkainen premium-tason boutique-saaristohotelli. Se sijaitsee Inkoon upeassa Barösundissa, vain reilun tunnin ajomatkan päässä Helsingistä. Hotellikokonaisuus on suunniteltu sulautumaan harmonisesti ympäröivään luontoon sitä kunnioittaen, ja se koostuu uniikeista, erillisistä maisemahuoneista, tyylikkäästä rantasaunasta sekä korkeatasoisesta **The Berg -ravintolasta**. Asiakkaille tarjotaan ensiluokkaisia ruoka- ja juomaelämyksiä, yksilöllistä palvelua sekä rauhoittumista saaristoluonnon syleilyssä ympäri vuoden.**Job To Do** on henkilöstöpalveluyritys, joka on erikoistunut tapahtuma- ja ravintola-alan henkilöstötarpeitten täyttämiseen. Tavoitteena on muuttaa henkilöstöpalvelutoimialaa inhimillisemmäksi ja innostavammaksi. Arvojamme ovat joustavuus, ammattitaito, kumppanuus ja turvallisuus. Välitämme ihmisiä, joista välitämme.**Heräsikö kysymyksiä?**Laita meille sähköpostia **rekry@jobtodo.fi**, vastaamme kaikkiin kysymyksiisi. Pidäthän varmuuden vuoksi silmällä myös roskapostikansiotasi.Emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse.Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Myyjä kodinturva-alalle
jobs.description: **Myyjänämme edustat Suomen suosituinta kodinturva-alan hälytysjärjestelmää ja työskentelet Great Place to Work -sertifioidussa organisaatiossa. Mikäli tämä kuulostaa sinulle sopivalta työpaikalta, jatka lukemista alta!****Huomioithan, että tämä ei ole kesätyötehtävä. Etsimme myyjiä, jotka haluavat työskennellä meillä kokoaikaisesti myös kesän jälkeen.****Miltä arkesi näyttää meillä?**Myyjänämme liikut Verisuren tarjoamalla käyttöetuautolla ja toimit hälytysjärjestelmäpalvelumme asiantuntijana. Työsi keskiössä on asiakkaan tiloissa tehtävä turvakartoitus, jossa arvioit kohteen turvallisuustarpeet ja suunnittelet siihen parhaan ratkaisun. Tavoitteenasi on rakentaa asiakkaalle räätälöity turvasuojaus ja varmistaa hänen kotinsa tai yritystilojensa turvallisuus.Viikkokalenterisi koostuu valmiiksi sovituista turvakartoituksista sekä itse hankkimistasi asiakaskäynneistä, koulutuksia ja tiimipalavereja unohtamatta. Kun turvakartoitukset alkavat onnistua ja tuottamaan kauppoja, koulutamme sinut asentamaan kaupatut hälytysjärjestelmät asiakkaidesi kohteisiin. Pääset parhaimmillaan tarjoamaan asiakkaallesi kokonaisvaltaisen palvelukokemuksen ensikohtaamisesta tapaamiseen, ja lopulta järjestelmän asentamiseen. Työpäiväsi ovat liikkuvia ja vaihtelevia, ja työtä tehdään arkipäivisin lähtökohtaisesti klo 12:00–20:00. Perehdytyksen jälkeen aikataulut muuttuvat joustavammiksi ja pääset itse vaikuttamaan siihen, miten järjestät asiakaskäyntisi.**Kelle tämä työ sopii?**Mikäli koet syttyväsi tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta ja konkreettisista onnistumisista, löytyy sinulta hyvät eväät työssä menestymiseen. Myös tietty pilke silmäkulmassa kilpailullisuuden suhteen antaa hyvää lisäpotkua tekemiseen. Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta suoramyynnin tai turvallisuusalan parista, mutta voit olla myös esimerkiksi tavoitteellista myyntityötä etsivä alanvaihtaja, joka etsii uusia haasteita uralleen. Kurkkaa urasivuiltamme www.verisure.fi/ura, millaista arki Verisuren myyjänä voi olla.**Mitä edellytämme:**- B-luokan ajokortti (manuaali) ja valmius liikkua työtehtävissä Verisuren käyttöetuautolla. - Sujuvat yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaidot suomen kielellä, kyky kohdata asiakkaat ammattimaisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti. - Motivaatio oppia palvelut ja tuotteet sekä kyky toimia tavoitteellisesti ja vastuullisesti. - Tavoitteellisuutta ja innokkuutta suoramyyntiä kohtaan. - Kyky toimia itsenäisesti, suunnitella ja toteuttaa työtehtäviä ilman jatkuvaa ohjausta perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen jälkeen. - Kokemusta asiakastyötä tai itsenäistä tekemistä sisältävistä rooleista. - Käytännön valmiudet ottaa asiakaskohtaamiset ja päätöksenteko hallintaan kenttätyössä. - Turvasuojaajakortin edellyttämä nuhteettomuus rikosrekisterissä. Neuvomme kortin hankinnassa aina työsuhteen alkaessa. **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Kannustavan palkkamallin, maksamme noin 300€/kauppa provisioista. Keskimäärin myyjämme tienaavat noin **3000-5000€ / kk**, ja parhaiten tienaavat yltävät **10 000€ / kk tai sen yli.** - **Takuupalkan 2000€/kk** työsuhteen kolmena ensimmäisenä kuukautena, joka koostuu 500€ pohjapalkasta ja 1500€/kk takuuprovisiosta. Tuemme alkuvaiheen onnistumistasi maksamalla korotettuja provisioita työn ensimmäisten kuukausin aikana. - Käyttöetuauton, jolla pääset liikkumaan sekä työ- että vapaa-ajalla. - Kattavan perehdytyksen ja tuen koko työsuhteesi aikana. Aloitat työsi neljän päivän koulutuskurssilla toimistolla, jonka jälkeen perehdytys jatkuu kentällä yhdessä kouluttajien sekä esihenkilösi kanssa. Katso Youtube kanavaltamme (Verisure Suomi) videoltakouluttajamme Peterin esittely siitä, miten koulutamme sinut tehtävään. - Miellyttävän ja välittävän työyhteisön. Olemme myös tutkitusti hyvä työnantaja. Meille on myönnetty Great Place to Work -sertifikaatti. Lisäksi sijoituimme Suomen parhaat työpaikat -gaalassa keskisuurten yritysten kategoriassa. - Yhteistä tekemistä ja paljon erilaisia tapahtumia. Pääset esimerkiksi tutustumaan sekä näkemään eri kaupungeissa työskenteleviä myyjiä koko firman myyntitapahtumien yhteydessä, tai nauttimaan koko organisaatiolle järjestettävässä Inspiration Day –kesätapahtumassa. - Myyntikilpailuja, joista voit voittaa mm. Ulkomaanmatkoja. Katso tästäInstagram tililtämme video myyjiemme palkintomatkasta Saksaan. - Mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi – tällä hetkellä lähes jokainen kenttämyynnin esihenkilö on edennyt tehtäväänsä talon sisältä. Katso tarinoita urasivuiltamme sekä sosiaalisen median tileiltämme. - Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten käyttöetuauto, kattava työterveyshuolto Mehiläisellä, hammaslääkärietu, lounasetu, liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut. Pääset tutustumaan meihin sekä Verisuren myyntityöhön tarkemmin sosiaalisen median tiliemme kautta TikTokissa ja Instagramissa @verisurelaiset.**Kun kyse on työpaikasta, melko hyvä ei riitä. Parasta olla Verisure.**Verisuren myyjänä seisot ylpeästi tuotteesi takana ja turvaat samalla ihmisten kodit sekä yritystilat suomen suosituimmalla sekä luotetuimmalla kodinturva-alan palvelulla. Lähetä hakemus tehtävään sivulla olevasta linkistä. Käsittelemme hakemuksia hakuaikana, ja paikat täytetään aina sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä.Lisätietoja tehtävästä voit tarvittaessa tiedustella rekrytiimiltä sähköpostitse osoitteesta rekry@verisure.fi.

jobs.title: Technical Plant Support Technician
jobs.description:
Als Technical Plant Support Technician (TPS) ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt bij storingen van utilities installaties. (Elektriciteit, cooling & heating, HVAC).

  • Je neemt het alarm aan op het alert-systeem en doet de eerstelijnsinterventie. Bij uitvallen van de installatie neem je acties om de installatie binnen de kortst mogelijke tijdspanne terug operationeel te krijgen.
  • Je werkt hierbij steeds volgens de geldende Pfizer veiligheidsprocedures en algemene GMP.
  • Correct rapporteren van voorvallen in een gevalideerd systeem behoort ook tot de taak en is belangrijk voor verdere impactbepaling door QA.
  • Je werkt zeer kwaliteitsgericht en volgt afspraken na, ook al sta je onder tijdsdruk.
  • Je escaleert (wederkerende) storingen en doet samen met de zone-ingenieurs onderzoek naar grondoorzaken, waarbij je ook voorstellen doet ter verbetering.
  • Preventieve- en curatieve onderhoudstaken behoren eveneens tot je takenpakket.
  • Daarnaast doe je ook periodieke checks op installaties volgens voorgeschreven controlelijsten. (nooddiesels, sprinklerinstallaties, stoomketels, waterinstallaties, …)
  • Je hecht veel belang aan veilig werken. Je meldt onveilige situaties aan supervisie en spreekt collega´s aan op onveilige handelingen of onveilig gedrag.
  • Je zal werken in een vijfploegensysteem.
  • Bachelor diploma in elektromechanica, Elektriciteit, HVAC of gelijkwaardig door relevante ervaring
  • Zeer brede technische kennis: Hoogspanning, sterkstroom, mechanisch, pneumatisch, meet- en regeltechniek, automatisatie
  • Zin om complexe problemen te analyseren
  • Prioriteiten inschatten op basis van algemene richtlijnen
  • Autonoom aan de slag gaan
  • Vlotte en duidelijke communicatie naar collega's en interne klanten
  • Objectief rapporteren op basis van feiten en meetcijfers
  • Kwaliteitsgericht werken

jobs.title: Safeguarding Lead - Safeguarding Unit (f/x/m) - Brussels
jobs.description:
Global Safeguarding Strategy and Culture

  • Enhance and oversee the delivery of the OCB Safeguarding Strategy ensuring it is enhanced, developed, and maintained and monitored, and is a mainstreamed issue within OCB

  • Provide strategic vision to drive through essential, systematic integration of SG into all of OCB's work

  • Act as strategic lead for all constituents of safeguarding in OCB operations, with specific emphasis on preventative aspects of work

  • Build a culture that embodies a consistent tone, energy and language on Safeguarding

  • In close collaboration with OCB departments and Executive Leadership Team, drive the integration of safeguarding roles and responsibilities throughout all aspects of OCB's work

OCB Safeguarding Systems, Policies and Systems

  • Ensure that standards of safeguarding are maintained across all parts of OCB

  • Ensure a robust and effective case management process & work to enhance the case management system

  • Ensure the development of staff capacity through the promotion and embedding of safeguarding policies and procedures across the movement

  • Oversee the Case Management and Reporting Standard Operating Procedure (SOPs)

  • Enhance and maintain OCB Safeguarding standards and Operating Procedures to take into consideration learning through implementation and necessary changes

Thought Leadership and Influencing

  • Participate in stakeholder engagement including participation in international sector platforms on safeguarding, benchmarking market best practice and positioning OCB as a thought subject -matter leader

  • Strengthen the SG voice within program design, risk assessment and mitigation and safe programming in a coordinated and consistent way

  • Ensure the integration of safe programming and safeguarding risk management throughout the project cycle, including safe and accessible community-based reporting mechanisms for SEAH and adequate safeguarding response capacity at country level, in close collaboration with the Operational Department

  • Lead the coordination of safeguarding positioning and external engagement within the wider sector and represent OCB externally on sector wide debates on safeguarding management

Leadership of Safeguarding resources

  • Engage with the members of the IPOB and Safeguarding network of colleagues across the movement

  • Lead, support, and develop the OCB Safeguarding Team

  • Management and leadership of the safeguarding team

  • Ownership and management of the Safeguarding Unit budget

  • Work with the HR Director to ensure compliance with safeguarding policies, including safe recruitment practices

  • Monitor activity to ensure there is an adequate resource for the Safeguarding Unit

Education & Experience

  • Relevant qualification in safeguarding, law, ethics, social work, gender-based violence or a related field, and/or at least five (5) years' experience preventing, detecting and responding to sexual exploitation, abuse, harassment and other forms of misconduct

  • Sexual Exploitation, Abuse and Harassment (SEAH) investigation qualification (e.g. CHS Tier 3, CFE, CFF, CPA, CCEP or equivalent recognised certification)
  • Minimum five (5) years' experience in a strategic role within a complex organisation
  • Minimum five (5) years' experience working within an international NGO, UN agency or comparable international environment
  • Experience leading or conducting safeguarding investigations and managing highly sensitive and confidential matters
  • Experience working in multicultural and transversal environments and building trust across all organisational levels
  • Experience leading and developing multicultural teams

Competencies

  • Critical thinking, analytical and decision-making skills for the protection of vulnerable people

  • People management, team leadership and influencing skills in complex organisational cultures
  • Strong cross-cultural communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Experience in multicultural and transversal environments
  • Ability to synthesise information from multiple sources with strong attention to detail
  • Experience drafting strategic documents, policies, standard operating procedures and guidelines
  • Strong organisational and time management skills
  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion
  • Strong commitment to creating a safe working environment where people are heard and concerns are addressed
  • Integrity, ethical judgement and self-awareness

Languages

  • Proficiency of English, both written and spoken is mandatory

  • Good knowledge of French, Spanish, or Arabic is an asset

Other

  • Availability for international travel, including programme visits and safeguarding-related meetings

jobs.title: Service Advisor - Boortmeerbeek
jobs.description:
Wat ga je doen als Service Advisor bij BMW?

  • Je verwelkomt klanten die langskomen voor onderhoud of herstelling van hun wagen en zorgt meteen voor een vriendelijke en professionele ontvangst. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt en zorgt ervoor dat elke klant zich gehoord en geholpen voelt.
  • Je maakt een duidelijke en efficiënte planning op waarbij je rekening houdt met de wensen van de klant, de capaciteit van de werkplaats en de beschikbaarheid van onderdelen. Je vormt hierbij de belangrijke schakel tussen de klant en de werkplaats.
  • Dankzij jouw proactieve en positieve communicatie blijven klanten steeds goed op de hoogte van de voortgang van de werken en eventuele wijzigingen.
  • Je volgt klantendossiers nauwkeurig op en zorgt ervoor dat alle administratie correct en overzichtelijk verwerkt wordt.
  • Bij de teruggave van de wagen neem je de tijd om samen met de klant de uitgevoerde werken en de factuur te overlopen. Eventuele vragen of opmerkingen behandel je professioneel en oplossingsgericht.
  • Je streeft elke dag naar een uitstekende klantentevredenheid en bouwt met jouw servicegerichte aanpak aan een duurzame relatie met de klant.

Waarmee kan je ons team versterken?

  • Je bent een enthousiaste autoliefhebber die graag bijleert. Ervaring in een gelijkaardige functie is een pluspunt, maar je servicegerichte ingesteldheid is het belangrijkste.
  • Je zet je elke dag in voor een uitmuntende klantenervaring en bent een echte ambassadeur van BMW.
  • Een gezonde dosis administratief werk schrikt je niet af en je bent organisatorisch sterk.
  • Je bent een vlotte communicator die zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband goed functioneert.
  • Je denkt oplossingsgericht en neemt initiatief.
  • Woorden zoals communicatief, positief, stressbestendig en flexibel passen perfect bij jouw persoonlijkheid.

jobs.title: Instruments Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
As an Instruments Manufacturing Engineer, you will play a key role across the full product lifecycle of surgical instruments, from setting up new assembly lines to driving continuous improvement once production is up and running. You will make sure every product can be built reliably and efficiently and meet yield and performance as volumes grow. Working closely with the Production team, you will provide hands-on line support and troubleshooting and help ramp up production.

Duties & Responsibilities :

· Set up and continuously optimize assembly lines to increase production capacity of surgical instruments.

· Lead manufacturing process development, validation, verification and equipment qualification activities to support production readiness and process sustainability.

· Provide day-to-day line support troubleshooting to keep production running and support production ramp-up.

· Drive continuous improvement of production, using data-driven problem-solving and root-cause analysis to identify issues and improve processes and design.

· Identify and lead value improvement initiatives that enhance quality, cost, capacity, efficiency and operational performance.

· Review field complaints related to medical devices, and contribute to root-cause analysis and corrective actions.Initiate, assess impacts on technical and quality aspects, and execute Change Requests, and associated Design Transfers to production.

· Update the technical documentation of the Device Master Records (DMR) in coordination with R&D, CMO and/or suppliers.

· Participate in the creation and the continuous update of the risk management file in coordination with R&D, CMO and/or suppliers.

· Be the voice of manufacturing during product development to ensure products can be manufactured reliably and efficiently.

Requirements

Requirements :

· Bachelor's degree in engineering (mechanical, industrial, or equivalent).

· 2+ years of experience in manufacturing engineering, industrialization, process development or production support of high-volume complex assemblies within a highly regulated industry (e.g. medical device, aeronautical, automotive).

· Demonstrated ability to analyse technical problems, propose solutions and drive improvements in a manufacturing environment.

· Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies, including Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or structured problem-solving approaches.

· Experience in leading process validation, verification, or manufacturing process development activities.

· Experience in manufacturing equipment qualification.

· A track record of successfully bringing complex products into production.

· Knowledge of medical device quality standards and regulations (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA 21 CFR 820) is a plus.

· Fluent in English and French.

Benefits

What we offer:

  • A dynamic, innovative environment with cutting-edge medical technology that is shaping the future of robotic surgery.
  • Fast-growing Company where innovation meets agility.
  • Structured onboarding program and training, ensuring a confident start.
  • High degree of autonomy and flexibility.

jobs.title: Industrialization Engineer, Instruments
jobs.description:
As an Industrialization Engineer, Instruments, you will play a key role in bringing our surgical instruments and accessories from design to production. You will define manufacturing strategy, develop processes and/or lines, and transfer the design to our contract manufacturers and suppliers. You will make sure that products can be built reliably and meets quality, yield and performance targets as volumes grow. Reducing the COGS of our instruments will also be a key objective of your role. You will work closely with R&D, Quality, Production team and suppliers to support the ramp-up and the continuous improvement of our instruments manufacturing lines.

Duties & Responsibilities :

• Lead the industrialization, design transfer and manufacturing ramp-up of new product or new feature introduction project related to surgical instruments, accessories and their components, in close partnership with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturers and Suppliers.

• Analyse the cost of the instrument, review the manufacturing processes and components, identify, evaluate and implement cost reduction opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of manufacturing processes using data-driven problem-solving and root-cause analysis to improve yield, quality, cost and efficiency.

• Lead manufacturing process development, validation or verification and equipment qualification activities.

• Contribute to the improvement of test strategies, and to the definition and implementation of on-line and end-of-line testing, from requirements to test design and qualification.

• Initiate, assess and lead Manufacturing Change Requests in coordination with R&D, Quality, Contract Manufacturer and suppliers. Update the technical documentation (DMR) and the risk management file (FMEA) and ensure compliance with relevant standards, regulations and Distalmotion's QMS.

• Be the voice of manufacturing during product development to ensure that products can be manufactured reliably and efficiently.

Je houdt je bezig met preventief onderhoud, het oplossen van storingen en het doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.Je krijgt veel zelfstandigheid en ruimte om werkzaamheden te plannen, knelpunten aan te pakken en onderhoudsprocessen verder te verbeteren. jobs.title: Vrachtwagenmonteur met APK 1-bevoegdheid - Nuenen
jobs.description: Wat ga je doen?Als vrachtwagenmonteur met APK 1-bevoegdheid werk je dagelijks aan het onderhouden, repareren en keuren van vrachtwagens en andere zware bedrijfswagens. jobs.title: Fitnessinstructeur
jobs.description: TAKEN EN VERANTWOORDELIJKHEDEN- Geef boeiende fitnessinstructie en groepslessen die leden van alle niveaus motiveren- Zorg voor de dagelijkse gang van zaken in de fitnessfaciliteit en een soepele, efficiënte dienstverlening- Ondersteun en motiveer klanten, alleen of in groepen, bij het opbouwen van gezonde, actieve gewoontes- Werk flexibel op locaties in de regio en pas je elke week aan een nieuw rooster aanWAT JIJ MEEBRENGT- Oprechte passie voor fitness en het helpen van mensen bij het opbouwen van gezondere gewoontes- Zelfverzekerde, energieke communicator die zowel individuen als groepen kan motiveren- Flexibel en aanpasbaar, en op je gemak bij wisselende werktijden op meerdere locaties- Betrouwbaar en zelfstandig, en op je gemak bij het werken met minimaal toezichtTwee merken. Één team. ROVA Health is wat er gebeurt wanneer twee gevestigde namen in gezondheid en welzijn niet langer naast elkaar, maar samen verder gaan. Gebouwd op meer dan een eeuw erfgoed van Westfield Health Group en gedreven door de overtuiging dat de manier waarop mensen leven, werken en herstellen fundamenteel is veranderd - wij bestaan om daar iets aan te doen. Dit is een platform met een doel, gebouwd door mensen die het graag goed doen. Als je bij ons komt werken, begin je niet zomaar een nieuwe baan. Je helpt mee bepalen wat er nu komt.Geen twee dagen zijn hetzelfde, en dat is precies de bedoeling. Als onze Fitness Coach ga je naartoe waar de energie het hardst nodig is.Je bent een energieke motivator die mensen in beweging brengt, alleen of in een groep, wat hun ervaring of energieniveau ook is. Samen met ons team help je de dagelijkse activiteiten van onze fitnessfaciliteiten te runnen en zorg je dat alles soepel blijft lopen voor onze leden.Je wordt ingezet in de hele regio, met flexibel ingeroosterde diensten van 7 uur. Geen twee weken zijn hetzelfde, en het kan zijn dat je op het laatste moment ergens nieuws wordt ingezet. Voor die flexibiliteit ontvang je een maandelijkse back-upbonus naast je salaris.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description: Ben jij de accountmanager die nieuwe kansen om zet naar langdurige relaties? Lees dan snel verder.G-Nius zoekt een enthousiaste accountmanager: Als Account Manager ben je commercieel gedreven, ondernemend, energiek, verkoop- en resultaatgericht. Je werkt proactief aan een solide en langdurige samenwerking met zowel opdrachtgevers als met professionals.Daarnaast ben je continu op zoek naar het maken van de perfecte match tussen professionals en opdrachtgevers. Je draagt de zorg en verantwoordelijkheid voor het beheer van jouw relatiebestand. Dit bestand bestaat voornamelijk uit opdrachtgevers binnen de ICT-, Logistiek- en Managementomgeving.Hiernaast ben je de verbinding tussen onze professionals en opdrachtgevers waarbij kwaliteit en open communicatie hoog in het vaandel staat. Dit doe je door in gesprek te gaan en de wensen en behoeften van beide partijen in kaart te brengen. Alleen zo kan je als Account Manager maatwerk bieden.Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden bestaan uit:Verkoopbeheer, accountbeheer en relatiebeheer.Resourcemanagement.Acquisitie new business.Analyseren van personele behoefte, processen en wensen van de klant en deze vertalen in praktische oplossingen.Commerciële activiteiten, zoals het voeren van verkoopgesprekken, het uitbrengen van offertes, het onderhandelen over en afsluiten van contracten.Werving van professionals.Voeren van sollicitatiegesprekken.Interim- en Recruitment.Contactpunt voor klant en professional.Werken als Account Manager IT Detachering bij G-NiusG-Nius is een onderneming waar een informele maar professionele sfeer heerst. We vinden openheid en betrokkenheid belangrijk.We bieden je een zelfstandig functie binnen een jong en enthousiast team waar eigen initiatieven vanzelfsprekend zijn. Wanneer je er even niet uitkomt staan je collega's voor je klaar om ondersteuning te bieden.Wij vinden het belangrijk dat ons team een hecht team is. Daarom lunchen wij altijd samen. Na de lunch lopen we een rondje door de binnenstad van s-Hertogenbosch om de middag weer vol goede energie te beginnen. Daarnaast organiseren wij leuke evenementen om elkaar, ook buiten kantoor, beter te leren kennen. Wil je meer weten over werken bij G-Nius? Kijk dan op www.werkenbijg-nius.nl.

jobs.title: Facilitair medewerker servicedesk
jobs.description: Geen dag is hetzelfde. jobs.title: Medewerker meldkamer telecom!!
jobs.description: Ben jij een gedreven probleemoplosser en klaar voor een nieuwe uitdaging waar je veel kan leren? Dan is deze rol als Servicedesk Medewerker NOC iets voor jou! jobs.title: IT supportmedewerker
jobs.description: Relevante werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie is vereist. Wijj zijn op zoek naar een IT Support Medewerker die collega-s ondersteunt bij IT-vragen en storingen. jobs.title: Medior asset management professional
jobs.description: Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajectenJe kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbindenJe schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projectenje werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passenafgeronde HBO of WO-opleidingstevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogenklantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatieWerken bij Compris:Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. jobs.title: Medior System & Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: Met welke techniek krijg je te maken?Onder andere met Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Server, Hyper V, networking, VLANs, routing, switching, WiFi, firewalls, VPN, DNS, back up en recovery, endpoint security, EDR, monitoring, scripting en automatisering. We werken daarnaast met professionele MSP tooling voor monitoring, beheer, documentatie en automatisering.Je hoeft echt niet alles al te beheersen. Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. A solid job, attractive employment conditions androom to grow. Competitive salary: €3,000–€3,900 gross per month, based on a 38-hour working week, depending on your experience and qualifications. Pension scheme: a pension plan through PMT and access to collective insurance arrangements. Training and development: access to a learning platform offering more than 300 courses and training programmes. A supportive team: experienced colleagues who value cooperation, knowledge-sharing and technical craftsmanship. Salary, employment conditions and any relocation arrangements will be discussed with you during the recruitment process. The availability and conditions of relocation support will be confirmed individually. Why move to the Netherlands? The Netherlands offers exciting opportunities for skilled technicians who want to grow professionally and gain international experience. By joining Xelvin, you will have the opportunity to: Work with modern technology: gain experience with advanced HVAC systems, increasingly efficient installations and innovative technical solutions. Expand your technical expertise: develop your knowledge through practical experience, collaboration with experienced colleagues and access to training. Build an international career: bring your existing skills to a new working environment and gain valuable international experience. Take ownership of your work: solve technical challenges, make decisions in the field and build strong relationships with customers. jobs.title: Order picker in day shift - open to English speakers!
jobs.description:
Are you already familiar with orderpicking and logistics? And are you looking for a stable and physically engaging role with job security? And do you like great hours to get a good work-life balance? Then this is an excellent opportunity for you!

For a large and growing logistics in Oostkamp specialised in frozen goods, we're looking for an orderpicker to join the day shift team in the freezer warehouse. Do cold temperatures not scare you at all and do you speak English well? Then don't hesitate to apply, because the company is very welcoming to speakers of Dutch and English!

The job

As an orderpicker, you play a crucial part in the company’s logistical process. You work in the freezer every day to prepare orders for supermarkets throughout Europe.

Your responsibilites include:

  • Making orders based on order lists
  • Preparing completed orders for shipment
  • Taking the orders to the loading docks for the trucks

You do all of this using an electrical pallet truck (also known as an "EPT").

Be sure to apply if you:

  • Have experience in orderpicking or other warehouse work
  • Aren't afraid of physically heavy work in a freezer environment
  • Have your own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT) is a big plus, but not required.

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium for this job. Actief cannot help you immigrate nor provide housing. If you don't have an official address in Belgium, you don't qualify and cannot apply !!

jobs.title: Wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Deze bouwgroep is één van de grootste in België en is elke dag actief op meer dan 250 werven. Met maar liefst 2.000 collega’s werken ze samen aan projecten voor wegen, gebouwen, sportfaciliteiten en waterzuivering.

Wat deze werkgever zo bijzonder maakt, is dat ze alles zelf doen: van de productie tot de uitvoering. Dat zorgt voor topkwaliteit, innovatie én werkzekerheid. Medewerkers krijgen volop kansen om te groeien, samen te werken in sterke teams én mee te bouwen aan projecten om trots op te zijn.

Hier draait het om meer dan werken alleen. Welzijn, teamspirit en een goede balans tussen werk en privé zijn erg belangrijk. Wie hier start, krijgt niet alleen een job, maar echt een toekomst.

Solliciteren? Eerst heb je een gesprek met HR en daarna krijg je de kans om ter plaatse te zien hoe de job écht is. Je ontmoet meteen je mogelijke collega’s. Grijp deze kans en bouw mee aan morgen!

Wil jij aan de slag als wegenwerker? Ontdek hier wat jij gaat doen!

  • Je voert onderhouds- en herstellingswerken uit samen met je collega’s
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en zorgt dat het werk op tijd klaar is
  • Je voert diverse taken uit, zoals:
  • Grond- en rioleringswerken

  • Leggen van klinkers en borduren
  • Opwerken van putdeksels

  • Je bent flexibel en steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen.

jobs.title: Rioolarbeider
jobs.description:
Deze aannemer met de vacature van rioolarbeider te Aalst is actief in de wegenbouw, rioleringsaanleg, milieusanering en de aanleg van publieke ruimtes. Hun projecten zijn voor zowel publieke als private opdrachtgevers in Vlaanderen en Brussel. Het bedrijf behoort tot de top 3 spelers op de Belgische infrastructuurmarkt. Vanuit verschillende vestigingen beschikken ze over eigen betonsites, recyclagesites en asfaltproductie-installaties. De bedrijfscultuur is open en samenwerkend: collega’s ondersteunen elkaar om veilig en kwalitatief werk te leveren. Kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid staan centraal, met aandacht voor planning, correcte uitvoering en ruimte om te leren en te groeien.

Jobomschrijving

Als rioolarbeider in de regio Aalst werk je samen met je ploeg op verschillende werven en voer je het onderstaande takenpakket uit:

  • Je vertrekt met je team vanaf een afgesproken opstapplaats in de regio Aalst naar de werf en stemt ter plaatse de dagplanning af met de ploegbaas en werfleiding.
  • Je voert rioleringswerken uit, zoals het maken van huisaansluitingen, het plaatsen van rioleringsbuizen en putten, en het ophogen of vrijmaken van putdeksels.
  • Je plaatst en werkt weginfrastructuur af, waaronder funderingen, kolken, boordstenen, goten en straat- of klinkerwerken.
  • Je gebruikt klein bouwmaterieel en gereedschap voor grond- en wegenwerken, zoals trilplaten, slijpschijven en (kleine) graafmachines.
  • Je houdt de werf ordelijk en veilig, controleert hoogtes en uitzettingen waar nodig, en helpt mee om de uitvoering volgens planning te laten verlopen.

Dit heb je nodig voor de job

Hieronder vind je wat je nodig hebt om op te starten als rioolarbeider voor deze job in de regio Aalst:

  • Je raakt iedere ochtend vlot tot een ophaalpunt in de regio Aalst.
  • Je hebt al (een eerste) ervaring als grondwerker, arbeider in rioleringswerken of wegenwerker.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd om te starten als rioolarbeider en je wil fysiek werken in weer en wind.
  • Je hebt een geldig rijbewijs B of bent er concreet mee aan de slag (praktijklessen en/of praktijkexamen ingepland).
  • Je hecht belang aan veilig en vlot communiceren op de werf.
  • Je kan vroeg starten en je bent flexibel naar werkuren, overuren en werven op verschillende locaties.
De ideale collega is...
  • Iemand die graag werkt in teamverband, vlot afstemt met ploegbaas en collega’s en meehelpt waar nodig om samen vooruitgang te maken.
  • Iemand die veiligheid en orde op de werf serieus neemt: je volgt afspraken, gebruikt materiaal correct en spreekt risico’s tijdig aan.
  • Iemand die flexibel is in werkritme en planning, met bereidheid om vroeg te starten en in overleg extra uren te doen wanneer de werfplanning dat vraagt.
  • Iemand die houdt van buitenwerk en fysiek werk, ook bij wisselende weersomstandigheden: je blijft doorzetten tot het werk klaar is.
  • Iemand die graag slimmer wordt via opleiding en begeleiding on the job.
  • Iemand die nieuwe werkwijzen en technieken snel toepast in de praktijk.

jobs.title: Grondwerker / wegenwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij gepassioneerd door ruwbouw en blijf jij graag met beide voeten op de grond? 

We zijn op zoek naar nieuwe teamleden om onze huidige teams in de regio Antwerpen te versterken. Ons bedrijf is actief in diverse infrastructuurprojecten, variërend van wegenwerken tot asfalt- en betonproductie, inclusief laboratoriumwerk, signalisatie- en onderhoudsdiensten.

Als grondwerker / wegenwerker zal je werken aan grote projecten zoals tunnels, bruggen en stedelijke projecten. Dit binnen een stabiel team en met goede apparatuur om je werk soepel te laten verlopen.

Je takenpakket omvat onder meer:

  • Plaatsing van borduren
  • Rioolaansluiting
  • Algemene grondwerken
  • Beton uitschoten
  • Kolken plaatsen in het wegdek
  • Etc.

Je zal regelmatig in contact komen met buizen van 2 tot 3 meter breed. Daarom vereisen we ervaring met dergelijke grote materialen.

Een rijbewijs is verplicht binnen ons bedrijf, zodat je indien nodig het stuur kunt overnemen. Nacht- of weekendwerk kan worden gevraagd, met een extra toeslag op het loon. Naast de standaardvergoeding ontvang je ook maaltijdcheques (€5.60/dag) en Benefits@Work.

Wij investeren in persoonlijke groei en bieden tal van opleidingsmogelijkheden. 

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een sterke speler in de infrastructuursector?

  • Kennis van de Nederlandse taal
  • Ervaring binnen grond / wegenwerken
  • Rijbewijs B

In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. exposure to Git, Azure Pipelines or scripting is an advantage. • Analytical judgement, with the ability to identify material issues, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into prioritised actions. • Clear and persuasive communication, with effective stakeholder management across technical teams, control functions and senior management. • A structured, pragmatic and results-oriented approach, combined with accountability and the confidence to challenge constructively. • Curiosity about emerging threats and technologies, with the ability to learn quickly and adapt priorities in a changing environment. • Fluent written and spoken English is required. jobs.title: Grondwerker
jobs.description:
Ben jij iemand die energie haalt uit buiten werken, afwisseling en zichtbaar resultaat? Zoek je een job waarin je niet achter een bureau zit, maar elke dag meebouwt aan infrastructuur die écht gebruikt wordt? In deze functie combineer je techniek, beweging en verantwoordelijkheid. Je bent vaak onderweg, werkt op uiteenlopende locaties en geen dag voelt hetzelfde aan. Je krijgt vertrouwen, ruimte om zelfstandig te werken en maakt tegelijk deel uit van een team dat voor elkaar klaarstaat. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en trots op je werk staan centraal. Deze job is ideaal voor wie graag praktisch bezig is, houdt van machines en voldoening haalt uit werk dat tastbaar is. Als jij graag initiatief neemt en je werkdag het liefst in de buitenlucht doorbrengt, dan is dit een uitdaging waarin je je helemaal kan vinden.Jouw taken:

  • Ondergrondse kabels en leidingen correct aanbrengen en afdekken.
  • Sleuven en werkputten maken met machines en manueel gereedschap.
  • Aansluitingen voorbereiden en OV-palen plaatsen.
  • Kabels trekken en verschillende nutsvoorzieningen installeren.
  • Je hebt ervaring met het bedienen van een graafmachine en autolaadkraan.
  • Je hebt een technisch diploma of gelijkwaardige praktijkervaring.
  • Je werkt flexibel en hebt een sterke focus op veilig werken.
  • Je functioneert goed zelfstandig én in samenwerking met collega’s.
  • Je werkt graag buiten en schrikt niet terug voor fysiek werk.
  • Je bent hoofdzakelijk overdag inzetbaar, met bereidheid tot occasioneel nacht- of weekendwerk.
  • Je hebt geen hoogtevrees, ervaring met een hoogtewerker is mooi meegenomen.
  • Een VCA-attest is een extra pluspunt.

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship field of Sociology (Soziologe/Soziologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Sociology. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Susann Wagenknecht, Chair of Micro-Sociology and Technosocial Interaction.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Sociology, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- The (conflict-ridden) negotiation of imaginaries, infrastructures, institutional frameworks, and/or externalities (e.g., emissions, waste, waste heat) associated with energy production and supply across a wide variety of practices, communities, networks, organizations, markets, fields, and/or assemblagesTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree in Sociology or a comparable field in the social sciences, as well as relevant previous experience in the sociological analysis of the environment, technology, or energy, and/or in the field of Science and Technology Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatoryWe offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Educational Science/Media Education. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship  in the field of Civil and Digital Law (Jurist/in)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of Civil and Digital Law. Primary supervision will be provided by Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Juniorprofessorship in Civil Law, Intellectual Property Law, especially Patent Law and Legal Issues of AI.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of Civil and Digital Law, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Energy- and resource-intensive digital infrastructures as a subject of EU regulation- Systemic risks of digital platforms and AI systems in the context of energy use, resource consumption, and ecological sustainability, particularly under the Digital Services Act and the AI Act- Ecological sustainability as a European value and as an interpretative principle in digital law- Law and legal culture as elements of energy and technology cultures, particularly the interactions between legal categories, technological development, societal transformations, and concepts of sustainability- Territorial and extraterritorial limits of European digital regulation in addressing global ecological impactsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Civil and Digital Law. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an above-average university degree in law and have prior knowledge of, or at least a strong interest in, the regulation of digital services and AI, as well as in the role of energy (cultures) and/or ecological sustainability. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the applicable doctoral regulations, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters). Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-004, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Jun.-Prof. Dr. Katharina Kaesling, LL.M., Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Doctoral Fellowship in the field of International Politics (Politologe/Politologin)
jobs.description: In the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, researchers from the Social Sciences and Humanities as well as artists explore the relationships between technology, science, and society. The Lab was initiated by The Schaufler Foundation together with TUD Dresden University of Technology. The Lab's guiding theme for the upcoming third funding phase (April 2027–September 2030) is "Energy Cultures in Transition". The guiding theme is investigated from a humanities, cultural, social, and educational science perspective, explored through artistic practice, and communicated to the public. For the third funding phase, the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden comprises eight doctoral fellowships and an annually changing Artist in Residence program.TUD embodies a university culture that is characterized by cosmopolitanism, mutual appreciation, thriving innovation and active participation. For TUD, diversity is an essential feature and a quality criterion of an excellent university. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.The Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden offers, subject to the availability of resources, aDoctoral Fellowshipfor a period of 2 years, with the option of extension by 1.5 years, starting on April 1, 2027. The fellowship (EUR 1,850 per month, plus a grant for material costs of EUR 150 and, where applicable, a family supplement of EUR 315 per child) is aimed at early-career researchers in the field of International Politics. Primary supervision will be provided by Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Chair of Political Science with a focus on International Politics.The guiding theme Energy Cultures in Transition understands energy as a cultural phenomenon deeply inscribed in aesthetic, historical, political, ecological, economic, and socio-technological practices and systems. Building on the dynamically growing research fields of the Energy Humanities, Science & Technology Studies, and the Digital Humanities, the aim is to examine how modern energy regimes—from petromodernity, to nuclear culture, and post-carbon futures—have shaped not only material infrastructures but also subjectivities, power relations, progress narratives, geopolitical orders, ecologies, and knowledge systems, while simultaneously being shaped by them. Interdisciplinary perspectives from the social sciences, cultural studies, humanities, and educational research represented at the Schaufler Kolleg@TU Dresden enable the analysis of the multifaceted entanglements of energy, culture, and society. The focus is on questions concerning the representation, communication, and aesthetics of energy transitions and resource paradigms as well as continuities between resource economies and information economies, the relationships between energy, labor, environment, and consumer culture, and the role of colonialism, gender, nationalism, geopolitics, education, and social justice in deciding energy futures and navigating collective transformation processes. In the field of International Politics, the following research areas and questions are of particular relevance to the guiding theme:- Research on the transnational transition of energy cultures by linking Political Science and International Relations with Social Movement Studies, Sociology, or Conflict Studies- Energy transformation as a political and social distributional conflict in the context of global governance and transnational networks- Challenges of cross-border labour relations in the context of the energy transition, and as objects of analysis for Global Social Policy, Transnational Advocacy Networks, and international norm research- Analysis of legitimation strategies for international objectives (e.g., CO2 reduction) at the national and local levels, particularly in the context of labour- Investigation of global and transnational issues in local contexts, for example through the application of qualitative, comparative, and ethnographic methodsTasks:Your tasks include independent research and academic further qualification with the goal of completing a doctorate at TUD, as well as writing a dissertation on a topic within the guiding concept "Energy Cultures in Transition" in the discipline of Political Science/International Relations/Political Sociology. The fellowship requires a high degree of willingness to engage in interdisciplinary dialogue, particularly with the STEM partnerships of the Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, as well as to conduct joint research with artists within the framework of the Schaufler Residency. In addition, engagement in the areas of science communication and outreach is expected. Shared office spaces will be made available to the fellows. Participation in the Kolleg's English-language training program is mandatory.Requirements:You hold an excellent university degree (Master's or equivalent) in Political Science or a comparable social science discipline. Furthermore, you have relevant prior experience in the application of social science methods as well as in the fields of International Politics and Social Movement Studies. You have a strong ability to work in teams and enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration. As the training program is conducted in English, you have English skills at a minimum of C1 level. In accordance with the doctoral regulations of the Faculty of Arts, Humanities and Social Science, the dissertation may be written in either German or English—if you choose to write it in German, corresponding German language skills are required. Beyond this, German language skills are desirable but not mandatory.We offer:The opportunity to pursue a doctorate within the Schaufler Kolleg with a structured qualification program and integration into an interdisciplinary research project. You will receive a fully equipped office workspace on the premises of TUD and access to an excellent research infrastructure, including participation in Research Studios and writing retreats. The Graduate Academy and other central institutions of TUD offer numerous further training and qualification opportunities. In addition, within the limits of the available project funds, the Schaufler Lab will cover the costs of conference travel. Inclusion and equal opportunities are important to us. We therefore look forward to receiving applications from people regardless of gender, origin, sexual orientation, worldview, or disability. TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The University is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment. The fellowship does not constitute an employment relationship.Application:Your detailed application, in German or English, should contain, in addition to the completed online application form (https://tu-dresden.de/gsw/schauflerlab/schaufler-kolleg/phase-3/anmeldung-registration) , a letter of motivation, a curriculum vitae in tabular form including an account of your academic career, a copy of your most recent university degree certificate, an exposé of your research project including a work and time schedule (max. 20,000 characters), and, where applicable, details of your family situation. Please send us your application documents, including the online application form, quoting the reference number s26-003, by November 24, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), preferably via the TUD SecureMail Portal https://securemail.tu-dresden.de (https://securemail.tu-dresden.de/)  by sending it as a single pdf file to schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:schaufler.lab@tu-dresden.de) or to:TU Dresden, Schaufler Lab@TU Dresden, Prof. Dr. Anna Holzscheiter, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

jobs.title: Strategic Procurement Manager - Semiconductor Materials (f/m/d) (Category-Manager/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:Strategische/r Einkäufer/in; Technische/r Einkäufer/inStellenbeschreibung:About usWe see the semiconductor industry as a realm of possibility. We see opportunity. We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. The vision is: Prove to everybody that you can make a fundamental change. Prove with your knowledge and skills how things can be done differently. Together, we can change the paradigm of how the world connects.About our technologyThe semiconductor industry’s growing demand for more powerful chips with higher bandwidth and lower power finds its solution in our technology. We connect chips to high-throughput, low-delay computing networks. The key lies in harnessing the physical properties of graphene to combine electronic computing with photonic communication, allowing countless chips to interact almost as if they were one. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude.In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution.The RoleBlack Semiconductor is looking for a Strategic Procurement Manager (f/m/d) or Category Manager (f/m/d) to strengthen our growing team in Aachen, Germany. In this role, you will lead strategic sourcing and supplier management activities for materials critical to semiconductor manufacturing. You will ensure continuity of supply, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain quality compliance while adapting to evolving technology requirements and market conditions.To join our team, you should be excited to take ownership of:- Develop and execute global sourcing strategies for semiconductor materials, including wafers, photoresists, CMP slurries, specialty gases, chemicals, and other critical materials.- Identify, qualify, and manage strategic suppliers while ensuring alignment with technology roadmaps, quality standards, and production requirements.- Negotiate contracts, pricing, and commercial terms to achieve cost targets while securing reliable supply.- Monitor semiconductor material markets, supplier performance, pricing trends, and supply chain risks to identify opportunities and mitigation strategies.- Collaborate with R&D, process engineering, quality, and manufacturing teams to align material requirements with technology and production needs.- Support new product introductions by sourcing materials that meet emerging process requirements and scalability targets.- Manage procurement performance, supplier relationships, and reporting activities to support business objectives.Your Profile- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in supply chain management, engineering, physics, materials science, business, or a related field.- 5+ years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or supply chain management, preferably within semiconductors, electronics, or advanced manufacturing.- Proven experience negotiating contracts, managing suppliers, and driving cost optimization initiatives.- Strong understanding of semiconductor materials and processes, including wafers, specialty gases, chemicals, photoresists, lithography, etching, and metallization materials.- Strong analytical skills with experience using ERP/procurement systems and data analysis tools.- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with fluent English; Your work focuses on strengthening donor engagement and increasing fundraising revenue. You will work across two connected pillars, namely content development and programme development, that together drive donor acquisition, retention and development for IRC Germany.MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES- Create engaging content for donor journeys and donor communications across- digital acquisition, email, direct mail, and telemarketing to increase donations- and donor engagement.- Support colleagues in the private market with audience-specific content, such- as face-to-face pitches and website copy.- Work with colleagues in other national markets and the global support team to- keep content aligned and share ideas.- Test and improve content and formats on an ongoing basis to raise income- and impact with different audiences.- Analyse web and digital campaign performance across IRC Germany's- fundraising efforts, and use the findings to guide content and testing decisions- and give prospects and supporters a great digital experience.- Take responsibility for how your activity performs against agreed KPIs and- income targets, and make sure campaign reports capture learnings for future activity.YOUR PROFILEEssential:- Relevant university degree or equivalent practical experience (at least 2-4- years) in donor and/or customer acquisition, retention, and content- development, ideally in a non-profit or NGO context- Proven ability using analytics and reporting to inform channel and content- decisions and measure success against key KPIs, primarily ROI- Experience creating and adapting fundraising content and messaging across- formats and channels, including design tools such as Canva or Adobe- Creative Cloud, especially Adobe Premiere- Experience using Salesforce or an equivalent CRM- Excellent written and spoken communication skills in German (C1 level or- above, according to the Common European Framework of Reference for- Languages, CEFR), and fluent in English- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Office (especially Excel)- Desirable:- Experience working with agencies, external consultants, and vendors- Experience and knowledge in applying AI tools to support fundraising- activities, such as content creation, campaign optimization, or data analysisPreferred:- Experience working in a centralized or international organization, or in other- cross-team and cross-country collaborationWe Offer- Meaningful work within a collaborative team- A starting salary of 51,428.58 Euro gross per year as well as an annual salary- increase- Attractive employee benefits such as gym membership, company pension scheme,- shopping vouchers, childcare subsidy, job bike leasing, subsidized Deutschlandticket- (national public transport), and access to timely and confidential psychological- support if needed- 30 days of annual leave and special leave days- Flexible hybrid-work options (working hours, office/homebased)- Training and professional development opportunities, including access to free- language courses- Assistance services for people with disabilities, if required.We look forward to receiving your application (including CV and – if available – three references) via our application portal – even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.Unfortunately, we are unable to consider applications submitted by email.For questions regarding the position, please contact Burrhus Njanjo (HR.Deutschland@rescue.org).As an organization committed to an empowering work environment, equal opportunities, and against any form of discrimination, we welcome applications from people regardless of their origin, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disabilities, age, or other characteristics protected by applicable law.
