jobs.title: Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger medarbejdere til afdelingen for praktisk bistand
jobs.description:
Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger medarbejder til praktisk bistand ved borger i eget hjem

Tænk på en arbejdsdag, hvor du bruger størstedelen af din tid på at skabe tryghed og livskvalitet for borgere i deres eget hjem. Her hjælper du med daglige behov og opbygger relationer, der gør en positiv forskel i deres liv. Lyder det som noget for dig? Hvis ja, så læs videre – måske er du Carelink Plejes nye medarbejder i Aalborg-afdelingen.

Hvorfor vælge Carelink Pleje som din nye arbejdsplads?

  1. Du træder ind i en vigtig rolle, hvor du bidrager til at skabe tryghed og omsorg i borgernes hverdag. Hos Carelink Pleje får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den lokale hjemmepleje og den måde, vi skaber livskvalitet for mennesker på.

  2. Du kommer tæt på de borgere, vi hjælper. Med din faglige ekspertise og omsorg kan du gøre en mærkbar forskel i deres liv. Sammen med borgerne finder du løsninger, der passer til deres individuelle behov og ønsker.

  3. Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab med kollegaer, der brænder for omsorg og nærvær. Vi støtter hinanden, sparrer om udfordringer og fejrer de succeser, vi skaber sammen. For os er samarbejde nøglen til at lykkes – hver dag.

  4. En fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi forstår, at livet skal hænge sammen. Har du brug for en løsning, der matcher din hverdag, finder vi ud af det sammen. Vores værdier er initiativ, omtanke, fællesskab og nr. 1 i service – det gør os til en arbejdsplads, der tager hensyn til dig som menneske.

Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver:

  1. Omsorg og praktisk hjælp i borgernes hjem

  2. Du spiller en central rolle i borgernes hverdag ved at levere omsorg og støtte med praktiske opgaver inden for rengøring og tøjvask , som gør en reel forskel for deres livskvalitet. Du sørger for, at den rette hjælp gives til rette tid, så borgerne føler sig trygge og godt tilpas i deres eget hjem. Dette praktisk hjælp og nærværende samtaler. Din gode kommunikationsevne og empati gør dig til en afgørende støtte for borgern

Der er Køretid mellem borgerne En del af din arbejdsdag vil inkludere transport mellem borgernes hjem. Vi giver dig de nødvendige ressourcer og værktøjer, så du kan koncentrere dig om det vigtigste – at gøre en forskel for borgerne. Du skal have gyldigt kørekort, og kunne stille egen bil til rådighed.

  1. Stillingen er på 30-32 timer ugentligt fri hver weekend og på hele helligdage .

  2. Vi søger en person, der kan arbejde selvstændigt, men som også trives i et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og leverer service på højeste niveau.

  3. Hos Carelink Pleje er vores mission klar: "Vi skaber rammerne for livskvalitet og et værdigt liv" – og vi søger en medarbejder, der brænder for at bidrage til dette hver dag.

  • Aftaler og overenskomst: Vi følger overenskomsten med 3 F , så du kan være tryg ved, at dine arbejdsforhold er ordentlige og fair. Derudover bliver du tilknyttet en privat sundhedsforsikring.

Har du brug for yderligere oplysninger, kan du kontakte Driftschef Birthe Rex alle hverdage mellem kl. 10:00-14:00 på tlf. 98180199.

Vi læser ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler, når den rette kandidat findes. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke stillingsopslaget, når stillingen er besat. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt.

jobs.title: Automotive Software Engineer
jobs.description:
2 positions · Electric vehicles · Broad profile · R&D

Do you want to help create software that runs in real vehicles in your very first week? RENTEQ Automotive is looking for two software people who are curious, learn fast and want to try their hand at a bit of everything. You do not need to be a specialist or have many years of experience. What matters most is that you are adaptable and eager to learn.

About RENTEQ

RENTEQ Automotive is a Danish company at the forefront of electrifying existing diesel machines and vehicles. We convert everything from vans to dumpers and excavators, and all the vehicles run on control software we develop ourselves. We are a growing startup with short decision paths, a small team, and our workshop and offices under one roof in Dragør.

What is it like to work with us?

Our software developers are never far from the product. The workshop is right next door, and the changes you make in the morning can be tested in a vehicle in the afternoon. We are a small team where everyone helps each other, and you will quickly work closely with engineers, mechanics and management.

We do not expect you to know everything from day one. You will get time to learn our system, and support from colleagues working with CAN, embedded software, high voltage and testing. In return, we expect you to be curious, ask questions and be keen to get stuck in.

The job

You will start by getting to know our system: how the vehicles are controlled, how the software is structured, and how it all ties together with CAN and hardware. After that, you will become part of the daily software work and help develop the system further. Our control software is currently built in Simulink, and we are moving parts of it to C/C++, so you will work with both.

Your tasks will include:

•       Get to know our control software and how it works together with the vehicle

•       Flash and test software on the bench and in the vehicles

•       Test new components and help integrate them into the system

•       Debug using CAN logs and measurement data

•       Help develop new features and improve existing ones

•       Document what you learn and build so the rest of the team can use it too.

Is this you?

We are looking for broad profiles rather than specialists. You may be a recent graduate or have a few years of experience. What matters most is that you have a good foundation and a desire to learn.

•       A degree in software, electronics, mechatronics, automation or similar, or equivalent experience

•       Programming experience, for example C, C++, Python or Matlab

•       Curious, adaptable and quick to learn new things

•       You enjoy hands on work and seeing things work in real life

•       Good English skills, Danish is an advantage

It is a plus if you have tried some of the following, but it is not a requirement:

•       Simulink or Stateflow

•       Embedded software or microcontrollers

•       CAN bus and tools such as PCAN or Vector

•       Electric vehicles, batteries or high voltage systems

•       Git.

What we offer

•       A job where you see your software running in real vehicles on the road and on construction sites

•       A fast-paced professional development opportunity with broad insight into software, hardware and electric vehicles

•       A small, informal team where asking questions and helping each other comes naturally

•       Varied tasks on many different vehicles and machines

•       The opportunity to grow with the company and shape how we build our software going forward

•       Workshop and offices in Dragør with easy access by car or public transport.

Salary

Salary is set individually based on gender neutral criteria: education, work experience and other qualifications. We are happy to share the salary range for your profile before the first interview.

jobs.title: Sælger til trælast og byggecenter
jobs.description:
Er du en dygtig sælger, der tager ansvar, ser muligheder og selv får tingene til at ske?

Vi søger en ny kollega til Mou Trælast & Byggecenter. Vi har brug for dig, der trives med kundekontakt og salg, men som også tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og er med til at få butikken til at fungere i hverdagen.

Hos os får du ansvar for egne produktområder. Det betyder, at du ikke bare skal sælge varerne, men også holde øje med sortimentet, sørge for vareopfyldning og tage initiativ, når noget kan gøres bedre.

Du behøver ikke kende hele vores sortiment fra starten. Erfaring fra trælast, byggemarked, detailhandel eller håndværk er en fordel, men det vigtigste er, at du har den rette indstilling, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har lyst til at lære.

Om jobbet

Du bliver en del af et mindre hold, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, og hvor alle tager del i den daglige drift.

Hverdagen er varieret. Den ene kunde er en professionel håndværker, der skal hurtigt videre. Den næste er en privatkunde, som har brug for hjælp til at finde den rigtige løsning.

Samtidig skal varer bestilles, hylder fyldes op, og butikken holdes salgsklar.

Dine opgaver bliver bl.a. at:

  • sælge og rådgive både private og professionelle kunder

  • tage ansvar for dine egne produktområder

  • disponere varer og holde styr på sortiment og lager

  • sørge for vareopfyldning og en ordentlig varepræsentation

  • se muligheder for at udvikle salget og forbedre dine områder

  • tage del i de praktiske opgaver i butikken

Du får frihed til at løse dine opgaver, men vi forventer også, at du selv følger dem til dørs.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med salg og kundebetjening og trives med at have ansvar.

Du er typen, der selv tager fat, når du ser noget, der skal gøres. Du har overblik over dine opgaver, kan prioritere i en travl hverdag og har det godt med, at arbejdsdagen ikke altid går helt som planlagt.

Vi lægger især vægt på, at du:

  • er serviceminded og har flair for salg

  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ

  • tager ejerskab over dine opgaver og følger dem til dørs

  • har praktisk sans og kan lide en alsidig arbejdsdag

  • kan holde overblik over sortiment, varer og egne ansvarsområder

  • fungerer godt i et mindre team, hvor alle hjælper hinanden

Har du kendskab til byggematerialer, værktøj eller håndværk, er det en fordel. Men du kan også komme med erfaring fra en anden branche.

Vi hjælper dig med at lære produkterne og vores arbejdsgange at kende. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du er nysgerrig, engageret og klar til at tage ansvar.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Mou Trælast & Byggecenter er en del af en lokal, familieejet virksomhed med historie tilbage til 1909.

Hos os bliver du en del af et mindre hold, hvor din indsats kan mærkes. Vi har en uformel omgangstone, hjælper hinanden og har korte beslutningsveje.

Du får dine egne ansvarsområder og mulighed for at præge både sortimentet, varepræsentationen og den daglige drift.

  • selvstændigt ansvar og indflydelse på din arbejdsdag

  • mulighed for faglig udvikling

  • gode kolleger og et uformelt arbejdsmiljø

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Tender Manager, Renewable Offshore Services; Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, UK - Grimsby
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by turning complex customer requirements into competitive and commercially robust proposals? Do you thrive on creating structure, coordinating specialists, and driving tender processes from opportunity to contract award? Then you could be our new Tender Manager.Your position As our new Tender Manager, you will play a key role in securing renewable offshore service opportunities, with a particular focus on offshore wind. You will lead the complete tender lifecycle, from initial qualification and bid strategy through proposal development, internal approval, submission, clarification, negotiation, and handover to project delivery. Working closely with colleagues across Sales, Engineering, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, and HSEQ, you will bring together the right expertise and turn complex requirements into clear, compliant, and customer-focused solutions. You will create structure throughout the process, maintain tender governance, manage commercial risks, and ensure that every submission is delivered on time and to a high standard. In this full-time position you will report to the Sales Director, Service. Your place of work will be Esbjerg, Aarhus, Copenhagen or Grimsby, UK and travelling for customer meetings, site visits, negotiations, and other tender-related activities should be expected. At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining a strong culture of safety, quality, compliance, and integrity throughout all tender activities.Your tasks & responsibilities As Tender Manager, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering assigned tenders while ensuring clear ownership, effective collaboration, disciplined governance, and alignment with our commercial objectives. Your tasks will include, but are not limited to:
  • Leading renewable offshore service tenders from qualification and bid/no-bid assessment through submission, negotiation, award, and structured handover.
  • Establishing tender strategies, plans, timelines, responsibilities, review gates, and communication routines across the bid team.
  • Coordinating technical, operational, commercial, contractual, procurement, finance, and HSEQ contributions into coherent and compelling proposals.
  • Managing pricing inputs, assumptions, exclusions, compliance, risks, opportunities, clarifications, and internal approval processes.
  • Preparing and quality-assuring customer-focused submissions while capturing lessons learned and contributing to the continuous improvement of tender processes, tools, and content.
Your profile & qualifications We are looking for a commercially aware and structured tender professional who enjoys bringing people and specialist disciplines together around a shared deadline. You take ownership, maintain an overview when the process becomes complex, and communicate clearly with stakeholders at different levels of the organisation. You combine attention to detail with the ability to understand the bigger commercial picture. You are comfortable challenging inputs, following up on deliverables, and ensuring that the proposed solution is both competitive and operationally achievable. To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have: 
  • Relevant experience in tender or bid management within offshore wind, renewable energy, maritime, oil and gas, engineering, or technical services. 
  • Experience leading complex, multidisciplinary tenders involving several internal and external stakeholders. 
  • A strong understanding of tender governance, compliance, cost estimation, pricing, contractual risk, approvals, negotiations, and handovers. 
  • Excellent written English and strong communication, editing, planning, and stakeholder-management skills. 
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant tender, CRM, document-management, or collaboration platforms. 
Additional languages relevant to our key markets will be considered an advantage. Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.  Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Engageret Account Manager til Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing Denmark
jobs.description:
FirmabeskrivelseVil du arbejde med salg til Pharma industrien i et internationalt og fagligt stærkt miljø?

Eurofins BioPharma Product Testing Denmark A/S er et verdensførende globalt kontraktlaboratorium på lægemiddelområdet, og vi servicerer den farmaceutiske industri med mikrobiologiske og kemiske analyser, proceskontrol samt rådgiver om laboratorieydelser efter GMP.  

Vil du være med til at forme fremtiden hos Eurofins? Med udgangspunkt i din faglighed og passion for salg, vil det blive din fornemste opgave proaktivt at servicere vores eksisterende samt fremtidige kunder. Vi leder efter en kollega, der har et stærkt kommercielt mindset, trives med kundekontakt og arbejder målrettet og effektivt. Du er serviceminded, forretningsorienteret og har en naturlig evne til at spotte og forfølge nye muligheder – både på egen hånd og i tæt samarbejde med teamet.

JobbeskrivelseVores kommende Account Manager vil være med til at styrke vores kunde- og salgsaktiviteter i et spændende pharmaceutisk marked hvor kvalitet og overholdelse af timeline er afgørende. Som Account Manager vil du være ansvarlig for at supportere vores nuværende kunder og identificere potentielle nye kunder samt implementere aftaler.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte

  • At skabe, udvikle og vedligeholdelse af gode relationer til eksisterende kunder

  • Opsøgende salgsarbejde og dialog med potentielle nye kunder 

  • Planlægning og afholdelse af 10-15 kundemøder pr. måned (fysisk og virtuelt)

  • Tilrettelægge din salgsindsats og gennemføre salg 

  • Sikre opnåelse af salgsbudget og udarbejdelse af salgsrapportering i CRM 

  • Udarbejdelse og opfølgning på tilbud og aftaler

  • Koordination og kommunikation med andre Eurofins laboratorier 

  • Holde dig fagligt opdateret inden for dine ansvarsområder, så kunderne anser dig som en kompetent samarbejdspartner 

Opgaverne tilpasses dit erfaringsniveau, og vi sikrer en grundig onboarding.

Du vil blive en del af vores ambitiøse Sales and Business Development team i Glostrup, som til dagligt arbejder med professionelt og effektivt salg, strategisk forretningsudvikling og kundesupport af højeste kvalitet.   

KvalifikationerHvem er du?Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med eller interesse for salg til teknisk eller videns intensive kunder – men din motivation og indstilling er mindst lige så vigtig som din baggrund.

Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med B2B‑salg, Account Management eller kundesupport

  • Har en naturvidenskabelig, teknisk eller kommerciel uddannelse (eller tilsvarende erfaring)

  • Har indsigt i – eller interesse for – pharma-/life science‑industrien

  • Trives med dialog, erfaring med relations opbyggende salg og service og kan begå dig på alle niveauer i en organisation  

  • Er struktureret og arbejder målrettet med dine opgaver

  • Du har interesse og flair for IT og mestre Excel, Microsoft CRM, etc.  

  • Har gode kommunikations- og formidlingsevner, både i skrift og tale på dansk og engelsk  

Det er en fordel – men ikke et krav – hvis du:

  • Har arbejdet i eller med pharma, biotek eller laboratoriemiljøer

  • Har erfaring med CRM-systemer og Excel

Som person

  • Du har et naturligt gåpåmod og arbejder systematisk og målrettet med projekter 

  • Du er udadvendt og trives i samspillet med kunder  

  • God kommunikator – og god til at lytte  

  • Du har stærk forretningssans og solid økonomisk forståelse.

  • Du arbejder målrettet og fleksibelt – og tager ansvar for at få tingene til at ske. Du yder et høj serviceniveau – både internt i organisationen og eksternt over for vores kunder.

  • Du har et stærkt overblik og trives i et dynamisk miljø, hvor tempoet er højt og opgaverne varierede.

Kørekort til kategori B og adgang til egen bil er et krav, da rollen indebærer kundebesøg og eksterne møder.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du vil få et spændende job i en international virksomhed i vækst og blive en del af et dedikeret og passioneret team. Derudover tilbyder vi en afvekslende hverdag i et arbejdsmiljø med højt tempo og godt humør, hvor fokus ligger på effektivitet og god kundeservice. 

Du vil være med til at påvirke din egen hverdag og vil blive en meget vigtig del af vores velfungerende team. Vi sørger naturligvis for, at du bliver sat ind i opgaverne og vores forretning, så du er klædt på til at varetage opgaverne professionelt. 

Yderligere oplysninger

Arbejdssted Ørnebjergvej 1, 2600 Glostrup. 

Arbejdstid Fuldtid (mandag til fredag)  

Tiltrædelse Hurtigst muligt  

Interesseret?Du søger stillingen online ved at klikke på "Jeg er interesseret". Ansøgninger sendt på mail tages ikke i betragtning. Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter så snart, den rette kandidat er fundet og vi opfordrer derfor til, at du sender dit CV og evt. relevante bilag hurtigst muligt. Under ”Besked til ansættelsesteamet” modtager vi meget gerne en kort motivation for din ansøgning.

Vil du vide mere om stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Salgschef Nadja Sun på mail (NadjaSun.Wissing@bpt.eurofinseu.com) eller HR Konsulent Frederik Orsted Thomsen på mail (FrederikOrsted.Thomsen@sc.eurofinseu.com). 

Udvælges du som en af de kandidater, vi ønsker at invitere med i rekrutteringsprocessen, vil du modtage et link til en kort videobesvarelse af nogle spørgsmål forud for en eventuel samtale.

Du kan læse mere om Eurofins på www.eurofins.dk.

I forbindelse med ansættelse, vil du blive bedt om at fremvise straffeattest.

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye kollega velkommen.   

Eurofins Scientific er en international life science virksomhed, som tilbyder et unikt udvalg af analyser til kunder inden for mange forskellige industrier, med det formål at gøre livet og vores miljø mere sikkert, sundere og mere bæredygtigt. Fra den mad du spiser, til vandet du drikker, til medicinen du anvender, arbejder Eurofins sammen med de største virksomheder i verden, for at understøtte, at de produkter virksomhederne udbyder er sikre, deres ingredienser er autentiske og at mærkningen på produkterne er korrekte. Eurofins er verdensledende inden for test af fødevarer, miljø, farmaceutiske og kosmetiske produkter, samt agro-science CRO services. Eurofins er ydermere en af de globale markedsledere inden for specifikke test og laboratorieservices inden for genomics, farmakologi, retsmedicin, CDMO, avanceret materialevidenskab, samt support til kliniske studier. På lidt mere end 30 år er Eurofins vokset fra at været et enkelt laboratorium i Nantes i Frankrig, til at bestå af 65.000 medarbejdere i et netværk af mere end 1000 selvstændige selskaber og over 950 laboratorier i 60 lande. Eurofins tilbyder en portefølje af mere end 200.000 analytiske metoder, til at evaluere sikkerhed, identitet, sammensætning, ægthed, oprindelse, sporbarhed og renhed af biologiske stoffer og produkter. Som en af de førende spillere inden for specialiseret klinisk diagnostisk test, tilbyder vi endvidere vi innovative klinisk diagnostiske testydelser.I 2025 genererede Eurofins en samlet indtægt på 7,296 milliarder Euro og er i blandt de aktier, som har performet bedst i Europa over de sidste 20 år.

jobs.title: A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years.
jobs.description:
A position as postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to three years. The starting date is 01 February 2027 or later by agreement and depending on the candidate’s preferences.

We are seeking a researcher with documented experience in epidemiological research who can independently plan studies, conduct analyses and write scientific papers. We are looking for a future colleague with a clear academic interest in women’s mental health and the motivation to develop their research in this field. Experience in psychiatric epidemiology is a distinct advantage.

The project

The position is funded by a grant from the Wellcome Trust through PROMIS, an international research project on women’s mental health during perimenopause. The project is in its initial phase and will draw on cohort data linked to national registers, in collaboration with researchers in the UK, the USA and Sweden.

The project investigates risk factors for the onset or recurrence of depression, anxiety, bipolar disorder and psychotic disorders during perimenopause. The work includes epidemiological studies of risk, the development and validation of prediction models, and studies of hormone therapy and mental health outcomes using target trial emulation.

Research tasks

The postdoc will work closely with Principal Investigator Professor Trine Munk-Olsen and the project’s data analyst and participate actively in the international research collaboration. The candidate will have considerable scope to shape research questions, the structure of individual studies, study designs and methodological choices within the framework of the project.

The main tasks are to:

  • Plan and conduct epidemiological studies using register and cohort data, including preparing study protocols and analysis plans.

  • Independently perform statistical analyses, interpret results and write scientific papers.

  • Identify risk factors for mental disorders during perimenopause and contribute to the development and validation of prediction models.

  • Contribute to studies using target trial emulation to investigate hormone therapy and mental health outcomes.

  • Together with other project team members, contribute to applications for access to external datasets and to the maintenance, quality assurance, harmonisation and documentation of the datasets used.

  • Participate in subprojects and undertake tasks within the international collaboration, including coordination, organising project meetings and following up on joint agreements.

The position will involve limited travel. It is primarily research-oriented. Teaching and supervision duties may be included, depending also on the candidate’s interests and preferences.

Expectations of qualifications

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree in epidemiology, health sciences, biostatistics or data science with a strong focus on health. Candidates who have not yet completed their Ph.D. may apply if they expect to obtain the degree by the starting date. However, we envisage that, in addition to their Ph.D., the candidate will have at least 1–2 years of research-related experience, for example as a postdoc, research assistant or statistician.

The applicant must have the following qualifications:

  • A clear academic interest in research on women’s mental health, including the relationships between reproductive life stages and mental disorders.

  • First authorship of several scientific papers, including documented experience in epidemiological research based on register or cohort data.

  • Documented experience with advanced epidemiological and statistical methods.

  • Documented experience and competence in statistical programming, for example in R or Stata.

  • A documented ability to independently plan studies, prepare study protocols, conduct analyses and write scientific papers.

  • Good collaboration skills and the ability to take responsibility for tasks and contribute constructively to joint research projects.

  • The ability to work systematically with data quality, documentation and the maintenance of research data.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.

The following would be an advantage but are not requirements:

  • Experience in psychiatric epidemiology.

  • Experience in the development or validation of prediction models.

  • Practical experience with target trial emulation.

  • Experience in international research collaborations.

  • Written and spoken Danish, as Danish is the working language of the research unit.

Research environment

The position is based in the Research Unit of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry, a growing, dynamic and collaborative research environment at the Department of Clinical Research, University of Southern Denmark. Our research group brings together expertise in psychiatry, psychology, epidemiology and public health. We offer a friendly, inclusive and interdisciplinary working environment where early-career researchers are supported in developing their academic and professional skills. The unit leads several major research projects focusing on perinatal mental health, child and adolescent psychiatry, and early intervention and prevention.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact Professor Trine Munk-Olsen, e-mail: tmun@sdu.dk, phone: +45 24 46 62 97.

Application deadline

November 18, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Interviews

Interviews are expected to take place in early December 2026.

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Hospitalsringen 90, 5260 Odense S.  

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers in the APAC region. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role in APAC is office based 2–3 days per week, as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region.



What you'll do

 - Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at Linear’s largest customers in APAC - act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear to drive business outcomes

 - Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating with product, sales, and support teams to address challenges and drive enhancements in the product

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years relevant work experience in a technical customer-facing role

 - SaaS and start up experience a must; comfortable working and adapting in a fast paced and flexible environment

 - Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively

 - Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and effectively

 - Previous experience working with product + engineering teams and/or developer tools is preferred

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

Learn how we think and work

Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

In this role, you will serve as the primary technical partner for our most strategic prospects and customers in the APAC region. You’ll play a dual role: driving complex technical engagements through end-to-end demos, migrations, and integrations, and accelerating ramp for new sales hires by codifying best practices. You will showcase our product’s value to prospects, uncover challenges and architect tailored solutions, drive successful sales evaluations, and champion customer needs internally.

jobs.title: Clinical Data Manager
jobs.description:
General Summary
The temporary Clinical Data Manager acts as a lead data manager for one or more projects, applies data management experience to clinical trials, and utilizes functional knowledge of the logistics of clinical trials to ensure the quality and integrity of clinical trial data. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME).

We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities. The initial assignment is for 6 months, but may be extended to meet the needs of our Team. Applicants must be eligible to live and work in the US.


Specific Duties and Responsibilities
â¢Independently lead and/or perform all data management activities within an assigned study (e.g., study startup, study conduct, study closeout, and reporting). *
â¢Serve as the data management SME on multidisciplinary project teams providing specific expertise on timeline development, identification of data management deliverables and resource requirements. *
â¢Participate in the creation, review, and maintenance of project timelines and monitor progress of data management activities. *
â¢Provide oversight for Data Management CRO and other vendors to ensure compliance with the protocol, external/internal standards, Good Clinical Practices (GCPs), applicable regulatory guidelines, SOPs, and other relevant guidelines.
â¢Ensure Data Management documentation is filed/archived according to applicable Penumbra and regulatory requirements. *
â¢Interact with data management, biostatistics, Clinical Affairs and Medical Affairs team to ensure integrity and quality of data. *
â¢Contribute ideas to the development of the department, identifying areas for improvement (e.g., SOPs, processes)
â¢Participates in audits and inspections. *
â¢Attend Investigator Meetings when requested to provide training on CRF data completion.
â¢Responsible for creation of training materials and training of the CRAs to ensure consistency of data entry at the sites. *
â¢Provide DM departmental training and to other teams, as needed.
â¢Utilizes reports to track study progress and ensure timeliness and quality expectations are met.
â¢Adhere to the Companyâs Quality Management System (QMS) as well as domestic and global quality system regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Understand relevant security, privacy and compliance principles and adhere to the regulations, standards, and procedures that are applicable to the Company. *
â¢Ensure other members of the department follow the QMS, regulations, standards, and procedures. *
â¢Perform other work-related duties as assigned.
*Indicates an essential function of the role


Required Qualifications
Minimum education and experience
â¢Bachelor's degree with 5+ years in a medical device, pharmaceutical company, or similar environment (e.g., CRO); or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Preferred qualifications
â¢Masterâs degree with 3+ years of clinical research, pharmaceutical company preferred
â¢Thorough knowledge of effective clinical data management practices; CCDM certified professional a plus
â¢Must have strong experience with systems used for electronic capture of clinical trial data (e.g., iMedidata Rave, InForm, eClinicalOS, RedCap)
â¢This position must have experience working on regulatory trials within the medical device and/or pharmaceutical industry
â¢Position requires technical, organizational, analytical, and strong communication skills
â¢Knowledge of regulatory guidelines pertaining to data quality and data management
â¢Proven experience and in-depth understanding of all aspects of Data Management
â¢Ability to effectively manage change and multiple priorities
â¢Ability to operate independently and achieve results; ability to effectively deal with employees and business contacts and conveys a positive service-oriented attitude
â¢Knowledge of continuous improvement, project management, change management, and risk management
â¢Medical device, pharmaceutical, biotech, or other regulated industry experience required
â¢Proficiency with MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

 

Working Conditions
â¢General office environment
â¢Willingness and ability to work on site.
â¢May have business travel from 0% - 5% to conferences and/or other Penumbra affiliated facilities.
â¢Potential exposure to blood-borne pathogens

â¢Must be able to remain stationary and use a computer or other standard office equipment, such as a printer or copy machine, for an extensive period of time each day.
â¢Must be able to read, prepare emails, and produce documents and spreadsheets.
â¢Must be able to move within the office and access file cabinets or supplies, as needed.
â¢Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis. Must be able to communicate and exchange accurate information with employees at all levels on a daily basis.

 

Base Pay Range Per Hour: $50.00 - $80.00
Individual compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location.

\n


\n

What We Offer

â¢ The opportunity to be part of the team that is revolutionizing the treatment of some of the world's most devastating diseases.

Penumbra, Inc., headquartered in Alameda, California, is a global healthcare company focused on innovative therapies. Penumbra designs, develops, manufactures, and markets novel products and has a broad portfolio that addresses challenging medical conditions in markets with significant unmet need. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je navedene isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Nepravodobne i/ili nepotpune prijave, kao i one koje ne zadovaljavaju uvjete iz natječaja neće se uzimati u obzir, a njihove podnositelje se neće posebno obaviještavati o tome. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno (osobno) ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, 10 000 Zagreb, Remete 99a s naznakom „za natječaj: Kuhar/ica- Slastičar/ka 2“.

jobs.title: VODITELJ/VODITELJICA YUFE DIGITALIZACIJE I INTEROPERABILNOSTI SUSTAVA (YUFE HUB)
jobs.description:
SVEUČILIŠTE U RIJECI, Trg braće Mažuranića 10, raspisuje NATJEČAJ br. 20/26 za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na sljedećem radnom mjestu na projektu YUFEPulse Voditelj YUFE digitalizacije i interoperabilnosti sustava (YUFE Hub) - voditelj ustrojstvene jedinice 4 - na projektu YUFEPulse na određeno puno radno vrijeme (m/ž 1 izvršitelj/ica) Posebni uvjeti za zasnivanje radnog odnosa:
  • HKO-a 7.1.sv ili 7.1.st
  • najmanje dvije godine radnog iskustva
  • aktivno znanje engleskog jezika u govoru i pismu
  • napredno poznavanje rada na računalu
  • razvijene analitičke sposobnosti i sposobnost rješavanja tehničkih problema spremnost na kontinuirano učenje, praćenje razvoja digitalnih tehnologija te daljnje stručnousavršavanje
Opis poslova:
  • pruža podršku aktivnostima YUFE Pulse radnog paketa WP11: Digitalisation, posebice zadatku T11.2 (Interoperability Deployment and Partner Onboarding
  • sudjeluje u uvođenju YUFE Hub-a u produkcijsku i podržava njegovu operativnu stabilnost na Sveučilištu u Rijeci
  • koordinira i usklađuje proces uvođenja (onboardinga) i ostalih YUFE partnerskih sveučilišta u YUFE Hub, pružajući tehničke smjernice, dokumentaciju i podršku pri testiranju konektora
  • surađuje sa Sveučilišnim računskim centrom (SRCE) na razvoju i tehničkoj implementaciji sustava potrebnih za povezivanje Sveučilišta u Rijeci s YUFE Hub-om
  • doprinosi izradi okvira za dugoročno upravljanje interoperabilnošću i održivost digitalne infrastrukture Sveučilišta u Rijeci
  • obavlja sve ostale stručne poslove u području digitalizacije i interoperabilnosti sustava, po nalogu institucijskog koordinatoraili neposrednog voditelja
Probni rad 3 mjeseca. Pod radnim iskustvom podrazumijeva se vrijeme provedeno u radnom odnosu na poslovima odgovarajuće vrste i razine složenosti nakon stjecanja kvalifikacije određene razine prema Hrvatskom kvalifikacijskom okviru (HKO-u). Na natječaj se po jednakim uvjetima mogu prijaviti osobe obaju spolova. Pojmovi koji imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na oba spola. U prijavi na natječaj pristupnici trebaju obavezno navesti osobne podatke: ime i prezime, datum i mjesto rođenja, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona, e-adresu, naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuju te napomenu o povratu natječajne dokumentacije. Prijavu na natječaj je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Uz prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti: životopis, dokaz o traženoj stručnoj spremi (presliku diplome), elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radnom stažu (ne stariju od mjesec dana), presliku osobne iskaznice ili domovnice te ostale potvrde o zadovoljavanju uvjeta/prednosti za radno mjesto (preslike ugovora o radu odnosno druge odgovarajuće dokaze kojima se dokazuje zadovoljavanje uvjeta/prednosti za radno mjesto). Kao dokaz o odgovarajućem poznavanju engleskog jezika prihvatit će se potvrda ili certifikat o znanju engleskog jezika, preslika ocjena iz odgovarajuće isprave o obrazovanju ili vlastoručno potpisana izjava pristupnika o ispunjavanju navedenog uvjeta a kao dokaz o poznavanju rada na računalu prihvatit će se preslika uvjerenja ili potvrde, drugi odgovarajući dokaz odnosno vlastoručno potpisana izjava pristupnika o ispunjavanju navedenog uvjeta. Sveučilište zadržava pravo provođenja provjere znanja, vještina i sposobnosti kandidata pisanim testiranjem i/ili intervjuom. U slučaju provedbe navedenih provjera kandidati su im obvezni pristupiti, u protivnom će se smatrati da su odustali od daljnjeg sudjelovanja u natječajnom postupku. Povrat natječajne dokumentacije izvršit će se na zahtjev pristupnika. Pristupnik zahtjev treba navesti u tekstu prijave. Rok za podnošenje prijave je 8 dana od dana posljednje objave natječaja u odgovarajućim glasilima. Prijave s prilozima podnose se poštom na adresu: Sveučilište u Rijeci, Trg braće Mažuranića 10, Rijeka s obaveznom naznakom za natječaj - naziv radnog mjesta. O rezultatima natječaja pristupnici će biti obaviješteni. Sveučilište zadržava pravo djelomično ili u cijelosti poništiti natječaj i ne izabrati nijednog kandidata bez posebnog obrazloženja. Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 103. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf. Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 49. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Pristupnici koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Dokazom o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave o invaliditetu na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom koji se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje. https://mrosp.gov.hr/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-7348/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-izaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom-7475/pod-kojim-uvjetima-osobe-s-invaliditetom-ostvarujuprednost-pri-zaposljavanju-7477/7477 Pristupnici kojima hrvatski jezik nije materinski jezik moraju priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika (razina B2) prema Zajedničkom europskom referentnom okviru za jezike. Prijavom na natječaj pristupnici su izričito suglasni da Sveučilište u Rijeci, kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka, sukladno odredbama Opće Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

Nastavování procesů, plánování, dohled nad každodenním provozem i gastro úseku.•    Vedení pokladny a potřebné dokumentace.Co od vás očekáváme?•    Kompletní organizace akcí: Budete plánovat, koordinovat a osobně dohlížet na hladký průběh svateb, firemních akcí a kurzů od prvního kontaktu s klientem až po závěrečné vyúčtování.•    Aktivní komunikace: Vyřizování poptávek (e-maily, telefonáty) a osobní prohlídky vily s budoucími novomanželi či firemními partnery.•    Reprezentativní a příjemné vystupování: Jste prvním člověkem, kterého klienti vidí – úsměv a lidský přístup jsou u nás základ.•    Zkušenosti s organizací: Praxe z provozu penzionu, cateringu nebo event managementu je pro vás výhodou.•    Lásku k detailu a estetično: Chceme někoho, koho baví dotvářet harmonickou atmosféru místa – od prostření svatební tabule po vkusný styling rautu a coffee breaků.•    Psychickou odolnost a samostatnost: Během víkendové svatby umíte pohodově řešit neočekávané situace s ledovým klidem a úsměvem.•    Schopnost improvizace: Nečekané změny (např. náhlý déšť před venkovním obřadem) vás nerozhodí, ale nastartují k okamžitému hledání řešení.•    Diplomatické dovednosti: Umíte s klidem a empatií uklidnit emoce na straně klienta i týmu.•    Flexibilitu: Práce v provozu s sebou nese nepravidelnou pracovní dobu (včetně víkendů, kdy u nás akce a svatby probíhají nejčastěji).Sleva na kosmetické výrobky Original ATOK, příspěvek na stravování, auto i k soukromým účelům, Notebook, mobilní telefon.

  • Fejlfinde tekniske problemer og sende komplekse sager videre til det rette team.

Hvem er du?

Du behøver ikke være ekspert i spillekonsoler. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig på teknologi, kan bevare overblikket og har lyst til at hjælpe andre.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk på meget højt niveau, svarende til C2.

  • Har engelskkundskaber på minimum B2-niveau.

  • Har afsluttet en gymnasial uddannelse eller tilsvarende.

  • Er fortrolig med IT og god til at forklare løsninger på en forståelig måde.

  • Er tålmodig, serviceminded og løsningsorienteret.

  • Er EU-borger og enten bor på Cypern eller ønsker at flytte dertil.

Erfaring med kundeservice eller teknisk support er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Interesse for gaming og spillekonsoler vil være en fordel i hverdagen.

Arbejdstid, løn og oplæring

Du arbejder 40 timer om ugen fra virksomhedens kontor i Larnaca. Vagterne ligger mandag til fredag inden for kl. 09.00–19.30, lokal tid, så du har fri i weekenden.

Du starter med fem ugers oplæring, som foregår mandag til fredag kl. 10.00–18.45, lokal tid.

Den faste månedsløn er 1.350 euro før skat, som stiger til 1.400 euro efter seks måneders ansættelse.

Du tilbydes en toårig kontrakt med mulighed for efterfølgende tidsubegrænset ansættelse. Prøvetiden er seks måneder.

Hjælp til at komme afsted

Hvis du flytter til Cypern, kan du vælge mellem to flyttepakker:

  • 1.500 euro i flyttetilskud, udbetalt 2–3 uger efter jobstart. Du arrangerer og betaler i første omgang selv fly og bolig.

  • Refusion af flybillet på op til 300 euro samt mulighed for indkvartering gennem virksomheden i op til to måneder. Første måned er gratis, og anden måned koster 100 euro. Du booker selv flybilletten.

De nærmere betingelser for flyttepakken gennemgås under rekrutteringsprocessen.

Jobsun er med dig under hele opholdet

Et nyt job i et andet land er et stort skridt, og du skal have nogen at række ud til. Derfor er Jobsun din kontaktperson og mentor både før afrejse, under opstarten og gennem hele dit ophold.

Du kan altid kontakte os, hvis du har spørgsmål om jobbet, hverdagen på Cypern eller noget praktisk, du har brug for hjælp til. Vi hjælper dig med at finde en løsning, så du ikke står alene med udfordringerne.

Interesseret? Et CV er nok

Forventet opstart er 2. november 2026, og fristen for at sende dit CV er 25. oktober 2026.

Send dit CV via ansøgningsmuligheden i opslaget. Du behøver ikke skrive en ansøgning.

Rekrutteringsprocessen omfatter en sprogtest og en samtale på dansk og engelsk. Jobsun står for den indledende rekruttering og hjælper dig gennem processen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Customer Success-medarbejder
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Customer Success-medarbejder til Vinduespudserskolen

Kunne du tænke dig at skifte job og hjælpe andre med at gøre det samme?

På Vinduespudserskolen hjælper vi personer med at skifte deres nuværende job ud med deres egen vinduespudserforretning. Eleverne lærer håndværket fysisk på skolen i København og modtager grundig undervisning i forretningsudvikling. Tilsammen giver det dem fundamentet til at bygge en succesfuld vinduespudserforretning.

Bag skolen står et team, der arbejder for at hjælpe eleverne med at lykkes. Nu søger vi en ny kollega til en Customer Success-stilling.

Dine primære opgaver bliver at:

  • Følge op på elevernes ugemål og henvise dem til relevante undervisere, når de har brug for hjælp.

  • Sikre, at alle elever bruger vores interne systemer korrekt og får mest muligt ud af dem.

  • Følge op på elevernes undervisningsplan og hjælpe dem, der halter bagud.

  • Tale med potentielle elever, der ønsker optagelse på skolen, i takt med at du får større kendskab til vores forløb.

  • Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklingsafdeling om elevernes ønsker til undervisningssystemer etc.

  • Samarbejde med chefunderviser Jonas som kan vidergive om elevernes færdigheder inden for håndværket.

Du kommer også til at arbejde tæt sammen med Asger og Malte, som du skal dele kontor med på Vestergade i København. De står for din oplæring og indkøring, som tager op til 6 måneder, før du kører "selvstændigt". Derfor søger vi dig, der kan se en fremtid på skolen.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en god grundlæggende teknisk forståelse

  • Kan arbejde fra København hver dag.

  • Kan lide at have med mennesker at gøre – hver dag.

  • Har god menneskelig forståelse.

  • Trives i en virksomhed, der arbejder som en startup med mange selvstændige og engagerede mennesker.

  • Føler dig hjemme i jargonen på en skole med over 500 elever, som nok bedst kan beskrives som ”en masse meget friske fyre”.

Stillingen er på fuld tid med løn efter kvalifikationer.

Er du ikke selv den rette, men kender du en, så anbefal endelig vedkommende. Vi ansætter, så snart vi finder den rigtige, med opstart hurtigst muligt.Læs mere og ansøg på https://www.vinduespudserskolen.dk/job-customer-success

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.

 

This role will be based in Paris. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and French

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €115,000-€128,000 per year.

jobs.title: Science Hub Denmark Student Assistant
jobs.employer: COPENHAGEN CAPACITY, FONDEN TIL MARKEDSFØRING OG ERHVERVSFREMME
jobs.description:
The Science Hub Denmark initiative is expanding. Join us and help us tell the world why Denmark is a fantastic place to pursue a career in research!

We are looking for a promising Student Assistant with a passion for science to join our growing team that aims to brand Denmark internationally as an attractive career destination for elite researchers within Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI.

We are still looking for a new setup for the team and are therefore open to profiles within all our focus areas.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • Assist the Science Hub team in running the project and developing and executing the various activities and events. Both online and in-person. This could imply some international travel.

  • Conduct market research.

  • Candidate and university outreach.

  • Provide administrative support to the team.

  • Work with our CRM system, HubSpot.

Your profileYou are currently studying a master’s degree and are excited about the opportunity to share with the world why Denmark is a great place to live and work. You are a motivated, creative and a structured team player. It would be good if you have some of the skills and competencies listed below but don’t worry if you don’t have them all. If you have the right mindset, everything is possible!

  • A passion for science and an interest and firsthand knowledge of one of our research areas at Danish universities.

  • Proficient in English both verbally and in writing.

  • Outgoing with good communication and public speaking skills

  • Good organisational and time management skills.

  • Ability to work effectively within a team and independently.

Our offices are in the city center of Copenhagen, Denmark. You’ll work here part-time: 15-20 hours per week. We’ll agree on a work schedule that fits with your studies.Copenhagen Capacity Copenhagen Capacity is Greater Copenhagen’s organization for investment promotion and regionaleconomic development. We work to make the region even more attractive to foreign investment andmarket it internationally to attract companies, investors, and highly educated workers.

The goal is to create jobs, growth, and development in Greater Copenhagen. In addition to that, we are a close-knit, passionate organization with a multinational work environment where English is our shared office language. We value collaboration and connection, whether over lunch in the company canteen with colleagues across departments or at social events.

Science Hub Denmark Science Hub Denmark is an initiative dedicated to enhancing the international visibility of Danish research and career opportunities in Denmark. With funding from Villum Fonden, Novo Nordisk Fonden, and Lundbeck Fonden, the initiative will continue for three more years with the aim of significantly increasing the interest in Danish research worldwide, while also exploring innovative strategies for promoting career opportunities in Denmark. 

Emphasizing research excellence, societal impact, and quality of life, the initiative will utilize digital channels to engage researchers abroad and facilitate recruitment for research positions at Danish universities. The project focuses on key areas: Biosolutions, Biomedicine, Neuroscience, Sustainable Energy Tech, Quantum and AI; research strongholds where Denmark excels internationally. 

How to apply If you think you’re the right profile for this position and our team, please apply before the 8th of November 2026 by sending your CV and cover letter job@copcap.com with "Student Assistant – Science Hub" in the subject line.  Interviews are expected to be held in the week of 9-13 November.

If you have any questions regarding the role, please reach out to Head of Science Hub Denmark – Alexander Watts, by email: alw@copcap.com

Du skal være fleksibel og klar til at træde til ved akutte behov, herunder ved sygdom, ferie eller andre situationer, hvor de øvrige medarbejdere ikke har mulighed for at dække opgaverne. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du trives med en alsidig hverdag, hvor du både har ansvar for koordinering og ledelse samt selv tager aktiv del i det praktiske arbejde.

  • Sørger for indkøb, manglende varer/udstyr mv.

Vi søger dig, der er ansvarsbevidst, struktureret og god til at skabe overblik. Du trives med at tage initiativ, løse udfordringer og sikre, at både medarbejdere og kunder får en god oplevelse.

Hos Kola Sons får du mulighed for at blive en vigtig del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor du kan få indflydelse på den daglige drift og være med til at præge vores fortsatte udvikling.

Er det dig, vi søger? Så kontakt os for at høre mere om stillingen og mulighederne hos Kola Sons.

jobs.title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description:
Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark’s power supply and support the green transition.

On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.

Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components

  • Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems

  • Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks

  • Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations

  • Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentation

Over time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.

You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Works independently and takes a structured approach

  • Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work

  • Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others

  • Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height

  • Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificate

You must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.

A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.

You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish “fritvalgsordning” scheme.

You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.

We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.

If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.

Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.
