jobs.title: Deltid - Vicevært? Flyttesynstekniker? Handy-person?
jobs.description:
Din titel er ikke afgørende for os. Bare du har hænderne skruet rigtig på og lysten til at blive en del af en virksomhed, hvor vi har tendens til at blive hængende på holdet i lang tid.

Denne her stilling er deltid - vi forventer at arbejdet til en start er på 20-30 timer ugentligt, men vi hører gerne til dine forventninger og ser om vi kan få det til at gå op med resten af teamet.

Det er vigtigt at du har egen bil, som du kan burge til at komme rundt imellem ejendommene.

Hvem er du og hvorfor passer du ind hos os?Det går du fordi, du er:

Servicemindet - du nyder en hverdag, hvor din primære opgave er at sikre en god oplevelse for beborerne.

Handy - måske selvlært eller fordi du har en teknisk uddannelse, men du kan løse de fleste udbedringer i lejemålene og på ejendommene selv, som fx udskiftning af blandingsbatterier, kontrol af gulvvarmeanlæg, justering af skabslåger, mm. De ting du ikke har prøvet før, kan du gennemgå med en kollega, så du er godt klædt på til at klare det selv næste gang.

Struktureret og har styr på dine aftaler. Vi sætter stor værdi i at holde, hvad vi lover hinanden og vores kunder.

Motiveret af et fleksibelt arbejdsliv. Du bestemmer selv, om din arbejdsdag starter kl. 8 eller kl. 10 – bare opgaverne bliver løst med høj kvalitet og til tiden.

Hvem er vi og hvorfor er vi sjove at arbejde hos?Vi er en professionel leverandør af ejendomsservice og vores kunder er udlejningsejendomme, ejerforeninger og lignende. Vi vækster og har netop vundet vores 3. gazelle. Det betyder, at der på sigt kan være mulighed for flere timer eller mere ansvar, hvis det er noget, du ønsker.

Vi har tillid til hinanden og opbakning fra vores chef.

Det betyder, at vi arbejder selvstændigt med vores egne opgaver og at vi altid kan spørge om hjælp, når vi har brug for det.

Vi er uformelle og møder hinanden og vores kunder i øjenhøjde. Samtidig tager vi naturligvis ansvar for vores opgaver og sikrer, at vi løser tingene godt.

Hvad er det så for nogle opgaver, som du kan være med til løse hos os?

Arbejdsopgaverne•   Pasning og renholdelse af ejendomme•   Udførelse af ind-/fraflytningssyn•   Håndtering af lejerhenvendelser og udbedring af ting i lejemålene•   Evt. pasning af mindre grønne områder, så som græsslåning•   Andre viceværtsrelevante opgaverDet med småt

Bil: Da stilling er deltid, stiller vi en bil til rådighed, så du skal derfor forvente at du skal have mulighed for at transportere dig selv i egen bil rundt imellem ejendommene.

Vi tilbyder dig firmatelefon, tablet og et kollegialt fællesskab med høj trivsel.

Derudover kan du selv frem til en opstart, hvor du bliver klædt på af dine kolleger - som du også lærer at kende til de sociale arrangementer, som vi holder i løbet af året.

Du skal forvente at løse opgaver primært i og omkring Horsens, men der er også mulighed for opgaver i de omkringliggende byer.

Vi er fleksible i forhold til opstart, så lad os holde en åben dialog omkring det.

Vi holder samtalerne løbende, så tøv ikke med at tage fat i os allerede i dag.

Vil du med?Lyder det som noget for dig, så send dit CV til andreas@dalboege.com. Du er også meget velkommen til at skrive med eventuelle spørgsmål eller læse mere om os på dalbøgesejendomsservice.dk.

Vi inviterer løbende til samtaler og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet det rette match.

jobs.title: koordinerende planlægger til afdeling for praktisk bistand
jobs.description:
Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger koordinerende planlægger

Vil du have en central rolle i hverdagsdriften i en privat hjemmepleje – og samtidig understøtte den daglige ledelse gennem struktur, overblik og stabil drift?

Hos Carelink Pleje søger vi en koordinerende- og planlægningsansvarlig medarbejder, som kan tage ansvar for den daglige planlægning og koordinering i vores afdeling for praktisk bistand i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens 2 øvrige medarbejder.

Stillingen er en nøglefunktion i organisationen og et vigtigt led i at sikre kvalitet, kontinuitet og trivsel for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Vagtplanlægning og koordinering

  • du skal udarbejde konkrete vagtplaner inden for de rammer og principper, som virksomheden har fastlagt og med udgangspunkt i 3F gældende overenskomst.

  • Håndtere daglige ændringer, herunder sygemeldinger og akutte justeringer. Herunder at man i samarbejde med øvrige nøglepersoner skal modtage sygemeldinger på telefonen.

  • Være første kontaktpunkt for medarbejdere ved ændringer i vagter

  • Sikre overblik over bemanding, kontinuitet og stabil drift

Dag-til-dag disponering

  • Justere ruter og opgaver i løbet af dagen ved sygdom, forsinkelser eller aflysninger

  • Koordinere indsatsen, så borgerne får den rette hjælp på rette tidspunkt

  • Have løbende kontakt med medarbejdere i vagten ved behov for justeringer

  • Være tilgængelig på telefonen og besvare henvendelser fra medarbejdere, visitationen, borgere og deres pårørende.

Ruteplanlægning og systemunderstøttelse

  • Daglig ruteoptimering og justering i planlægningssystemer

  • Opdatere ruter ved ændrede visiteringer

  • Arbejde aktivt i Cleanmanager og Cura , sikre korrekt anvendelse af systemerne i planlægningen

Understøttelse af den daglige ledelse

  • Understøtte afdelingslederen i den daglige ledelse gennem:

  • Overblik over drift, bemanding og udfordringer

  • Tidlig opsamling på mønstre (fx gentagne sygemeldinger, pres på ruter, ustabilitet)

  • Bidrage med input til forbedring af arbejdsgange, planlægning og kontinuitet

  • Være en stabil og tydelig samarbejdspartner for både ledelse og medarbejdere i hverdagen

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra hjemmepleje, planlægning eller koordination

  • Er uddannet SSA , sygeplejerske eller terapeut

  • Har praktisk erfaring med Cura.

  • Trives med struktur, overblik og mange samtidige opgaver

  • Er tydelig, rolig og respektfuld i din kommunikation – også når hverdagen er presset

  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem drift, faglighed og medarbejdertrivsel og er indstillet på at arbejde under helhedspleje konceptet.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer og i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen

  • Villig til at varetage opgaver i perioder, som ligger udenfor jobfunktionsbeskrivelsen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En tydeligt afgrænset rolle med ansvar og mandat

  • Tæt og dagligt samarbejde med en øvrige administrativ personale

  • Mulighed for uddannelse, kursus og udvikling

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet og ordentlighed

  • Mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på struktur og hverdagsdrift

  • Stillingen er på 30-37 timer.

  • Skal indgå i en turnus ordning af intern bagvagts telefon samt sygetelefon.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Birthe Rex på tlf. 98 180199 alle hverdage mellem kl. 10.00-14.00.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, men senest d 1/12-26.

jobs.title: Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet
jobs.description:
Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet

Har du hjertet på rette sted, lyst til at være sammen med børn og mod på at blive en del af et lille børnehus med masser af historie og personlighed? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Bag den grønne port i Helsingørs gågade ligger vores lille private børnehave med 27 børn og fem medarbejdere, herunder vores leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med mere end 190 års historie, en hyggelig legeplads, bålfad og vildtvoksende gemmesteder. Her er der plads til leg, fantasi, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi elsker at være ude i al slags vejr.

Hos os er det nære børneliv i fokus. Vi vægter relationer, leg og nærvær højt.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld timelønnet medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en fast del af vores hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med børn og lyst til at arbejde pædagogisk.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

·        er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe relationer til børn

·        deltager aktivt i børnenes leg og hverdag

·        møder børn med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiver

·        kan tage initiativ og indgå i husets rammer og rutiner

·        er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

·        kan træde til med kort varsel og tage både åbne- og lukkevagter

Hos os får du

·        en arbejdsplads med historie, charme og personlighed

·        27 skønne børn og en hverdag fyldt med leg og oplevelser

·        engagerede kollegaer, der vægter samarbejde og faglighed

·        mulighed for at få erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde

·        mulighed for at blive en tryg og genkendelig voksen i børnenes hverdag

Praktisk information

Vi søger en timelønnet medarbejder. Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel og har mulighed for at træde til med kort varsel ved sygdom og andre akut opståede situationer. Ved i forvejen planlagt fravær blandt personalet, vil arbejdstiderne være fastlagt på forhånd, så du i god tid ved hvornår du skal arbejde.

Du skal kunne arbejde inden for hele børnehavens åbningstid og varetage både åbne- og lukkevagter.

Åbningstider: mandag–torsdag kl. 6.30–17.00 og fredag kl. 6.30–16.15.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst og aftaler. Der indhentes børneattest inden ansættelse.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Børneasylet?

Send os en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med børn, og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig at arbejde hos os. Vi holder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Helsingør Børneasyl  |  Telefon: 26 21 21 70  |  Mail: leder@hbasylet.dk

Helsingør Børneasyl – anno 1835

jobs.title: ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B) / ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)
jobs.description:
ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS oplever fortsat vækst, og vi udvider nu vores team. Vi søger to engagerede, ansvarsfulde og stabile profiler til vores transport- og logistikdrift: En struktureret koordinator (med aktiv kørsel) og en professionel chauffør. Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag i en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet og højt serviceniveau er i højsædet. Læs mere om de to stillinger nedenfor og angiv i din ansøgning, hvilken rolle du søger.

PROFIL 1: Teamkoordinator & Chauffør (Hybridstilling)

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

  • Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

  • Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

  • Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

  • Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

  • Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

  • Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

  • Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

  • Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

  • Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

  • Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

  • Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

  • En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

  • Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne, så snart de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte os via ovenstående e-mail, hvorefter vi vil vende tilbage til dig.

 

ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS continues to grow, and we are now expanding our team. We are seeking two dedicated, responsible, and reliable profiles for our transport and logistics operations: A structured coordinator (with active driving) and a professional driver. Both positions require a standard driver's license (Category B), as well as proficiency in Turkish and English.

We offer a dynamic everyday work environment in a developing company where quality and high service levels are paramount. Read more about the two positions below and please specify in your application which role you are applying for.

PROFILE 1: Team Coordinator & Driver (Hybrid Position)

As our new coordinator, you will be the core of our daily operations. You will be responsible for planning the work schedule for our drivers, but you will also be an active part of the fleet and step behind the wheel yourself.

Your primary tasks:

  • Planning and coordination: Daily route planning and task management for the company's employed drivers.

  • Quality assurance in the field: Periodically driving with the drivers to evaluate, guide, and ensure our high-quality standards.

  • Active driving: Even though you have administrative tasks, you will also act as an active driver (License B) on a daily basis and during busy periods.

  • Administrative tasks: Handling ad-hoc administrative tasks related to operations.

  • Sparring and support: Acting as the primary contact person, guide, and motivator for the driver team.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You must be able to communicate fluently in Turkish and English (both written and spoken) for our internal coordination and business partners.

  • Experience in logistics, coordination, or team leadership (experience in the transport industry is a major advantage).

  • Structured, solution-oriented, and able to maintain an overview in high-pressure situations.

  • Valid driver's license (B) and experience as an active, experienced driver.

PROFILE 2: Driver (Driver's License B)

We are looking for a reliable and service-minded driver who will be the face of the company to our customers. You will become an important part of our daily delivery team.

Your primary tasks:

  • Transport and delivery: Safe and efficient execution of planned routes in the company's vehicles (Category B).

  • Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

  • Quality-conscious work: Making sure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy, and that applicable regulations for transport are followed.

  • Collaboration: Close dialogue with the coordinator and the rest of the team to optimize the daily workflow.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

  • Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

  • Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

  • Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

  • A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

  • A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

  • Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

jobs.title: PhD in In-Operando Diagnostics of Li-ion and Post-Li-ion Batteries Using Acoustic Technology
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a PhD stipend position is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from 15 November 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksBattery performance assessment and diagnostics rely today on standardised electrical measurements complemented by post-mortem analysis. None of these methods is suited for in-operando diagnostics, as they are either destructive or require the battery to be taken out of its daily operation. Acoustic techniques, based either on passive listening to acoustic emissions or on active ultrasound signal injection, have recently been proposed as an alternative; however, further research is needed to establish the relationship between materials degradation and the sensed acoustic signals. The aim of this PhD project is to establish a mechanistic understanding of the coupling between battery ageing mechanisms and measured acoustic signals, and to translate this understanding into a diagnostic method applicable to both Li-ion and post-Li-ion chemistries.

You will start by reviewing the state of the art in acoustic-based battery diagnostics, and you will then design and build a set-up for sensing acoustic emissions in coin cells. Using this set-up, you will carry out degradation tests over a wide range of operating conditions with simultaneous acoustic and electrical measurements, and you will analyse how the acoustic signatures relate to the electrical ones and to the underlying degradation mechanisms. On this basis, you will develop an acoustic-based, physics-validated model for battery diagnostics; the resulting algorithm is targeted to be at least 25% more accurate than conventional impedance-based estimation and at least 50% less energy demanding than traditional diagnostic approaches. While most of the experimental work will be carried out at coin-cell level, a proof of concept at single-layer pouch-cell level is expected, which will facilitate further demonstration towards innovation.

The work will be supported by critical analysis of the results, benchmarking against the state of the art, and high-quality publications and conference presentations. In addition to the research activities, you will contribute to teaching and to the supervision of student projects, as well as to broader dissemination activities within the department.

The position is offered in relation to the research group Batteries, and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for Power Electronics Systems Integration and Materials.

Your competencies We are looking for a motivated PhD candidate who is eager to work at the intersection of battery testing, sensing instrumentation and signal processing, and who enjoys combining fundamental understanding with hands-on experimental work. The ideal candidate is curious and persistent in the laboratory, excels at troubleshooting, can plan and execute experiments independently, and motivated to collaborate closely with colleagues in an international and interdisciplinary environment.

Applicants must hold an M.Sc. degree in electrical engineering, energy engineering or mechatronics. Experience with one or more of the following will be considered an advantage: electrical characterisation of batteries, acoustic or ultrasonic sensing and laboratory instrumentation, and signal processing and data-driven modelling (e.g., in MATLAB or Python). Experience with Problem Based Learning (PBL) is required, as the PhD student will be involved in the supervision of BSc and MSc student projects. Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken, are required, as the project will be carried out in an international research environment. Danish language skills are highly desirable and will support co-supervision of BSc student projects; however, they are not a formal requirement.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners, utilities and other academic environments to address real world energy challenges.

Aalborg University has been ranked as the best university in Europe within energy research and is among the very best universities worldwide in this field. At AAU Energy you will be part of a top international environment where research, innovation and collaboration are used to develop solutions to global challenges such as the green transition and future energy systems.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and with diverse national and disciplinary backgrounds, which creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as working language in both research and teaching, which supports the integration of international colleagues.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employmentThe employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement). 

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: PhD in Quantum Computing for Power Systems
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from December 1, 2026, or as soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasksThis PhD position focuses on the application of quantum computing to computational challenges in power systems with high shares of renewable energy. You will investigate quantum and hybrid quantum–classical methods for power system analysis and optimization, with emphasis on their practical performance and suitability for real-time applications.

Your work will include formulating representative power system analysis and optimization problems, developing and implementing quantum and hybrid quantum–classical solution methods, and comparing their performance with relevant classical approaches. You will also evaluate the developed methods through numerical studies and real-time power system simulation. The research will involve scientific programming, analysis and documentation of results, and dissemination through peer-reviewed publications and international conferences.

The position is offered within the Center for Research on Microgrids, and the PhD student will be affiliated with the Electric Power Systems and Microgrids section at AAU Energy.

Your competencies The applicant must have a relevant educational background in electrical engineering, energy engineering, computer science, or a closely related field. You should have a solid foundation in mathematical modelling and numerical methods, together with experience in scientific programming, preferably in Python. Knowledge of power system analysis and optimization (e.g., power flow and optimal power flow), as well as experience with quantum computing methods and algorithms (e.g., HHL or variational quantum linear solvers for linear system problems, and QAOA or quantum annealing for optimization problems), is expected.

Experience with real-time power system simulation using platforms such as RTDS or OPAL-RT would be an advantage. Previous peer-reviewed journal publications at the intersection of quantum computing and power and energy systems would also be considered an advantage. You should be motivated to further develop your expertise across both power systems and quantum computing.

You should be able to organize and conduct research independently, document and communicate your methods and results clearly, and discuss technical challenges constructively with colleagues. The position requires both independent research and collaboration with researchers from different disciplinary backgrounds, as well as good written and spoken English.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

In this position, you'll play a crucial role in shaping our go-to-market strategy and driving data-informed decision-making within the Japan/APAC region. This position sits at the intersection of sales, strategy, and operations, offering the opportunity to significantly impact Notion's growth trajectory. You'll work closely with sales leadership and cross-functional teams to optimize processes, deliver actionable insights, and support key strategic initiatives. You will report directly to the Head of Field Strategy & Operations.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with Japan leadership team to define and drive strategy (e.g. territory mapping, long-term account planning, geographic expansion) and results for the region by conducting insightful analysis on local Japan markets and customers while providing support for other APAC priorities as needed.

 - Support regional sales leaders and sales teams in achieving their goals by providing actionable insights and visibility to sales performance metrics

 - Build reporting and presentations for Japan/APAC sales leadership to update on the state of the business, both up and across the organization

 - Act as a partner to the Japan/APAC sales team, providing hands-on operational support to drive deals forward and advising with decision-making

 - Enable smooth, efficient deal execution by supporting day-to-day deal operations, including opportunity hygiene, quote preparation, and coordination of approvals and internal handoffs, helping sellers navigate processes and remove friction throughout the deal lifecycle

 - Partner with the GTM Systems team to continuously enhance our sales technology stack to provide both a best-in-class experience for our sellers and a robust sales data environment

 - Work with cross-functional teams including Legal, Finance, Product, Marketing, etc. as the primary operational counterpart on behalf of the Japan/APAC sales org

 - Maintain and embed global sales policies, processes, and procedures, driving discipline with regards to strategy execution

 - Support global planning process locally, including target setting, capacity modeling, territory carving, etc.

 - Surface on-the-ground observations and insights to global sales and RevOps leadership




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 5+ years of strategy, operations, and analytics experience with a track record of driving growth - working in sales operations, preferably in a high-growth SaaS environment

 - Expertise to quickly drill down into the business funnel for outbound and inbound sales motions, and how that connects to revenue

 - Excellent analytical and quantitative modeling skills; ability to analyze and interpret data, provide actionable insights, and deliver measurable results

 - Expert proficiency with core sales tools (e.g. Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, etc.) and best practices for sales data management

 - Ability to apply AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, uncover trends, and translate complex sales data into actionable business insights. Comfortable framing analytical questions, iterating on prompts, and validating AI-generated outputs with sound business judgment and rigorous data checks, while handling sensitive information responsibly

 - Strong collaborator, works well with stakeholders, gains trust, enjoys working with people

 - Demonstrates a senior presence and can convey complex information to executives clearly and concisely; can resolve tradeoffs. Effective communicator across levels and audiences

 - Hands on and proactive, with a builders mentality.

 - Maintaining high ownership mentality, demonstrated by developing projects of >6-12 months length

 - Notion power user or desire to learn -- prior Notion experience is not required, but you have the ability and desire to become a pro

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Remote, Brazil, Full Time, Individual Contributor, +3 years of experience

Who We Are

At Yuno, we are building the payment infrastructure that allows all companies to participate in the global market. Founded by seasoned experts from the payments and tech industries, our technology provides access to leading payment capabilities, enabling companies to engage customers confidently and maintain global operations through seamless integrations.

We empower high-performing teams at brands like InDrive, McDonald's, Rappi, and Viva Aerobus to integrate over 1,000 payment methods via a single API. By leveraging advanced AI and the latest technologies, we orchestrate smart routing and fraud prevention across 80+ countries.

 

About The Role

We are orchestrating the best high-performing team!

We are looking for a Technical Account Manager to own and elevate Yuno's technical customer relationships across Latin America. This is a leadership position for someone who combines deep technical expertise with the ability to inspire a team, build trust with customers, and drive outcomes that matter. You will be the senior technical voice for our most strategic accounts in the region â and the person who sets the standard for how great technical partnership looks at Yuno.

Day to day, you will lead a team of TAMs while staying close to the most complex customer challenges yourself. LATAM is one of the fastest-growing payment ecosystems in the world, with unique local nuances and high-stakes integrations. That environment rewards people who bring both precision and resilience â someone who can stay steady under pressure, push through hard problems, and come out the other side with better solutions and stronger customer relationships than before.

This role also sits at the heart of Yuno's cross-functional engine. You will work closely with Product, Development, Sales, and Partnerships teams, making sure customer insights translate into real improvements and that internal teams have the context they need to move fast. You will set best practices, define how the TAM function scales, and ensure every integration your team owns reflects the quality and reliability Yuno's customers expect.

If you are technically sharp, and genuinely excited about building something meaningful in one of the most dynamic payment markets in the world â this role is for you.

 

Your contribution will be

  • Serve as the senior technical point of contact for strategic accounts, owning escalations and driving resolution on complex integration challenges

  • Lead high-level discussions with customer leadership around technical strategy, product trade-offs, incident management, and risk mitigation

  • Define and implement best practices for technical onboarding, integration delivery, and ongoing account health monitoring

  • Build deep knowledge of each customer's business model, technical stack, and operational needs to proactively unlock value

  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Partnerships, and Finance to support account retention and regional growth

  • Monitor integration progress and ramp-up milestones across the team, ensuring consistent and high-quality delivery

  • Champion the LATAM customer base internally, bringing regional intelligence into Yuno's strategic conversations

 

Skills You Need

Minimum Qualifications

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese is a plus ; Spanish is a plus

  • 5+ years of experience in technical account management or integration engineering, preferably in fintech or payments

  • Proven track record of leading or mentoring technical teams

  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, SOAP, JSON, XML, and API management tools such as Postman, SoapUI, or Swagger

  • Proficiency in web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, RESTful APIs, and modern frameworks

  • Hands-on experience in at least one server-side language: Golang, Python, Node.js, or equivalent

  • Familiarity with server and database technologies including Apache, Nginx, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and project management skills

  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple accounts, team priorities, and concurrent projects

  • Clear and compelling communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders at all seniority levels

  • Experience with ticketing systems is a plus

 

What We Offer at Yuno

  • Competitive Compensation

  • Remote Work â You can work from everywhere!

  • Home Office Bonus â A one-time allowance to help you create your ideal home office.

  • Work Equipment

  • Stock Options

  • Health Plan wherever you are.

  • Flexible Days Off

jobs.description:
Work tasks: The duties of a CNC Machine Operator / Printed Circuit Board (PCB) Manufacturer at Brandner Electronics include manufacturing and mechanically processing printed circuit boards according to technical requirements. The work involves setting up and operating CNC machines, loading materials into the machine, and monitoring the production process. The operator is also responsible for checking the quality and dimensions of finished circuit boards, sorting completed products, and reporting any problems. Additional duties include keeping the machine and workstation clean and organized, following health and safety regulations, and recording the quantities of products manufactured.

We offer: The opportunity to gain new knowledge and improve your practical skills. Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within the company. A friendly and supportive team where your contribution is recognized and valued. If you are looking for a stable job that offers opportunities for growth, values its employees, and provides a pleasant and supportive working environment, we encourage you to apply!

jobs.title: Head of Technology
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Head of Technology for the garden3d creative collective, to lead engineering at Sanctuary Computer and garden3d in the era of agentic computer code.

Original job posting link

About garden3d

We are worker owned creative collective, innovating on everything from brands and IRL communities to IoT devices and cross platform apps. We share profit, open source everything, spin out new businesses, and invest in exciting ideas through financial and/or in-kind contributions.

Our client roster includes Google, Stripe, Figma, Hinge, Black Socialists in America, ACLU, Pratt, Parsons, Mozilla, The Nobel Prize, MIT, Gnosis, Etsy & Gagosian.

Weâre the software team behind innovative products like The Light Phone & Mill, and we operate a global, decentralized community space collective called Index Space.

We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. We work on projects that bring value to our world, and we balance deep care for the work we do with a genuine curiosity about life outside of our jobs.

Sanctuary Computer - Development

At Sanctuary Computer weâre building a different type of technology shop â one that prioritizes close collaboration between the client and the craftsperson.

Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development.

XXIX - Design

When we started XXIX in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and weâve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be.

Weâre building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility.

Index - Community

Index is network of physical spaces all around the world, Index provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools.

We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care.

garden3d TK â Media

At garden3d, weâre in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture.

We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music.

Plus, our partner organizations

Lightphone
Mill
IngredientAI

â°ï¸ The Head of Technology Role

The garden3d Head of Technology has one mandate: everything we build works, holds up in production, and gets built the smartest way available to us. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and a lot of what all of them ship runs on software we wrote. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis, this person sets the engineering standard, and builds the culture that holds it.

You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you.

This role works with studio leads, developers, designers, project managers and clients across every garden3d vertical.

This person can move between a Rails migration, a Next.js app, a firmware release plan and an agent loop in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them.

They span all of garden3d, but their home base is Sanctuary Computer, where roughly 70% of their time goes. Our development studio is where the engineering standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips: architecture, code review, estimation, and the hardest technical calls on our biggest projects. The other 30% goes to garden3d's broader technology story: how we ship product for USB Club, build with agents across the collective, which tools and platforms we bet on, and what we build for ourselves.

They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the engineers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Stripe, Brooklyn Museum and The Nobel Prize, and sees an engineering practice they can propel among the best in the world.

Responsibilities & Mandates

ï¸ Systems that hold up

We build web apps, native apps, data pipelines, content platforms and connected devices for clients who can't afford for them to fall over. This person has engineered complex systems for a long time, and it shows in the architecture they draw before a line is written. They own the technical blueprint on our most important projects, and they make the hard calls on the rest: what to build, what to buy, and what to leave out.

All in on agentic development

The way software gets built changed, and we intend to be ahead of it. This person is already deep in it: loop engineering, agents running against evals, agents that open their own PRs, and the guardrails that make all of that trustworthy. They make agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer works, and they can tell the difference between a demo and a system a team can rely on.

Practical engineering

We strongly prefer convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms that let a small team ship a lot. TypeScript is the default language, Rails and Phoenix handle what they're best at, and we'd rather deploy to a platform like Render or Heroku than run our own infrastructure. This person practices value engineering: the simplest thing that works, built well, at a cost the client is glad to pay.

Code quality at Sanctuary Computer

Sanctuary Computer is where our engineering standard lives, so this is where most of their energy goes. They set what good code review looks like, keep our senior developers sharp on architecture and quality, and make sure that bar holds without slowing the team down.

Hiring and empowering the very best

They are a magnet for exceptional engineers. They know where to find them, how to convince them, and how to give them enough room to do their best work while still holding them to the standard. People who work for this person should get visibly better, and should say so.

Estimation, scoping and delivery

They make sure our teams can reliably estimate and story point the work ahead, and that we deliver at a pace that meets the dates we promised and protects our margins. When an estimate is wrong, they find out why and fix the process.

The technical voice in new business

Our clients include Google, Stripe, Figma, Mozilla and The Nobel Prize. This person joins new business calls as the trusted technical consultant, scopes the work, writes the technical side of proposals, and can explain a hard tradeoff to a client's CTO and their CEO in the same meeting.

Hardware sense

We're the software team behind The Light Phone and Mill, so a good share of our work touches devices. This person doesn't need to be a firmware engineer, but they understand how hardware works, where it constrains the software, and how to plan a project that spans both.

The garden3d technology story

Across the collective, they decide which tools and platforms we bet on, how every studio uses agents, and which internal tools are worth turning into products. When someone at garden3d asks "how should we build this?", this person has the answer, or knows who does.

Culture

They model garden3d's values of partnership, curiosity, and accountability. The engineers they lead do the best work of their careers here, because the feedback is honest, the recognition is earned, and the craft rubs off

Â Special Projects

In addition to day to day responsibilities, hereâs an idea of some of the projects this role may spearhead or support in coming years â

  • Making agentic development the default way Sanctuary Computer builds, with loops and evals the whole team trusts
  • Setting the shared technical conventions every garden3d studio builds from
  • Landing the kind of flagship engineering engagement that changes what people think we do
  • Hiring the next generation of the engineering team, across every garden3d studio
  • Turning the internal tools and agents we build for ourselves into products
  • Partnering with the Head of Design so our own studio websites are as well engineered as they are designed

Qualifications

This is a great opportunity for someone looking to make a significant impact in a growing, dynamic company. Based on the responsibilities of this role, we think the right candidate has the following experience and skills:

Must have:

  • 12+ years building software, at least three of them leading engineers inside a studio, agency, startup or founder-led company
  • Deep experience engineering complex systems, shipped and run in production: distributed services, data pipelines, multi-platform products
  • A true technology generalist, comfortable across frontend, backend, data, infrastructure and native
  • A strong preference for practical engineering: convention over configuration, boring technology, and platforms as a service over bespoke infrastructure
  • All in on agentic development: loop engineering, evals, and agents doing real work in a real codebase
  • Fluency across most of our stack: React, Next.js, Ruby on Rails, Elixir & Phoenix, Sanity, Postgres, Redis. You won't use all of it every week, but you should be able to review any of it
  • Experience as the technical lead in winning work: scoping, estimating and pitching to clients
  • A track record of hiring exceptional engineers, and of people who got measurably better working for them
  • Hands-on. This person can still write the code, not only review it (and will get on the tools when the need arises)

Nice-to-have:

  • A sense of how hardware works: firmware, embedded systems, IoT, and shipping software for physical products
  • Experience in a client services environment (a consultancy, agency or studio)
  • Experience in a Sales Engineer or Solutions Architect role
  • Open source projects they've started or maintained
  • Experience fostering close collaboration between design and engineering teams
  • Experience inside a worker-owned, open-book, or otherwise unusual company
  • A network in the engineering community: the meetups, the conferences, the people worth hiring
  • Interests in design, art, music, food or fashion. We find these people have a well rounded sense of quality

Who you are

The person weâre looking for is happy, relaxed and easy to get along with and appreciates a commitment to a culture of transparency, non-dictatorial leadership styles, and alternative methodologies. Theyâre flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work âsmartâ by carefully managing their workflow and team.

How we interview

After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests.

From there, weâll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where weâre going as a business.

For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow.

Compensation

This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program.

We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. In the first few weeks of the trial, this individual will propose their own goals to define success in their trial, and present them to our leadership team for approval.

At garden3d, we believe that those who shoulder the most responsibility and create the greatest impact should be paid accordingly. This role greatly favors autonomous, competent & ambitious operators.

â How we work:

We believe that thereâs a better balance between the poles of freelancing & full time, and for that reason we work differently to most shops:

  • Transparency & Ownership:Â We release out Profit & Loss statements to the community each year, open source our best ideas, and talk business & money with everyone in the company. Weâre proud to run our business with integrity, and for that reason we share everything with our team & community.

jobs.title: Senior Signal Processing Engineer – Acoustics & DSP
jobs.description:
Triton Depth | Copenhagen, Denmark | Full-time

About Triton Depth

Triton Depth is a Danish defence technology company developing advanced maritime sensing and surveillance technologies.

We bring together expertise in electronics, embedded systems, signal processing, and artificial intelligence to develop innovative solutions for some of the most challenging problems in maritime security.

We are a fast-growing, multidisciplinary engineering team working on technologies with real-world applications in defence and critical infrastructure protection.

The Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Signal Processing Engineer with a strong background in digital signal processing (DSP), preferably specializing in acoustics.

You will work on complex signal-processing challenges, developing algorithms that extract meaningful information from real-world acoustic data. Your work will involve advanced mathematical modelling, spectral analysis, filtering, detection, and statistical signal processing.

We are particularly interested in engineers who enjoy exploring signals, understanding their underlying physical characteristics, and pushing the boundaries of what can be extracted through classical signal-processing techniques.

This is a research-intensive, hands-on engineering position with significant technical freedom and ownership.

You will work closely with our embedded software, electronics, and AI teams, taking ideas from mathematical concepts through experimental validation and practical implementation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and implement advanced digital signal-processing algorithms.

  • Analyze complex acoustic signals in both time and frequency domains.

  • Develop techniques for spectral analysis, digital filtering, noise reduction, and signal detection.

  • Apply statistical signal processing and estimation theory to extract meaningful information from noisy measurements.

  • Investigate new signal-processing approaches and evaluate their performance using real-world data.

  • Develop efficient implementations of algorithms for practical applications.

  • Design experiments, analyze results, and continuously improve algorithm performance.

  • Collaborate with our multidisciplinary engineering team to integrate signal-processing solutions into operational systems.

Qualifications

We value technical ability, curiosity, and problem-solving skills more than specific degrees or years of experience.

We would like you to have:

  • An MSc or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Signal Processing, Applied Physics, Mathematics, or a related field.

  • A strong theoretical foundation in digital signal processing.

  • Passive sensing systems.

  • Real-time or embedded DSP.

  • Signal processing within defence, aerospace, telecommunications, or scientific instrumentation.

Work on meaningful challenges. Contribute to advanced technologies addressing real-world security challenges.

Technical freedom and ownership. Take responsibility for complex engineering problems, explore new approaches, and influence the technical direction of our products.

From research to reality. See your algorithms move beyond simulations and become part of real systems deployed in demanding environments.

A multidisciplinary engineering environment. Work alongside talented engineers specializing in embedded software, electronics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering.

A growing defence technology company. Join Triton Depth at an exciting stage, where individual contributions have a direct impact on the company's technology and future.

Who You Are

You are someone who genuinely enjoys understanding signals.

You are curious about the information hidden within complex measurements and have the mathematical knowledge and practical skills to uncover it.

You are equally comfortable exploring theoretical concepts, experimenting with algorithms, and analyzing real-world data.

You enjoy difficult, open-ended technical challenges and take pride in developing solutions that work outside controlled laboratory environments.

Above all, you are motivated by the opportunity to turn advanced signal-processing research into technology with real-world impact.

Apply

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you.

Send us your CV and a short introduction describing your background and relevant experience.

We are particularly interested in hearing about signal-processing projects, research, or technical challenges you have worked on.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
jobs.description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
jobs.description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

Description

Machine Learning Maestro: You donât just work with data - you decode it, predict the future with it, and turn it into action. Your models donât just sit on a shelf - they shape strategy, optimize efficiency, and fuel company growth. You thrive on uncovering hidden patterns, validating hypotheses, and embedding machine learning models into real-world AI applications. If that sounds like you - read on.

AlgaeCal is looking for a top-tier Associate Data Scientist who can turn raw information into strategies that drive measurable results.

This job will give you ALL the feels:

At AlgaeCal, weâre driven by a single idea. To end the fear of bone loss. In the United States, an estimated 54 million people have low bone density.

The good news? AlgaeCal has the worldâs only clinically-backed natural solution to this problem. We give hope to everyone worried about bone loss. If that excites you, youâll find no better place to continue your career than at AlgaeCal.

This job might be for you if youâve gotâ¦

  • Experience as a Data Scientist (or a similar role) and can back it up with a resume that shows real results. Youâve built predictive models, optimized AI applications, and refined data architectures that have had a measurable impact. You donât just analyze numbersâyou translate data into actionable insights that drive business decisions.
  • Serious coding skills in Python or R. You know how to build and refine machine learning models that actually work. Youâve used statistical modeling and data science tools to solve complex problems and unlock growth opportunities.
  • Expertise in SQL and relational databases. Writing efficient queries? Optimizing data structures? Your resume is packed with quantifiable examples thatâll make us drool with desire! You know how to work with large datasets, ensuring data is organized, accessible, and primed for analysis.
  • A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms. Whether itâs regression, clustering, or neural networks, you know how to choose the right approach for the right challenge. You donât just apply modelsâyou understand how they work under the hood.
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouses. BigQuery or similar? Check. You understand how to design, maintain, and optimize scalable data storage solutions that support robust analytics.
  • A knack for standardizing and improving data models. Youâve worked with data at scale, refining schemas and improving architectures to ensure efficiency, accuracy, and usability across the organization.
  • A laser-sharp eye for detail. Youâre the kind of person who spots trends, outliers, and opportunities that others miss. Your ability to catch anomalies helps ensure our models and analytics are always on point.
  • An entrepreneurial approach to data. You donât just crunch numbersâyou think strategically about how data can be leveraged to create business value. Youâre proactive in identifying new ways AI and machine learning can drive efficiency, sales, and profitability.
  • Industry know-how that adds value. If youâve got experience in consumer packaged goods, e-commerce, or the health/supplement industry, thatâs a huge plus. You understand how data can shape customer experience, optimize operations, and maximize ROI.

Now, time to be honest: is this really you? If youâre nodding your head and feeling that flutter of excitement, then we canât wait to meet you.

Other Qualities Youâll Need

At AlgaeCal weâre going to insist that you have these 3 qualities:

  • Youâre humbleââyou put the team and othersâ needs ahead of your own

The truth is, if you donât have these qualities you wonât last long at AlgaeCal. So if youâre missing one of them, be honest. Save yourself a lot of headaches and skip to a job posting that is a better fit for you.

What Will You Earn?

We believe in rewarding top talent. Letâs talk about salary once weâve had the chance to get to know you better. Rest assured, weâre generous and offer above-market pay for the right person. If you bring the skills and experience, weâll make sure the compensation reflects that.

Youâll also enjoy the following benefits:

And above all, youâll join a team that youâll never want to leave. Culture is everything to us. Yes, we work extremely hard to change as many peopleâs lives as possible. But we know how to have fun and reward ourselves too.

How To Apply
